origins.d: Physical prowess has always come naturally to you, and all your life you’ve been in good shape.
origins.full: Physical prowess has always come naturally to you, and all your life you’ve been in good shape. It still takes a modest amount of upkeep and discipline to maintain, but that has never been a hard decision for you to prioritize such things. You likely play physical sports, work out in your spare time, and maintain a healthy lifestyle.

f.perk: Always Training (origin benefit, Core p.22)
f.ess: You may increase either Strength or Speed by +1.
f.langs: You haven’t had much time to learn new languages beyond that of your family. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each three points of Social you possess.
f.btext: You are used to always working out and physically training in your spare time. When making a Strength or Speed-based Skill Test in a skill you do not possess levels in, you still roll a d2 skill die and do not suffer a Snag for being untrained.

origins.d: You love studying, learning, and reading about, well, everything.
origins.full: You love studying, learning, and reading about, well, everything. You live to learn, and you have learned a lot in your time. With all your time spent with your nose in books and such, you haven’t had time to prioritize things like how to fight, or much else beyond some personal hobbies.

f.perk: “I remember reading about…” (origin benefit, Core p.23)
f.langs: You have a knack for learning, and that includes linguistic roots and families. You are fluent in your native language, plus one additional language for each point of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: You have a vast array of knowledge that you have accumulated over the years, and occasionally you might know a little bit about something useful in nearly any situation. Once per scene, you can attempt a Skill Test in a Smarts-based skill as if you were Specialized in that skill.

origins.d: Class clown.
origins.full: Class clown. Jester. Wiseacre. Smart-aleck. There are a number of different terms and names often applied to a person like you, someone who uses comedy and levity to get through life’s little issues. While you have leaned on your charm and lighthearted cunning to get out of some situations, it has also thrown you in the thick of things on more than a few occasions.

f.perk: Keep ‘Em Laughing (origin benefit, Core p.23)
f.ess: You may increase either Smarts or Social by +1.
f.langs: Knowing extra ways to communicate are good if jokes are your best defense. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each three points of Social you possess.
f.btext: Using comedy to maintain morale amongst friends and keep adversaries guessing as to what’s really happening, you wield it like a sword and shield. Anytime you make your teammates, your opponents, or both laugh with your antics, add one Story Point to the pool.

origins.d: Ever since you were very young, you never have been able to keep your nose out of mysteries and the unknown.
origins.full: Ever since you were very young, you never have been able to keep your nose out of mysteries and the unknown. You live for discovering new things, especially if you’ve been told you aren’t supposed to know about it. Some might have called you nosey, or perhaps an eavesdropper, but it wasn’t really your fault; you’re just naturally interested in the unknown.

f.perk: Secret Knowledge (origin benefit, Core p.24)
f.ess: You may increase Smarts or Social by +1.
f.langs: Listening and understanding are key parts to your ability to uncover secrets. You are fluent in your native Language, and one additional Language for each two points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: You have been able to learn something others have not, and may choose a General Perk you meet the prerequisites, if any, to possess.

origins.d: No matter what the world throws at you, it only takes a pair of crossed arms and a good eyeroll to deflate the nature of it.
origins.full: No matter what the world throws at you, it only takes a pair of crossed arms and a good eyeroll to deflate the nature of it. You are sarcastic and dry, possibly even jaded from happenings in your life, but nothing strikes you as completely exciting or breathtaking. Even though it hands you new adventures all the time, the world leaves you nonplussed.

f.perk: “Oh, What Now?” (origin benefit, Core p.24)
f.ess: You may increase either Speed or Social by +1.
f.langs: You haven’t really had any reason to want to learn many new languages; it just isn’t “you.” You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each three points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: You are so steeled against being shocked or surprised that negative emotional responses are just not really something you give in to easily. Any attack or effect that targets you emotionally automatically suffers Snag, and you have Edge when trying to roll to overcome emotional distress.

origins.d: You are beloved by most, and it comes as a reflection of your own kindness that you show others.
origins.full: You are beloved by most, and it comes as a reflection of your own kindness that you show others. You are generally a good person that wants others to excel at what they are doing, and it hurts you to see anyone suffering or in pain. When people think of you, it is almost always with good connotations in mind.

f.perk: “I Know A Guy” (origin benefit, Core p.24)
f.ess: You may increase Smarts or Social by +1.
f.langs: You learned early in life how to communicate with your neighbors and all the people you’d like to help. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each three points of Social you possess.
f.btext: You have been so nice to so many people in your lifetime, you have friends in the strangest places with a variety of talents. If you need a favor, some information, or perhaps the use of a skill you and your team does not possess, once per day you can communicate with a friendly acquaintance and attempt a DIF 12 Persuasion Skill Test. If you are successful, your acquaintance will gladly help you out with whatever you are lacking in the moment.

origins.d: You aren’t like anyone else.
origins.full: You aren’t like anyone else. Sometimes you say things that don’t make any sense to anyone but you and your close friends, and sometimes not even them. You don’t dress like the popular people, you don’t listen to the Top 40 music stations, and when your mind wanders it really wanders. Some people call you eccentric, perhaps unique, but one thing is for certain: you aren’t like anyone else.

f.perk: Nobody Like Me (origin benefit, Core p.25)
f.ess: You may increase any Essence score by +1.
f.langs: While you probably know a few made up languages or those from your favorite television series, real languages haven’t been big on your radar. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each three points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: You are truly unique, and this is shown by you being able to choose any General Perk you meet the prerequisites for.

origins.d: You were born to be raised up on a social pedestal by your peers and looked up at by the rest of the masses.
origins.full: You were born to be raised up on a social pedestal by your peers and looked up at by the rest of the masses. You weren’t necessarily Prom King or Prom Queen, but your name was assuredly on the ballot. Everyone knows who you are, and the majority of people think you are a pretty okay person. There are benefits to being the cool kid, and hopefully you don’t take them for granted.

f.perk: Are You Who I Think You Are? (origin benefit, Core p.26)
f.langs: It looked good to have at least one additional Language on your transcripts and resumes. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each three points of Social you possess.
f.bname: Are You Who I Think You Are?
f.btext: You have learned, possibly just accidentally, how to use your popularity as a method to get the results you are looking for in social circles. Whenever you are in a position to be recognized as a local social celebrity, you can always consider yourself as having an applicable Specialization in Deception, Persuasion, or Streetwise.

origins.d: Punks, delinquents, activists, troublemakers.
origins.full: Punks, delinquents, activists, troublemakers. There are countless different terms for those who just don’t like to get along with the status quo, whether in ideology, fashion, following social norms, or obeying the rules. You have never even wanted to go with the flow, nor has the system ever really done anything for you, either. You lash out in your own ways, and you stand firmly in your independence. You are a rebel, and damn anyone who tries to hold you down!

f.perk: You Can’t Tell Me What To Learn! (origin benefit, Core p.26)
f.ess: You may increase your Strength or Speed by +1.
f.langs: The system tried to tell you how much you needed additional languages to excel, but you weren’t having that. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each four points of Smarts you possess.
f.bname: You Can’t Tell Me What To Learn!
f.btext: You defy the system by learning skills and trades that aren’t of the norm, letting you stand out as truly unique. You gain any General Perk you meet the prerequisites for.

origins.d: Not everyone has the perfect childhood, the best relationship with their peers, or a carefree life where nothing has happened that leaves a mark forever.
origins.full: Not everyone has the perfect childhood, the best relationship with their peers, or a carefree life where nothing has happened that leaves a mark forever. Whatever happened in your past, you look back upon it with sadness, but not true depression or regret. Your past is what made you strong, and you know that you can overcome anything in your future because of the lessons you learned from it.

f.perk: Capable of Anything (origin benefit, Core p.27)
f.ess: You may increase any Essence score by +1.
f.langs: Learning to share your past with others opened you up to new cultures and modes of communication. You are fluent in your native language, and one additional language for each two points of Social you possess.
f.btext: You do not let your past define you, but it has made you stronger against the odds. Once per scene, you may re-roll any die result of a 1, but you must accept the new result.

origins.d: Some civilizations and cultures stand against the status quo.
origins.full: Some civilizations and cultures stand against the status quo. As you grew up, many peers, mentors, and teachers tried hard to make you fit into the mainstream, but you resisted. Even though you have learned there is more to the universe than fighting against it, you find yourself rebelling against the norm and playing devil’s advocate.

f.perk: One-Upping (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.38)
f.ess: Increase either Strength or Smarts by +1.
f.langs: Your teachers focused on your culture’s speech, and cultural exclusions made it challenging to find opportunities to learn other languages. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional Language for every three points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: If there is one thing you can never let pass by, it’s the opportunity to show someone else that you’re better than they are. Anytime one of your allies fails or Fumbles a Skill Test, you may immediately (or on your following action, if in a combat scene) attempt the same Skill Test, if possible, with ↑1.

origins.d: You are a mystery to others and even yourself, but your mysterious past is just a new storyline waiting to be discovered and understood.
origins.full: You are a mystery to others and even yourself, but your mysterious past is just a new storyline waiting to be discovered and understood. You know almost nothing about where you came from, and with help from your CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS friends and teammates, you can continue to grow in your own way or try to find out who you once were.

f.perk: Why Do I Know That? (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.38)
f.ess: Increase any Essence score by +1.
f.langs: Knowing almost nothing about your past forced you to learn as much as possible about everyone else’s, just in case it links up with yours. You are fluent in two Languages and one additional Language for every four points of Social you possess.
f.btext: Wherever you came from, it left a lasting impact on what you know. You may choose any General Perk, provided you meet its prerequisites.

origins.d: You were born running from something.
origins.full: You were born running from something. Whether it is a force looking to do you harm or perhaps something that believes you would be better off with them, you’ve always had to look over your shoulder and stay on the move to avoid the forces that try to put you in their sights. You have been escaping from the hardships and conflicts of the universe your entire life

f.perk: Can’t Catch Me! (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.39)
f.ess: Increase either Speed or Smarts by +1.
f.langs: Always on the run, you have crossed paths with many different peoples. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional Language for every two points of Social you possess.
f.btext: You have been avoiding capture for as long as you can remember and have gotten very good at being hard to pin down. As long as you are aware of an effect targeting you, you gain +1 to your Evasion.

origins.d: Some cultures uphold generational traditions of hereditary nobility, passing power and prestige though bloodlines, social groups, or collective families.
origins.full: Some cultures uphold generational traditions of hereditary nobility, passing power and prestige though bloodlines, social groups, or collective families. You were born into one of these families. Being of nobility doesn’t necessarily give you any additional rights or power over others (though it may); instead, it represents the cultural traditions surrounding your familial history.

f.perk: Be an Example (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.40)
f.ess: Increase either Smarts or Social by +1.
f.langs: It was essential to know the best ways to communicate with the people surrounding the lands of your bloodline. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional Language for every three points of Social you possess.
f.btext: You were born within the nobility of your civilization and taught the family traditions and the responsibilities of rulership. You can spend a Free action to reflect on your training and traditions to gain ↑1 to the skill you chose to increase or advance as part of this Origin.

origins.d: For as long as you remember, you have looked to the heavens, wanting to see the stars.
origins.full: For as long as you remember, you have looked to the heavens, wanting to see the stars. The secrets of the universe felt so close and yet so far away. Focus and dedication were key to breaking away from your world and reaching the stars, and your love of the expanding universe grows with each new piece you discover.

f.perk: Always Seeking (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.40)
f.ess: Increase either Speed or Smarts by +1.
f.langs: You’ve prepared to communicate with potential civilizations by learning many languages. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional Language for every three points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: Even when you achieve the heights you strive for, you then look further into the beyond and set yourself to exploring a new frontier. Whenever you knowingly attempt Skill Tests to work toward discovery, you do so with ↑1.

origins.d: The open road, made of sand, stone, or the void between the stars, has been a part of you for as long as you can remember.
origins.full: The open road, made of sand, stone, or the void between the stars, has been a part of you for as long as you can remember. Never satisfied in one place for long, a deep wanderlust always urges you to see more. You enjoy nothing more than feeling a new path beneath your feet.

f.perk: Life of a Thousand Roads (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.41)
f.ess: Increase either Strength or Smarts by +1.
f.langs: You have been to many places and met many people and picked up on communication around you. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional Language for every two points of Social you possess.
f.btext: As long as you can remember, you have moved from place to place, learning little bits of knowledge everywhere you go. Whenever you attempt a Culture or Survival Skill Test about an environment/ people you might have crossed paths with, gain ↑1.

origins.d: Your upbringing prepared you to be a champion, no matter how many battles life throws at you.
origins.full: Your upbringing prepared you to be a champion, no matter how many battles life throws at you. Your reason for fighting may be to wage war for your family, your people, and causes close to your heart.

f.perk: Fighting Spirit (origin benefit, Across the Stars p.42)
f.ess: Increase either Strength or Speed by +1.
f.langs: Taking to the battlefield alongside other warriors has given you a chance to learn how to converse with them, but you talk more through actions than words. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional Language for every three points of Social you possess.
f.btext: Passion and training taught you to always be on your toes. You always treat the Initiative Skill as though you are Specialized. Influences Like stars in the sky, there are countless reasons why a given character is the perfect choice for a position on a Power Ranger team. Differences in culture, civilization, and walks of life matter little when someone answers the call of duty to become a Power Ranger. The Morphin Grid and its champions find those who fill their needs, no matter what has shaped their pasts or is shaping their presents. Following, six new Essence20 Roleplaying System character creation Influences represent unique aspects of personalities hailing primarily from settings and civilizations far from the confines of Earth. While it isn’t unheard of for these facets of character creation to appear in humanity (or other Earth-based inhabitants), these options were inspired by common concepts concept in spacebased stories and existing Power Rangers. Important Rules Addendum—Mandatory Hang-Ups Some of the Influences found in this section have unique benefits that may seemingly outweigh other commonplace Influences found in this and other Essence20 Roleplaying System publications. To balance these out within the system, they come with unique and mandatory Hang-Ups. Unlike others that do not apply their Hang-Ups if chosen as a character’s first Influence, these Influences always impose their Hang-Up.

origins.d: In times of great need, it becomes necessary to sacrifice oneself to protect loved ones.
origins.full: In times of great need, it becomes necessary to sacrifice oneself to protect loved ones. Though this may cause great distress, it is a necessary sacrifice. You had the misfortune of witnessing an event so momentous that it changed your entire life, and you had to give up your old life and assume a new identity. Perhaps this was a permanent change, or perhaps it was only for a significant period of time, but you believe that it was for the greater good. Living in this manner was usually a matter of hiding in the open, but sometimes you were required to take certain actions that might have revealed your true identity to others, exposing either yourself or them to danger. And so, you didn’t just pretend to be someone else, you became someone else—at least until you were forced to unveil your true self once more.

f.perk: Blend With The Scenery (origin benefit, Beneath the Helmet p.29)
f.ess: Increase either Speed or Social by +1.
f.langs: To blend in when assuming another identity, it was important that you could understand and assimilate their language quickly. You are fluent in one additional language besides your own for every two points of Social you possess.
f.btext: Being forced to hide in plain sight and assume another identity, you’ve become adept at remaining unseen. Whenever you attempt a Deception or Infiltration Skill Test in an area you wouldn’t normally belong, you gain ↑1.

origins.d: If there was someone who was ever average, it was you.
origins.full: If there was someone who was ever average, it was you. People overlook you and your contributions no matter how hard you try or how good you are. There was always someone better around, but being second-best was never something you settled for. Instead, you become good at improvising and understanding what lay behind it all and learned to do a bit of everything. That didn’t help, and even your family simply expects you to conform to their wishes, but that’s not going to happen. Ambition drives you and drives you hard. You don’t want to be overlooked anymore, and you don’t want to be just “part of the scenery.” Your ambitions aren’t what others might want for you, but what you want. Choosing your path is your goal, and while others might slow you down from reaching it, they’ll not be able to stop you.

f.ess: Increase either Smarts or Social by +1.
f.langs: Your exposure to foreign languages was kept to a minimum while you were growing up, and while you can learn new languages, it doesn’t come naturally to you. You are fluent in one additional language besides your own for every three points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: Don’t Underestimate Me You’re always being underestimated by others, even if they’ve previously seen how capable you are. But there are ways to use that to your advantage, and you’ve learned to be unassuming when you need to be. The first attack or contested Skill Test against you in any scene imposes Snag if you are aware of the aggressor.

origins.d: You were always the smartest person in the room, though that never inflated your ego or made you arrogant.
origins.full: You were always the smartest person in the room, though that never inflated your ego or made you arrogant. Instead, you chose to make the best of your gifts and focus on where you could have the greatest impact. As a result, libraries and research labs became like a second home to you, and you were able to do extraordinary things. However, being on the cutting edge of technology and research comes with a cost, and that cost isn’t always one that a person can bear. You might have chosen to continue your research efforts, or you could have chosen to take a step back and teach the next generation instead so that they’d be smarter and wiser than you were once they were fully grown.

f.perk: I’ve Done My Research (origin benefit, Beneath the Helmet p.30)
f.ess: Increase either Speed or Smarts by +1.
f.langs: Your ability to learn is almost unparalleled, and your natural ability extends into languages as well. You can quickly assimilate new languages and understand nuances that others might miss. You are fluent in one additional language besides your own for every two points of Smarts you possess.
f.btext: Given time, you can think up a solution to just about anything if it is within one of your fields. But within those fields, you are unparalleled and able to quickly deduce the correct way to tackle any problem or obstacle that might stand in your way. At the beginning of an adventure, choose three Smarts Skills. You gain ↑1 on Skill Tests when you use those Skills until the next adventure.

origins.d: You grew up with more money than anyone would ever really need, and at an early age, you learned well that money was no obstacle to you.
origins.full: You grew up with more money than anyone would ever really need, and at an early age, you learned well that money was no obstacle to you. The finest teachers were available, as were the best bits of everything, like pets, toys, and whatever you wanted. You became so used to having whatever you pointed at that being exposed to the real world came as a very rude awakening that shook you to your core. You always considered yourself lucky, but not to an extreme degree, and seeing how other people lived was a surprise. Eventually, you came to the decision that your wealth was a boon, one that enabled you to help others in whatever way you could. You might not always understand why someone needed the help they did, but you were willing to give it, even if this occasionally led to clashes with your family over your use of your riches.

f.perk: Money is No Object (origin benefit, Beneath the Helmet p.31)
f.ess: Increase either Smarts or Social by +1.
f.langs: Due to your riches and social status, you were used to others conforming to your norms rather than the other way around. As such, you never really had much interest in learning the language of others, though you often did pick up on their social cues. You are fluent in one additional language beside
f.btext: You had access to wealth all your life, and you’ve learned to spread it around when necessary. To you, money is just a way of keeping score or acquiring the services you want. You gain the Vast Wealth Perk. WHO WEARS THE HELMET WHO WEARS THE HELMET

origins.d: Your world was taken over by Lord Drakkon, who rules it with an iron fist.
origins.full: Your world was taken over by Lord Drakkon, who rules it with an iron fist. The Power Rangers have all been defeated, their powers stolen to fuel his army of Ranger Sentries. No help is coming to save you, but you’ve refused to accept this new status quo. Even without Morphers or powers, you chose to fight, part of a resistance that works to save their world together. You’re used to fighting while outmanned and outgunned, so you’ve devised techniques to counteract that. Where the enemy is vulnerable, you strike hard and fast. Where the enemy has overwhelming forces, you have cunning and loyalty to each other, allowing you to sow dissent from within. These are just a few lessons you’ve learned to defeat the forces of authority. Victories are rare, but that doesn’t mean you can accept failure. You are the Coinless, and you will not give up on your world.

f.ess: Increase either Speed or Smarts by +1.
f.langs: The Resistance is composed of people from all over fighting side by side, exposing you to various cultures. You are fluent in your native Language and one additional language for every 2 points of Social you possess. Origin Perk: We are the Coinless You know the only way to stand up to evil is to st

origins.d: You are a borrowed existence of someone.
origins.full: You are a borrowed existence of someone. Whether you were a clone, a mystical replica, a mimic, or a projection—or you always knew you were the original version. Ultimately, you’ve lived your own life and made your own choices until you learned the truth, or you always knew and decided to live differently than your counterpart.

f.ess: Increase any Essence Score by +1.
f.langs: You know just as much as your original counterpart and possibly more. You are fluent in your native Language and two additional Languages. If your original knew more languages, then you know as many Languages plus two additional Languages. Origin Perk: Mirror-Mirror You have a knack for replicating

origins.d: The Void is a place untouched by the power of the Morphin Grid, and any attempt to survive in its harsh environment can only either make one terribly hardy or threaten to consume…
origins.full: The Void is a place untouched by the power of the Morphin Grid, and any attempt to survive in its harsh environment can only either make one terribly hardy or threaten to consume you. You have somehow survived the worst of it for some time and have returned to the known universe changed by it.

f.ess: You may decrease your Strength or Social by 1 and increase your Smarts or Speed by 2.
f.langs: You have had experience in the world from which you came before this point, but the trauma of your time in the Void has dulled your social talent. You are fluent in two Languages as well as one additional Language per four points of Social you possess. Origin Perk: Inner Conservation In a place wher

influences.d: You’ve always had an inspiration to create.
influences.full: You’ve always had an inspiration to create. Whether it’s putting notes to music, paint to a canvas, or another kind of creation, your life’s work is in the art of expressing yourself through making something. You may have been a musician, painter, chef, dancer, sculptor, model, writer, actor, or any of a wide variety of creative pursuits. When you select this background, choose the pursuit your character follows. It can change through play as your character experiments with different forms of art.

f.line: Artisan: You gain an Edge when your Art comes into play, such as when performing, sharing techniques, or applying your art to a mission. (Core p.66)
f.hangup: You sometimes get absorbed by your work and miss what’s going on around you. (Artisan)
f.perkText: You gain an Edge when your Art comes into play, such as when performing, sharing techniques, or applying your art to a mission. You are passionate about your art style, and gain an Edge on Social and Smarts Skill Tests where your art style applies.
f.hangText: You sometimes get absorbed by your work and miss what’s going on around you. You suffer a Snag on Smartsand Social-based Skill Tests unrelated to your art while you are actively involved with your art. If you are a solo artist, you hate having to share the spotlight with other artists, and you suffer a Snag on Social-based Skill Tests when around them. If you are a collaborative artist, your desire to talk about future art projects causes you to lose focus on the task at hand.

influences.d: You have a natural bedside manner and a way with those who need a little extra help.
influences.full: You have a natural bedside manner and a way with those who need a little extra help. Your strong sense of responsibility and ability to act calmly in stressful situations allow you to take care of others with a protective instinct of a parent. Since you were little, you have always felt a need to help those who aren’t as equipped to help themselves. You may have been a nanny, a babysitter, a hospital volunteer, or even have a live-in grandparent that you care for.

f.line: Caretaker: You gain Edge on all Science (Medicine) Skill Tests and Group Skill Tests. (Core p.67)
f.hangup: Your commitment to your charge takes priority over others, even those in more immediate danger. (Caretaker)
f.perkText: You gain Edge on all Science (Medicine) Skill Tests and Group Skill Tests.
f.hangText: Your commitment to your charge takes priority over others, even those in more immediate danger. You will always ensure the safety of those you are responsible for before engaging in combat or even helping your team.

influences.d: You are ready and at the scene whenever there is trouble, due to your past as a first responder.
influences.full: You are ready and at the scene whenever there is trouble, due to your past as a first responder. You have basic knowledge in medicine and emergency tactics after many experiences dealing with people in need. The service you choose to provide to your community has allowed you to learn how to apply that practical know-how to various situations. You may have been a police officer, firefighter, EMT, National Guard, or the junior volunteer versions of those.

f.line: Community Helper: You gain an Edge on any non-combat tasks related to your chosen service when your Influence comes into play. (Core p.68)
f.hangup: You run into dangerous situations to help others without thinking, and your desire to help others above yourself often puts you in harm’s way. (Community Helper)
f.perkText: You gain an Edge on any non-combat tasks related to your chosen service when your Influence comes into play. Suggested choices with example tasks are listed below, but ultimately, the GM will determine if a task applies to your service.
f.hangText: You run into dangerous situations to help others without thinking, and your desire to help others above yourself often puts you in harm’s way. If an innocent person is in danger, you feel compelled to aid them before any other task. In combat, you will attempt to heal others’ damage before your own, even if strategically unsound.

influences.d: You come from a simple life in a small town or a remote area that people rarely leave.
influences.full: You come from a simple life in a small town or a remote area that people rarely leave. Whether you came to Angel Grove with your family or on your own for new opportunities, your hard work, wisdom, and ethic brought you to become a chosen member of the Power Rangers. You may have been from a farming, mining, or factory upbringing, or perhaps you had to take a job in a restaurant or shop at an early age to help support your family.

f.line: Small Town Roots: Your wisdom guides you and your hard work pays off. (Core p.69)
f.hangup: Sometimes your simple experiences show with lacking eloquence or understanding of the greater world around you. (Small Town Roots)
f.perkText: Your wisdom guides you and your hard work pays off. Once per session, when making a choice you may ask your GM which option is better for you. The GM must then answer truthfully which of the two is most beneficial to you, if that is at all possible to estimate.
f.hangText: Sometimes your simple experiences show with lacking eloquence or understanding of the greater world around you. When you meet someone new with whom you don’t share an Influence, you suffer a Snag on your first Social Skill Test with them.

influences.d: While it may have begun at a mall dojo or a self defense class, you are defined by your time spent seeking the discipline and culture that martial arts provides.
influences.full: While it may have begun at a mall dojo or a self defense class, you are defined by your time spent seeking the discipline and culture that martial arts provides.

f.line: Martial Artist: Given the opportunity to observe another martial artist for one minute, you can learn information about their capabilities compared to your own. (Core p.70)
f.hangup: You can’t help but be a show-off, and attempts to goad you into action with Social abilities gain an Edge against you. (Martial Artist)
f.perkText: Given the opportunity to observe another martial artist for one minute, you can learn information about their capabilities compared to your own. The GM tells you if the creature is your equal, superior, or inferior in Threat Level as well as Toughness and Evasion Defense.
f.hangText: You can’t help but be a show-off, and attempts to goad you into action with Social abilities gain an Edge against you.

influences.d: You’ve grown up moving around from town to town constantly.
influences.full: You’ve grown up moving around from town to town constantly. Whether a military brat who has lived on not one, but many, military bases, a child of a parent whose job moves often, someone in foster care, or even part of a circus troupe, you’ve traveled to more places before adulthood than most people do in their entire lives. Always moving, you’ve been enrolled in more schools than you can count and have had to make new friends in every new city you visit. As a result, you pick up on body language and personalities, and you can always get a good read on new people. You have the ability to adapt to new situations easily but don’t always know how to rely on people or long-term friendships.

f.line: Nomad: You have a strong ability to read people and their motivations, and due to how fast you have needed to make new friendships, you are a good judge of character. (Core p.70)
f.hangup: You don’t often open up to others because you have learned through the impermanence of your life that it is a waste of time. (Nomad)
f.perkText: You have a strong ability to read people and their motivations, and due to how fast you have needed to make new friendships, you are a good judge of character. You gain an Edge on Social tests when attempting to gain insight into someone’s motives or see if they are lying to you. Additionally, you have an Edge on any Knowledge tests about cities you have lived in.
f.hangText: You don’t often open up to others because you have learned through the impermanence of your life that it is a waste of time. It takes a while for you to trust new people, and you do not believe any stranger on your first encounter with them.

influences.d: Whether an alien from another planet, a traveler from a different temporal era, or perhaps even created in a lab, you did not grow up like normal humans do.
influences.full: Whether an alien from another planet, a traveler from a different temporal era, or perhaps even created in a lab, you did not grow up like normal humans do. This gives you a different outlook on humanity and some distinct opinions of your own culture, but it also means you bring new and fresh concepts or even abilities to your team that an average person would not.

f.line: Not From Around Here: You gain an Edge on Skill Tests outside of combat where your distinct upbringing or unusual background comes into play. (Core p.72)
f.hangup: You suffer a Snag on all Social-based Skill Tests about naturally understanding human beings. (Not From Around Here)
f.perkText: You gain an Edge on Skill Tests outside of combat where your distinct upbringing or unusual background comes into play. You know one additional language.
f.hangText: You suffer a Snag on all Social-based Skill Tests about naturally understanding human beings.

influences.d: You devote your life to study in ways beyond just having a natural general intelligence.
influences.full: You devote your life to study in ways beyond just having a natural general intelligence. While you pride yourself on your academic studies you have focused on a specific subject in which you are an expert. This knowledge may have come from traditional classes, your parents or guardians, a beloved mentor, or a friend. An eager learner, you thrive on knowing all of the answers about your chosen subject and more, and you spend your free time researching facts for fun.

f.line: Student: Your expertise in your study of choice gives you superior knowledge in one subject, allowing you to speak eloquently and thoroughly on the topic. (Core p.72)
f.hangup: Your confidence in your subject of study often causes you to overlook other possibilities and perspectives of information. (Student)
f.perkText: Your expertise in your study of choice gives you superior knowledge in one subject, allowing you to speak eloquently and thoroughly on the topic. You may choose from the list provided or decide on your own choice with your GM’s approval. When attempting to recall facts or performing a task in relation to this subject, you gain Edge on your Skill Test. Additionally, you are recognized within learning institutions related to your study and are welcomed readily with assistance in your further research.
f.hangText: Your confidence in your subject of study often causes you to overlook other possibilities and perspectives of information. When you choose to perform a task in relation to your study to recall information not related to the actual subject at hand, your Skill Test suffers a Snag. Additionally, at the GM’s discretion, your focus on your area of study may mislead you into ignoring evidence of other information that may help you.

influences.d: You’ve escaped a hardship or deadly situation and have both a sense of inner strength and appreciation for life as a result.
influences.full: You’ve escaped a hardship or deadly situation and have both a sense of inner strength and appreciation for life as a result. Some feel that you are more sensitive or frail due to your experience, but you have learned to use the tools you gained to help your determination with everything you face. You may have been forced to live on your own at an early age, survived an accident, escaped extreme financial hardship, or overcome a tragic loss.

f.line: Survivor: After your hardship, you have honed your survival instincts and are able to use sheer willpower to overcome stressful situations. (Core p.75)
f.hangup: The hardships of your life have been traumatic and have left lasting effects in your consciousness. (Survivor)
f.perkText: After your hardship, you have honed your survival instincts and are able to use sheer willpower to overcome stressful situations. When faced with an emergency situation or instinctual choice, gain Edge on a Survival or other related skill Skill Test to know how to best navigate the situation. Additionally, at any point when your Smarts would be lowered to 0, roll a d20. On a result of 10 or above, your Smarts remains at 1.
f.hangText: The hardships of your life have been traumatic and have left lasting effects in your consciousness. This may cause you to stumble over your words or freeze like a deer in headlights. While in the presence of the reminder of your survival experience, you are unable to focus on anything else and suffer a Snag on all Alertness checks.

influences.d: Teachers come in all ages and love to share their passion for whatever they teach.
influences.full: Teachers come in all ages and love to share their passion for whatever they teach. As a teacher, you strive to inspire others to learn all that they can. You may have been a professor at a college, a T.A. at your high school, an extra-curricular activities instructor, or a tutor for fellow students.

f.line: Teacher: Your passion for passing on knowledge to others allows you to inspire them to achieve greatness. (Core p.76)
f.hangup: You cannot resist a teaching moment, and insist on showing others how it is done before allowing them to try on their own. (Teacher)
f.perkText: Your passion for passing on knowledge to others allows you to inspire them to achieve greatness. When you Lend Assistance to an ally for a noncombat Skill Test, they gain both ↑1 and Edge.
f.hangText: You cannot resist a teaching moment, and insist on showing others how it is done before allowing them to try on their own. In any non-combat situation in which you have a higher skill die than a team member, you will force yourself into doing the task first, even if strategically or socially unsound.

influences.d: You gave a portion of your life to an organized agency.
influences.full: You gave a portion of your life to an organized agency. Government, peacekeeping forces, religious groups, corporations, unions, and the like all need people to carry out their agendas. You were employed by and devoted to one of these agencies, and while it taught you a lot about their laws and methodologies, it also painted you with the same brush as all the other agents that came before you. When you select this Influence, choose the agency that shaped your character through its tenets, codes, and benefits, as well as related skills. Some good examples in the Power Rangers universe are the Angel Grove Police Department, Space Patrol Delta, NASADA, the Silver Guardians, and the Huntsman Network.

f.line: Agency: You gain Edge on the Skill associated with your agency, representing your additional training in that field to function as their agent. (Across the Stars p.42)
f.hangup: Whether or not you are still attached to your agency, your time as part of it defines your past. (Agency)
f.perkText: You gain Edge on the Skill associated with your agency, representing your additional training in that field to function as their agent. Additionally, due to the access to resources you have or had through the agency, your Wealth Tests may never use a die of a lesser value than the Skill Rank of your agency’s Skill.
f.hangText: Whether or not you are still attached to your agency, your time as part of it defines your past. Your agency friends, allies, and colleagues left their mark on your training, methods, and beliefs. When you Fumble in your agency’s Skill, you do not generate a Story Point as you normally would, as self-doubt haunts you.

influences.d: Someone (or something) subjected you to a series of invasive bodily augmentations.
influences.full: Someone (or something) subjected you to a series of invasive bodily augmentations. Whether you were pumped full of chemical stimulants, had parts of your body replaced with artificial ones, or had your very genetic structure modified through the mysteries of super-science, you came out of the process different from before. When you choose this Influence, work with your Game Master to decide how you became augmented. Are you the only example of the process’s success? Do you owe some group or individual for what they did to you? Is the augmentation readily visible, making you stand out among others of your kind? Are you even aware something happened to you at all? We encourage you and your GM to build a narrative based on how this happened to your character.

f.line: Augmented: Your augments and enhancements grant you a bonus in one of three aspects. (Across the Stars p.43)
f.hangup: The processes that augmented you had some unexpected side-effects that weakened you to certain substances, wavelengths, energy, or other stimuli. (Augmented)
f.perkText: Your augments and enhancements grant you a bonus in one of three aspects. You may increase your Health by 1, gain a +1 to any one of your Defenses, or choose a Skill to gain a constant ↑1 when using it.
f.hangText: The processes that augmented you had some unexpected side-effects that weakened you to certain substances, wavelengths, energy, or other stimuli. Choose one damage type from the list on pages 170–171 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. You halve your Defenses (rounding up) when targeted by attacks or other effects that inflict that type of damage on you. Unlike other Influences, you may choose Augmented multiple times, but you must choose a different Influence Perk benefit and Hang-Up type each time.

influences.d: A destiny, prophecy, or fated moment shapes your future, whether you like it or not.
influences.full: A destiny, prophecy, or fated moment shapes your future, whether you like it or not. Even though you make your own choices and decisions in life, fate pulls strings to put you on the path of your destiny. You aren’t alone, either: some people know of this destiny and either stand for its accomplishment or want to see it crushed. These people may know your destiny as foretold but not necessarily what part you play. What your destiny entails depends on your place in time and space, how actively you plan to participate in it, and the needs of your game’s narrative arc. This Influence interacts with the narrative arc and requires the GM to work with you on how exactly your character’s destiny will become part of the overall story. While ultimately necessary for your character, fulfilling your destiny might not be the primary goal of the campaign, merely the reason you are involved with it. CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS

f.line: Destiny: The forces of fate somehow direct and possibly protect you, helping shape your outcomes to better serve your greater destiny. (Across the Stars p.44)
f.hangup: Being a part of a greater destiny isn’t all boon and benefit; it has many costs that come in many forms. (Destiny)
f.perkText: The forces of fate somehow direct and possibly protect you, helping shape your outcomes to better serve your greater destiny. Fate’s fetters are reflected through a strange propensity toward things “just working out better” than they might have otherwise. Anytime you make a Skill Test, and the result on your d20 is a lower value than the maximum that could be rolled on your smallest Skill die, you may re-roll the d20, but you must accept the second result.
f.hangText: Being a part of a greater destiny isn’t all boon and benefit; it has many costs that come in many forms. Just as there are facets that predispose you toward victory and success, there are instances where fate needs you to fail in order to fulfill your destiny. Representing this occasional flux in your destined role, when you screw something up, you sometimes do so in a big way. Once per scene, the GM can spend 1 Story Point to turn a regular failure of yours on a Skill Test into a Fumble.

influences.d: You swore fealty and service to a greater ideal and loyally follow tenets associated with something greater than yourself.
influences.full: You swore fealty and service to a greater ideal and loyally follow tenets associated with something greater than yourself. Upholding your word and oath strengthens your resolve and helps you find the perseverance to push through hardship and conflict. Unlike a simple promise to serve, your oath holds legal or moral weight with you and the recipient of your servitude. You swore to serve a specific code of ethics or actions, and it’s an integral part of you whether you like it or not. Even if you walked away from your oathbound duties, many of the aptitudes and ideals you relied upon within its service are at the core of your character.

f.line: Oathbound: Your loyal service to the holder of your oath taught you a special brand of dedication and devotion. (Across the Stars p.46)
f.hangup: By swearing your allegiance and service to another, you willingly take on their enemies and hardships. (Oathbound)
f.perkText: Your loyal service to the holder of your oath taught you a special brand of dedication and devotion. By staying in line with your sworn words, you draw strength of purpose that can sharpen your focus, redouble your efforts, and help overcome adversity. As long as you are acting in line with the concept of your oath, you can re-roll any single Skill die result of a natural 1 but must take the second result (the d20 is not a Skill die, you may re-roll the die or dice according to your Skill Rank).
f.hangText: By swearing your allegiance and service to another, you willingly take on their enemies and hardships. These challenges may be in the form of unexpected enemies, stalwart rivals, challenges within your oath, or worse, based upon your GM’s discretion. In general, this often means that if your oath attracts enemies, these become your team’s enemies, too. Additionally, when you act contrary to your oath, you suffer ↓1 on Smartsand Social-based Skill Tests.

influences.d: You are a verified member of a royal group.
influences.full: You are a verified member of a royal group. Whether based upon your bloodline, a social arrangement such as marriage, or an earned position like a lordship granted through military service, you are part of a higher-class socio-political sect. You may or may not strongly believe in your royal values, but others do: your position is being watched, judged, and probably coveted, perhaps by your closest fellows and family members.

f.line: Royalty: Your training and focus on cooperative efforts and teamwork on a vessel shine in your skillset. (Across the Stars p.47)
f.hangup: No matter how far removed from the throne, the crown, or the top of the pyramid you are in the royal line of succession, someone is waiting to make the most of your public failures. (Royalty)
f.perkText: Your training and focus on cooperative efforts and teamwork on a vessel shine in your skillset. While aboard a familiar ship, you gain Edge on all Driving and Technology Skill Tests with that vehicle. Additionally, while on the vessel, you can offer aid to your crewmates and Lend Assistance even if you are unskilled in the Skill in question. D12 BACKGROUND BOND 1 I love being part of a crew, and I consider my crew to be my family. 2 I secretly wanted to have a ship of my own, and my past is a constant reminder that I never really made it that far. 3 I take orders well enough, but not without giving a little lip or back-talk in response. 4 My duties as part of a greater crew are ultimately important to my self-esteem, and I take it extremely personally when the ship suffers any kind of setback. 5 I lost a close friend while following orders on that ship, and I’ve never quite forgiven the commander who ordered us into that situation. 6 I served on multiple ships, not because I wanted to, but because crewmates on board every vessel saw me as a bad luck charm. 7 I have many great stories to tell from my days on the ship’s crew, and anyone willing to listen to me becomes my new best friend for the moment. 8 My first ship was lost in a scandalous journey, and I was fortunate to survive. I avoid discussing it because I can’t remember what happened. 9 I delight in helping the ship’s commanding officers and often serve as the go-between for those in charge and the rest of the crew. 10
f.hangText: No matter how far removed from the throne, the crown, or the top of the pyramid you are in the royal line of succession, someone is waiting to make the most of your public failures. Rumors, gossip, and social media follow every public action you take. When you Fumble a Skill Test in public, the pressure of creating a scandal or misrepresenting your family imposes ↓1 on all Social Skill Tests. This penalty lasts until you get a Critical Success on any Skill Test, thus restoring your self-confidence and standing. D12 BACKGROUND BOND 1 I take great pride in my royal family connections, (over)sharing information about them with my friends. 2 I have no problem using my royalty, or at least the perceived power behind it, as a tool to get what I want in certain circumstances. 3 My parents are far more interested in my following in their footsteps than I am, and it often places them in the wrong places at the worst times. 4 Most people don’t know about my royal background, except those who might be too eager to get me to lean into it more. 5 I uphold the family traditions with a stiff upper lip and maintain my family’s reputation. 6 I don’t care much for my royal brethren, but I see no problem using my connection to them to get my way here and there. 7 My royal background helped me to overcome a significant obstacle in my youth, so I hold it with a higher modicum of respect. 8 I can see the path to a position of power within the family. All I must do is focus time and effort on climb

influences.d: You have served time as a member of a vessel’s crew, such as by sailing the vast blue seas, skimming along the dunes of an immense windblown desert, CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER…
influences.full: You have served time as a member of a vessel’s crew, such as by sailing the vast blue seas, skimming along the dunes of an immense windblown desert, CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS

f.hangup: Following orders and chain of command were so important on ships you served on that you sometimes find it challenging to operate on your own or against the wishes of a supervisor or commanding… (Ship’s Crew)
f.hangText: Following orders and chain of command were so important on ships you served on that you sometimes find it challenging to operate on your own or against the wishes of a supervisor or commanding officer. Whenever you directly violate orders, commands, or stipulations issued by a superior in your chain of command, you suffer ↓1 on non-Combat Skill Tests for the remainder of the scene.

influences.d: You’ve spent your life dedicated to the cause of uncovering the secrets of the past.
influences.full: You’ve spent your life dedicated to the cause of uncovering the secrets of the past. You may have specialized in historical archaeology or paleontology, or performed hands-on work to uncover ancient sites and recover lost artifacts—or even something completely else entirely. Whatever your specialization, you have learned a lot about not only the past but also about putting together seemingly unrelated clues and making sense of them all. When you select this Influence, work with the Game Master to decide which field you specialize in, so they may work it into the campaign. Perhaps your paleontology studies allow you to deduce hints about the dinosaur-like threats you’re facing, or your field of archaeology comes in handy when you’re exploring the old ruins where your next big challenge awaits you.

f.line: Archaeologist: Your breadth of knowledge and ability to sort out clues based on limited information gives you a leg up when working in certain fields. (Beneath the Helmet p.32)
f.hangup: You get frustrated whenever someone doesn’t understand your arguments and conclusions. (Archaeologist)
f.perkText: Your breadth of knowledge and ability to sort out clues based on limited information gives you a leg up when working in certain fields. When a situation arises where your field of study could be related to the case at hand, you gain ↑1 on Culture and Science Skill Tests.
f.hangText: You get frustrated whenever someone doesn’t understand your arguments and conclusions. You suffer ↓1 on any Social-based Skill Tests whenever dealing with someone who isn’t interested in the past.

influences.d: People aren’t born good or bad but become so through their actions.
influences.full: People aren’t born good or bad but become so through their actions. And your actions led you to be bad or evil. Eventually, you realized that past actions did not have to dictate your future, and you redeemed yourself. You have an insight into the kind of life you led, and the person you were, giving you a perspective others do not have. You can appreciate situations from multiple sides and make an excellent undercover agent. Sometimes you wonder, though: Was this the right call?

f.line: Checkered Past: You have experience sneaking in and acquiring things that aren’t yours. (Beneath the Helmet p.32)
f.hangup: Because you were once a villain, people are never entirely sure if you can be trusted now, and many question your motives. (Checkered Past)
f.perkText: You have experience sneaking in and acquiring things that aren’t yours. You gain Edge on Smarts Skill Tests when looking for weaknesses, flaws in security, or hidden items.
f.hangText: Because you were once a villain, people are never entirely sure if you can be trusted now, and many question your motives. Did you really redeem yourself from your wicked ways, or are you just hiding it below the surface? You suffer Snag on Social Skill Tests with authority figures and people who’ve heard of your previous reputation.

influences.d: Something about you was always attracted to the limelight, though you were never quite sure what.
influences.full: Something about you was always attracted to the limelight, though you were never quite sure what. You thrive when performing in front of a crowd. You feed off their emotions, and you like nothing more than having someone acknowledge your skill. You use the insight you’ve gained into an audience and know how to manipulate a crowd. What’s more, you enjoy doing so and bringing joy to others is a feeling you cherish.

f.line: Crowdpleaser: You feed off of the crowd as you perform, finding delight in all eyes on you. (Beneath the Helmet p.33)
f.hangup: Your art means so much to you that you have trouble connecting to people in other ways. (Crowdpleaser)
f.perkText: You feed off of the crowd as you perform, finding delight in all eyes on you. You gain ↑1 on Performance Skill Tests if 10 or more creatures are present and observing you. You gain an additional ↑1 if 100 or more creatures are present and observing you, and another ↑1 if 1,000 or more creatures are present and observing you.
f.hangText: Your art means so much to you that you have trouble connecting to people in other ways. You suffer Snag on your first non-Performance Skill Test each day.

influences.d: Your life was all planned out.
influences.full: Your life was all planned out. You had everything. And then fate threw you a curveball, and everything you knew changed. For most people, life is a series of events and actions that affect who they are and who they become, but your life is defined by a single event that impacted you, far beyond those experienced by others. Perhaps you saw something you shouldn’t have or lost someone important to you, but whatever it was, you still seek the truth behind that event.

f.line: Life Interrupted: Your single-mindedness has proven to be an advantage. (Beneath the Helmet p.34)
f.hangup: Your single-mindedness causes you to lose a sense of urgency, and changing your perspective to think short-term is almost impossible. (Life Interrupted)
f.perkText: Your single-mindedness has proven to be an advantage. You can always focus on the task at hand as if everything depended on it. Persistence is the key to accomplishing your goals. You gain ↑1 on all Skill Tests that require a sustained effort.
f.hangText: Your single-mindedness causes you to lose a sense of urgency, and changing your perspective to think short-term is almost impossible. You favor thought and research over emotion and action, and as a result, you sustain ↓1 on any Skill Tests that are short-term, outside of combat, or other dangerous situations.

influences.d: You’ve tried the solo act before, sometimes with some success, but it’s been a long and challenging path.
influences.full: You’ve tried the solo act before, sometimes with some success, but it’s been a long and challenging path. You work best with someone else to bounce ideas (and bad guys) off of, and you always shine better when you’re not alone. Your true potential is drawn out when you synergize with someone else, bringing out the best in each other.

f.line: Better Together: You synchronize with a chosen ally when you take this Influence. (Shattered Grid p.18)
f.hangup: You are strongest when you and your chosen ally are together. (Better Together)
f.perkText: You synchronize with a chosen ally when you take this Influence. Whenever you or your chosen ally Lend Assistance to one another for any Skill Test, you both gain ↑1 and an Edge until the end of your next turn.
f.hangText: You are strongest when you and your chosen ally are together. In any situation where you and your chosen ally are not in a scene together, you suffer ↓1 on any Skill Test until you are reunited.

influences.d: You’ve been exposed to the existence of the multiverse.
influences.full: You’ve been exposed to the existence of the multiverse. Whether through someone revealing the secrets to you or because you have physically ventured beyond the bonds of your universe, you have learned the Morphin Grid connects not just to your reality but to infinite others. Some of these realities are eerily similar to your own, with but a few minor differences, while others are unimaginably different. This new knowledge has radically shaped how you view your own world and perhaps your place in it. There are incredible things to learn from other realities, but you’re also aware of dangers that may threaten your home across dimensions. How you use this information is up to you, but you know the stakes are much higher than your corner of existence.

f.line: Through the Shattered Grid: You are aware of multiversal phenomena and threats, so have prepared yourself accordingly should they ever appear in your neck of the woods. (Shattered Grid p.18)
f.hangup: Others have difficulty understanding the multiverse to the extent you do, and you often have trouble explaining the nature of the multiverse and its dangers. (Through the Shattered Grid)
f.perkText: You are aware of multiversal phenomena and threats, so have prepared yourself accordingly should they ever appear in your neck of the woods. When facing something outside your dimension, you gain an Edge on Smarts Skill Tests to identify it and determine weaknesses.
f.hangText: Others have difficulty understanding the multiverse to the extent you do, and you often have trouble explaining the nature of the multiverse and its dangers. You suffer a Snag on Social Skill Tests when explaining alternate realities and related phenomena to those who haven’t been exposed.

influences.d: You’re an Eltarian Observer, or a former one, sent by the Guardians to observe and report on a planet’s possible entry as part of the protectorate.
influences.full: You’re an Eltarian Observer, or a former one, sent by the Guardians to observe and report on a planet’s possible entry as part of the protectorate. This is not an infiltration but rather a cultural submergence, granting you a unique perspective on humanity and other species. Your technological expertise, fighting capabilities, and knowledge about intergalactic politics are a noteworthy asset to your team.

f.line: Eltarian Observer: Choose a Skill among Culture, Survival, and Technology. (Shattered Grid p.69)
f.hangup: Due to the longevity of your mission, you inevitably develop an attachment to the planet and its people. (Eltarian Observer)
f.perkText: Choose a Skill among Culture, Survival, and Technology. You gain an Edge on Skill Tests with the chosen Skill while on alien worlds as you learn of their civilization, history, and capabilities. You know one additional Language.
f.hangText: Due to the longevity of your mission, you inevitably develop an attachment to the planet and its people. Whenever something threatens or harms a connection or relationship you developed during your observation, it gains an Edge against you.

influences.d: You’ve been brought back from the brink of death or even beyond the boundaries of life and death itself.
influences.full: You’ve been brought back from the brink of death or even beyond the boundaries of life and death itself. The experience has left a stain on your very being, whether physically, mentally, or both. These unforeseen effects weigh heavily on you, and you try not to have your team worry about you, but there’s something different that they can’t ignore. The process that brought you back to your friends also affected your memories, possibly even your awareness of how you came back and why. You might even possess secret knowledge or capabilities you didn’t have before.

f.line: The Returned: Your return has changed you, and while you’re not quite the same as before, there are some familiarities to your interactions and recollection. (Shattered Grid p.112)
f.hangup: There’s an air of uncertainty that hangs over you. (The Returned)
f.perkText: Your return has changed you, and while you’re not quite the same as before, there are some familiarities to your interactions and recollection. Once per session, choose a Skill. You gain an Edge on Skill Tests with that Skills when you call upon memories to aid you. You and your GM may develop details on those memories.
f.hangText: There’s an air of uncertainty that hangs over you. Are you still you? Or have the changes made you so different that you’re not so sure of the path forward? You suffer a Snag on all Social-based Skill Tests about your past before you left, how you returned, and thoughts regarding your future. You may also suffer a Snag on Smarts-based Skill Tests about information from your time you were gone.

influences.d: You have spent a long time disguised as one of the enemy, learning their ways to gain advantage over them in the future.
influences.full: You have spent a long time disguised as one of the enemy, learning their ways to gain advantage over them in the future. No one understands how they work, how they interact, and, hopefully, how to best achieve victory over them better than you. Even if the enemy figures out who you really are and you can’t manage to talk your way out of things, everything you have learned could mean the difference between a tragic failure and a legendary win. When you choose this Influence, you must decide exactly who you’ve been or are infiltrating. The GM can help you figure out who is involved in your charade, and to what degree you’ve fooled them. You should decide your secret identity within them and what kinds of activities you have been involved with that ultimately sealed your position as one of them. WHERE THERE IS GOOD, THERE IS ALSO EVIL. POWER RANGERS MEDIA HAS SHOWN THE MANY FACETS OF VILLAINY THROUGHOUT THE MULTIVERSE. SOMETIMES, THOSE FIGURES MOVE UNERRINGLY TOWARD THEIR EVIL GOALS AND OTHER TIMES THEY BATTLE THROUGH THEIR WORST IMPULSES AND TOUGH TIMES TO FIND THEIR WAY TO A PLACE OF GOODNESS… OR AT LEAST SOMEWHERE IN BETWEEN. Knowing Where to Draw the Line Choosing to roleplay as a villainous or anti-heroic character in an Essence20 game can be a lot of fun, but when you choose to do so, you should understand where the lines are drawn at your game table. Before starting a campaign with potentially evil characters (even reformed villains), GMs and players should review the Roles, Perks, and powers of these potential characters discuss what everyone is comfortable with as part of your session zero, as mentioned in The Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook on pg. 224. Players may easily fall into a trap of trying to outdo one another with shocking acts of villainy, which could make other players uncomfortable and derail the narrative. Roleplaying games are supposed to be fun, and adjustments and limits can help keep the game fun for everyone. Work with your group to define the limits so everyone can lean into the right type of villainy for the group and story just as you would with other sensitive topics at the game table. Basically, be careful when bringing villainy to your table. PLAYING WITH THE BAD GUYS PLAYING WITH THE BAD GUYS

Grid Powers Gained through experience levels in a Power Ranger’s Spectrum Role, Grid Powers are unique abilities and modifiers that are chosen by the player to better suit their style and responsibilities of their character. Whenever a Grid Power is gained, it becomes immediately effective and any actions it might allow become immediately available. Unless stated otherwise, a character may only choose any given Grid Power once.
