perks.d: Needs 12th Level or higher. You’ve invested Solar crystal pieces into your Morpher, flooding you with raw Grid energy when you activate it.
perks.full: Prerequisite: 12th Level or higher You’ve invested Solar crystal pieces into your Morpher, flooding you with raw Grid energy when you activate it. This flood of energy turns you into one of the legendary Solar Rangers! You can spend 1 Personal Power when activating “It’s Morphin Time!” to unlock your Solar Ranger Power. While in your Solar Ranger form, the following are true: CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS • You gain Edge on Alertness Skill Tests to see through illusions and trickery and to notice signs of creatures from the Void. • You gain Resistance to Cold and Energy damage. • Your standard Targeting-based weapon (Blade Blaster, Turbo Blaster, or the like) becomes the Solar Energy version and inflicts 1 additional Fire damage. • Your Power Weapon deals 1 additional damage, and you may change its damage to an Elemental damage type of your choice. You cannot benefit from this and another Form General Perk simultaneously.

perks.d: Needs Athletics (Spacewalk) at +d4 or higher. You are a practiced expert at moving around in low or no gravity without any craft, taking full advantage of increased mobility and the lack of resistance offered in zero-G.
perks.full: Prerequisite: Athletics (Spacewalk) at +d4 or higher You are a practiced expert at moving around in low or no gravity without any craft, taking full advantage of increased mobility and the lack of resistance offered in zero-G. While operating as an individual in a lowor zero-gravity environment, you have Edge on all Athletics and Acrobatics Skill Tests. You gain ↑1 on all other Skill Tests in zero-G. While operating as an individual in a lowor zero-gravity environment, you gain +5 to your Evasion Defense.

perks.d: Needs must not have been previously declared a criminal by S.P.D. After searching through their extensive files on Power Rangers from all over the universe, Space Patrol Delta has decided to make you an asset of their mission, awarding you a…
perks.full: Prerequisite: must not have been previously declared a criminal by S.P.D. After searching through their extensive files on Power Rangers from all over the universe, Space Patrol Delta has decided to make you an asset of their mission, awarding you a benefit reserved for S.P.D. agents. You may choose this Perk multiple times, choosing a different asset below each time. When you select this Perk, the S.P.D. awards you access to one of the following: • A set of five Delta Blasters • DeltaMax Striker • Delta Patrol Cycle • R.I.C. (Robotic Interactive Canine) • Confiscated Xenotech (one Limited item, per GM’s approval) S.P.D. assets start on page 84.

perks.d: Needs maximum Personal Power 3 or higher. The Champions of the Grid have chosen you to bear the mantle of a Supersonic Ranger, a oncelegendary team of frontier warriors specializing in alien interaction.
perks.full: Prerequisite: maximum Personal Power 3 or higher The Champions of the Grid have chosen you to bear the mantle of a Supersonic Ranger, a oncelegendary team of frontier warriors specializing in alien interaction. You can spend 1 Personal Power when activating “It’s Morphin Time!” to “Go Supersonic!” and gain the following benefits. • You gain ↑1 on all Athletics and Acrobatics Skill Tests. • All of your unarmed Attacks may inflict Energy damage. • Your Blade Blaster inflicts Sonic damage. • You suffer no penalties for using Xenotech of any kind. • Your Morphed shell automatically contains a Gridwide Communicator (see page 84). You cannot benefit from this and another Form General Perk simultaneously.

perks.d: Needs 5th Level or higher. By supercharging your Morpher with Turbo power, you have turned into a Turbo Ranger!
perks.full: Prerequisite: 5th Level or higher By supercharging your Morpher with Turbo power, you have turned into a Turbo Ranger! You can spend 1 Personal Power when activating “It’s Morphin Time!” to become Turbocharged. • You gain Edge on all Driving Skill Tests. • You may spend 1 Personal Power to summon a Turbo Cart (see page 129 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook) of your Ranger Spectrum color. • Replace your Blade Blaster with an Auto Blaster and Turbo Blade (see page 76). • Replace your Power Weapon with a Targetingbased Turbo Weapon (see page 78). You cannot have this and another Form General Perk active at the same time.

perks.d: Needs not originally from the setting’s specific planet/culture. You studied a great deal about the people and cultures of one faraway place alien to your home world to gain the following benefits.
perks.full: Prerequisite: not originally from the setting’s specific planet/culture You studied a great deal about the people and cultures of one faraway place alien to your home world to gain the following benefits. • You gain Edge on Culture Skill Tests about people of the chosen location. • You gain Edge on Animal Handling, Deception, Insight, Persuasion, and Survival Skill Tests when in the chosen location or interacting with people from it. • Gain fluency in one Language commonly used in the chosen location.

perks.d: Needs Zord Role Perk and at least one instance of the Zord Feature Role Perk. The Morphin Grid has altered your Zord to meet your needs in battle.
perks.full: Prerequisite: Zord Role Perk and at least one instance of the Zord Feature Role Perk The Morphin Grid has altered your Zord to meet your needs in battle. Each time you choose this Perk, select one of the following Zord alterations. • Add 2 to the Strength or Speed Essence of your Zord, or 1 to both, choosing an equal number of Skill Ranks to increase accordingly. • Increase the Zord’s Size Class by one category and gain +1 Health. • Decrease the Zord’s Size Class by one category (minimum of Huge), and add 10 feet to all its Movement types. • Grant the Zord Resistance to one damage Element. • Add the following Critical Effect to one of the Zord’s Attacks: “Deal 1 extra damage.” When you choose this alteration, pick the damage type for this Critical Effect. New Grid Powers The following Grid Powers are accessible to all Power Rangers Roleplaying Game characters.

perks.d: Needs 5th level or higher, GM Approval. You are the guardian and custodian of a Battlizer, a treasured Ranger relic.
perks.full: Prerequisite: 5th level or higher, GM Approval You are the guardian and custodian of a Battlizer, a treasured Ranger relic. You can tap into the Morphin Grid to summon it when you need its aid. When you choose this Perk, select a Battlizer from the section beginning on page 87. While Morphed, you may spend the chosen Battlizer’s Power Cost to summon and use it. You may choose this Perk multiple times but must choose a different Battlizer each time.

f.line: Battlizer Access (Specific Battlizer) (Beneath the Helmet p.50)

perks.d: Whether taught to you or self-imposed, you follow a code of honor and courtesy that is evident to whomever you meet.
perks.full: Whether taught to you or self-imposed, you follow a code of honor and courtesy that is evident to whomever you meet. Most are charmed by your grace; a few try to take advantage. You gain the following benefits: • You gain ↑2 on Persuasion (Diplomacy) Skill Tests. • Add an additional Story Point to your team’s pool each game session. • Once per day, you may act as though specialized in any Social Skill for one Skill Test.

perks.d: You were either born noble or raised in an environment that afforded you more benefits than the average person.
perks.full: You were either born noble or raised in an environment that afforded you more benefits than the average person. You gain the following benefits: • Gain an Edge on Social Skill Tests against someone who feels that your status could negatively impact them. • Spend a Story Point to gain a temporary ally for the rest of the game session. This ally is awed by you and performs any reasonable requests so that they may hang around you but won’t put themselves in danger for you. • Once per game session, you may gain access to a person or area normally barred to you by virtue of your privilege.

perks.d: You have a fascination with puzzles and this helps you put clues together more easily than others.
perks.full: You have a fascination with puzzles and this helps you put clues together more easily than others. You gain the following benefits: • Gain ↑1 on Alertness (Investigation) Skill Tests that directly involve resolving the current adventure. • Add an additional Story Point to your team’s pool each game session. • You may spend a Story Point to see the connections between parts of a puzzle even if you don’t know how they fit together yet. When you do so, the GM points out people or items in the current scene related to the mystery. If the scene has no connections to your current puzzle, you regain the spent Story Point.

perks.d: Needs You must come from a different time period. You have spent enough time in the present period to have grown used to its quirks and foibles.
perks.full: Prerequisite: You must come from a different time period. You have spent enough time in the present period to have grown used to its quirks and foibles. While you still feel like an outsider, most people observing you wouldn’t notice your unfamiliarity. You gain the following benefits: • You can use everyday technological items without penalty, although you may still take Snag or be unable to operate complex electronics or machinery. • You gain fluency in 1 language of your choice (usually the commonly spoken one in your new home region). • Your time-displaced quirks are endearing to others. You enjoy Edge on Social Skill Tests the first time you meet someone in this time period.

perks.d: Needs Social 3 or higher Not only are you good at keeping secrets, but you are also good at getting others to trust you despite keeping those secrets. You gain the following benefits: • You gain Edge on Deception (Bluffing) Skill Tests when convincing someone that they can set aside your secret for the time being.
perks.full: Prerequisite: Social 3 or higher Not only are you good at keeping secrets, but you are also good at getting others to trust you despite keeping those secrets. You gain the following benefits: • You gain Edge on Deception (Bluffing) Skill Tests when convincing someone that they can set aside your secret for the time being. • You gain a +2 bonus to your Cleverness Defense. Form Perks The Perks listed here enable a Power Ranger to modify the form of their spectrum or, in some cases, their unmorphed form. These Perks require you to choose a form when activating the “It’s Morphin Time!” role Perk. You may only benefit from one Form Perk each time you use “It’s Morphin Time!” You cannot change your Form until you use “It’s Morphin Time!” again. Ninja Power from the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook counts as a Form Perk and does not combine with any other Form Perks.

perks.d: In Coral Harbor, California, scientists discover a way to create a physical substance from the Morphin Grid known as Morph-X.
perks.full: In Coral Harbor, California, scientists discover a way to create a physical substance from the Morphin Grid known as Morph-X. Morph-X quickly becomes a universal clean fuel source and, in the hands of a scientist who was a child prodigy, a catalyst for combining DNA from animals to humans, creating the Beast Morpher Power Rangers. The Beast Morpher Form is connected to It’s Morphin Time! The form grants animal-specific power to the Power Ranger but also imposes a hang-up that is related to the animal DNA incorporated in their system. Note that while this form is called “beast morpher,” it is possible to combine DNA with birds, insects, and other nonbeast creatures. WHO WEARS THE HELMET WHO WEARS THE HELMET When you select this Perk, choose from the list below to get your exact abilities. You may only have one beast morpher animal embedded into your DNA at a time (well, maybe not, but trying to integrate a second animal’s DNA is likely to have negative consequences!). CHEETAH Infused with cheetah DNA, you can run at incredible speeds. Unfortunately, your feline DNA causes you to freeze up whenever you are in the presence of dogs, a common occurrence in the city. When Morphed, you gain the following benefits and Hang-Up: • You move at incredible speeds. Your Ground movement increases by 20 feet. While running, you can move across walls as if they were ground terrain. If you end your turn on a vertical surface, you fall. • As a Standard action, you can run around a creature and create a vortex. The victim must make a Strength (Athletics) Skill Test with Snag against your Speed Essence score. If the roll fails, then the victim is thrown 10 feet into the air and knocked prone. • Hang-up: You tend to freeze when in the presence of a dog. When you encounter a dog (or similar creature, such as a wolf or Sirian alien) for the first time in a scene, you must make a DIF 10 basic d20 roll or be stunned until the end of your turn. GORILLA Infused with gorilla DNA, you are much stronger than normal. Unfortunately, your gorilla DNA often causes you to go berserk, threatening both friend and foe. When Morphed, you gain the following benefits and Hang-Up: • You can summon incredible strength and durability. You gain ↑2 on Brawn Skill Tests and calculations to determine the amount of weight you can carry, push, or drag, and add 2 to your Health. • Hang-up: The heat of battle

perks.d: Dino Thunder Form Perks are unique in that you can activate them in your non-Morphed form in addition to when Morphed.
perks.full: Dino Thunder Form Perks are unique in that you can activate them in your non-Morphed form in addition to when Morphed. When you select this Perk, you gain one of the powers listed below. You can spend 1 Personal Power to gain the listed power’s benefit. AURA READING As a Free action, you can spend 1 Personal Power to sense the auras of anyone or anything within 60 feet without touching them. You have an Edge on your Alertness (Perception) Skill Tests, and any type of disguise or invisibility has no effect on your test. The psychometry ends at the end of your next turn after activating it. CAMOUFLAGE You can spend 1 Personal Power to camouflage yourself for up to 1 minute. You aren’t completely invisible, but creatures attempting to notice you suffer Snag on Alertness (Perception) Skill Tests to notice you. Unlike Invisibility, if you take damage or make an attack while camouflaged, you do not lose the camouflage. INVISIBILITY You can spend 1 Personal Power to turn invisible for up to 10 minutes. No one can see you, and creatures making Alertness (Perception) Skill Tests notice you have a Snag on their roll. If you take damage while invisible, then your invisibility ends. Your invisibility also ends after you make an attack. INTANGIBILITY You can spend 1 Personal Power to become intangible until the start of your next turn. During this time, nothing can harm you and you can move through solid objects. You must end your move in an open area, or you take damage, and possibly lose body parts, from being partially or fully embedded in a solid object (at the Game Master’s discretion, you can spend a Story Point to avoid that gruesome fate! MIND READING You can spend 1 Personal Power to read thoughts. Generally, these are only surface thoughts, granting you Edge on Alertness (Insight) Skill Tests. At times, you can scan a little deeper, but this only works when the Game Master chooses to provide you with more information. PSYCHOMETRY You can learn valuable clues about the past by touching items. As a Free action, you can spend 1 Personal Power when you touch an object to learn who or what used it in the past, similar to a clue you might get from spending a Story Point. Work with your GM on how your character experiences these feelings, ranging from learning strong emotions associated with the object to full visions of the past. WHO WEARS THE HELMET WHO WEARS THE HE

perks.d: Needs Membership in Wind Ninja Academy or similar organization As a graduate of the Wind Ninja Academy, you have been given the training to harness the power of the wind and the amulets necessary to tap into an elemental force. When you first take this Perk, you must choose which element is connected to you. You can spend 1 Personal Power in conjunction with your “It’s Morphin Time!” Spectrum Role Feature to activate your Ninja Storm power.
perks.full: Prerequisite: Membership in Wind Ninja Academy or similar organization As a graduate of the Wind Ninja Academy, you have been given the training to harness the power of the wind and the amulets necessary to tap into an elemental force. When you first take this Perk, you must choose which element is connected to you. You can spend 1 Personal Power in conjunction with your “It’s Morphin Time!” Spectrum Role Feature to activate your Ninja Storm power. While Morphed with Ninja Storm Wind Ranger Power, the following is true: • Your Ground Movement is doubled. This includes jumping. • You gain ↑1 on Infiltration (Stealth) Skill Tests. • Any attempts to control your mind suffer Snag. • Your chosen element gives you additional abilities, as noted below. Activating your element requires an extra 1 Personal Power and lasts for 3 rounds. AIR The air element grants you the following additional benefits: • Aerial movement: While you don’t technically fly, you may move over the ground about 3 feet in the air, avoiding most Rough Terrain and only touching the ground at the end of your movement. • Air Blast: As a Standard action, you can hurl a gust of wind at an opponent. Choose a creature within 30 feet and make a Targeting (Energy) Skill Test against their Toughness. If you hit, the creature is knocked prone. EARTH The earth element grants you the following additional benefits: • Burrowing: You can move through natural earth or rock as easily as if you were walking or running. Your power subtly shifts the material that you travel through so it is left intact after you pass through it. • Duplication: As a Standard action, you can split your body into two separate fighters, but this reduces the Health of both you and your duplicate by 1. Each of you may act independently and you merge when the time is up, taking the lower WHO WEARS THE HELMET WHO WEARS THE HELMET

f.line: Ninja Storm Wind Ranger [Form] (Beneath the Helmet p.55)

perks.d: Your Power Morpher has been modified by Dr. K, making its connection to the Morphin Grid much more stable.
perks.full: Your Power Morpher has been modified by Dr. K, making its connection to the Morphin Grid much more stable. Attacks that would make you lose Personal Power or make you unable to spend it suffer ↓2 when targeting you.

f.line: Dr. K’s Modified Morpher (Shattered Grid p.25)

perks.d: There is something in your past you don’t talk about and try to hide from others.
perks.full: There is something in your past you don’t talk about and try to hide from others. Perhaps you were a bully, an evil Ranger, or worse. While you now fight for a better cause, you haven’t forgotten how to hit your enemies where it hurts the most. • You gain ↑1 on Intimidation Skill Tests. • You may spend a Story Point to know a weakness or a Hang-Up of a single enemy you can see.

perks.d: This is not your first time wearing the suit.
perks.full: This is not your first time wearing the suit. Maybe you received a call to a greater mission and had to change teams, leave for a time before resuming your heroic activity, or had the opportunity to briefly become a Power Ranger at some point in your past. However, once a Ranger, always a Ranger. You gain the following benefits: POWER RANGERS ROLEPLAYING GAME: THROUGH THE SHATTERED GRID • You gain ↑1 on Driving Skill Tests when piloting any Zord. • Your Maximum Personal Power increases by 1. Grid Powers The following Grid Powers are accessible to all Power Rangers Roleplaying Game characters as long as they meet any prerequisites they have.

perks.d: Needs Level 5+, GM approval One of the many Emissaries of the Morphin Masters has granted you the rare opportunity to go beyond the limits of your Spectrum energy. When you choose this Perk, select a Role Perk from any of the Core Ranger Spectrum Roles at any Level equal to or lower than your current Level; you now possess this Role Perk. Replace any references to that Spectrum Role with that of your current Spectrum Role. If your new Perk would refer to any special quantities on that Spectrum Role’s Level progression table, such as Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots or Green Ranger’s Solo Strike, that special quantity is its lowest (for example, Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots cannot exceed 2). You cannot choose the following: Extra Attack, General Perk, Grid Power, Zord, Zord Feature.
perks.full: Prerequisite: Level 5+, GM approval One of the many Emissaries of the Morphin Masters has granted you the rare opportunity to go beyond the limits of your Spectrum energy. When you choose this Perk, select a Role Perk from any of the Core Ranger Spectrum Roles at any Level equal to or lower than your current Level; you now possess this Role Perk. Replace any references to that Spectrum Role with that of your current Spectrum Role. If your new Perk would refer to any special quantities on that Spectrum Role’s Level progression table, such as Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots or Green Ranger’s Solo Strike, that special quantity is its lowest (for example, Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots cannot exceed 2). You cannot choose the following: Extra Attack, General Perk, Grid Power, Zord, Zord Feature.

perks.d: Needs Speed 4 or higher. You have trained with Eltarian warriors in their combat arts and tactics to powerful effect.
perks.full: Prerequisite: Speed 4 or higher You have trained with Eltarian warriors in their combat arts and tactics to powerful effect. Your Ground Movement increases by 10 feet, and you ignore the first ↓1 on Finesse Skill Tests.

perks.d: Needs Level 8 or higher, witness to the Defeat of a fellow Ranger or loved one. You have witnessed or experienced a great loss, whether of a fellow comrade in arms or a loved one — the emptiness you feel weighs heavily on your heart.
perks.full: Prerequisites: Level 8 or higher, witness to the Defeat of a fellow Ranger or loved one You have witnessed or experienced a great loss, whether of a fellow comrade in arms or a loved one — the emptiness you feel weighs heavily on your heart. It can become a place of strength and resolve or a place where rage and vengeance reside instead. You gain the following benefits: • You gain a +2 bonus to your Willpower. • You are immune to the Mesmerized Condition. • Once per scene involving an enemy who Defeated a Ranger or an ally, you may reroll a Skill Test and choose which results to keep.

perks.d: Needs must not be an enemy of Safehaven. After helping the people of Safehaven, they consider you one of their own, and its protectors feel the same way, awarding you benefits.
perks.full: Prerequisite: must not be an enemy of Safehaven After helping the people of Safehaven, they consider you one of their own, and its protectors feel the same way, awarding you benefits. Once per story in Safehaven, you may choose one of the following effects. You may choose differently each time you visit Safehaven for the first time in a story. If Safehaven is destroyed, you lose the benefits of this Perk. • Gain a weapon from Eternity Point’s armory (one Limited weapon). • Gain an Edge on your weapon upgrade attempts while in Safehaven. • Gain 1 Temporary Health. • Gain ↑1 on Social Skill Tests with Safehaven residents. • While in Safehaven, you are treated as having a +11 Wealth Bonus.

perks.d: Needs Defeated at least once before taking this Perk. You’ve been Defeated once.
perks.full: Prerequisites: Defeated at least once before taking this Perk You’ve been Defeated once. Fortunately, you had the opportunity to learn from your previous experiences, granting you the following benefits: • Once per scene as a Free action, you gain a +5 bonus to a Defense of your choice until the start of your next turn. • Once per scene, if you are reduced to 0 Health while Morphed, you immediately heal 1 Health unless the attack is a Critical Success. New Grid Powers The following Grid Powers are accessible to all Power Rangers Roleplaying Game characters.

powers.d: Your summoned Power Weapon is a stronger conduit of your Morphin Grid energy.
powers.full: Your summoned Power Weapon is a stronger conduit of your Morphin Grid energy. You may spend 1 Power to enhance the accuracy of your Power Weapon by ↑1 for 1 minute.

powers.d: You are able to flood your reflexes with raw energy.
powers.full: You are able to flood your reflexes with raw energy. Anytime after your Initiative order is determined, you may spend Power to increase your current Initiative standing at a ratio of +2 per Power spent.

powers.d: Your Morphed form is now fully sealed from external environmental threats.
powers.full: Your Morphed form is now fully sealed from external environmental threats. While Morphed, you can survive indefinitely in toxic atmospheres, a vacuum, or underwater. Additionally, you are immune to inhalation-based threats.

powers.d: Your Morphed form can repair damage at an increased rate.
powers.full: Your Morphed form can repair damage at an increased rate. You may spend 1 Power to heal 1d2 damage, usable once per scene.

powers.d: You can shine with the light of righteousness.
powers.full: You can shine with the light of righteousness. While Morphed, you may spend 1 Power to emanate bright light in a 30 foot radius for 1 minute. While in effect, your Martial Arts attacks inflict energy damage.

powers.d: You shield your armored shell with energy from the Morphin Grid.
powers.full: You shield your armored shell with energy from the Morphin Grid. Your armor bonus to Toughness, while Morphed, is 1 point higher. This Grid Power may be chosen up to three times.

powers.d: You and your Zord can become one body, one mind.
powers.full: You and your Zord can become one body, one mind. When you summon your Zord, you can be considered to be driving it anywhere within 100 feet and line of sight. Aside from you being a safe distance from your Zord, there are no other changes as to how you are driving the vehicle in question (rolling Initiative, using vehicle attacks, etc.).

powers.d: You have access to the flow of historic details as etched in the energies of the Morphin Grid.
powers.full: You have access to the flow of historic details as etched in the energies of the Morphin Grid. You may spend 1 Power to instantly remember one particular detail from your own past from the last 30 days.

powers.d: You can funnel raw Morphin Grid energy into your hand to hand impacts.
powers.full: You can funnel raw Morphin Grid energy into your hand to hand impacts. By spending 1 Power, you allow your Martial Arts attacks to ignore armor bonuses to Toughness for 1 minute.

powers.d: While Morphed, you can force Morphin Grid energy to coalesce into an unstable bubble, hurling it toward your enemies to explode.
powers.full: While Morphed, you can force Morphin Grid energy to coalesce into an unstable bubble, hurling it toward your enemies to explode. After spending between 1 to 5 Power you can make an Athletics or Targeting (Thrown for either) Skill Test as a Standard action with a range of 40ft/100ft. If it hits, the target suffers 1 Energy damage per Power spent. If it misses, the Power is wasted.

powers.d: By focusing the energy of the Morphin Grid into a living being, you can knit wounded flesh.
powers.full: By focusing the energy of the Morphin Grid into a living being, you can knit wounded flesh. While Morphed, you can spend Power while touching an injured living creature. Each Power spent heals 1 damage or removes one negative condition (poison, transformed into a plant, etc.).

powers.d: You can send a ripple across the Morphin Grid itself, possibly knocking enemies and allies off balance in the process.
powers.full: You can send a ripple across the Morphin Grid itself, possibly knocking enemies and allies off balance in the process. While Morphed, you can take an action to punch the ground and spend 1 to 3 Power to send a tremor out in a 15-foot radius, radiating from you. Every creature or vehicle caught in the area must pass a Athletics or Acrobatics Skill Test or be knocked Prone. The DIF for this test is equal to 12 plus 3 for each Power spent.

powers.d: You can draw the protective nature of the Morphin Grid around one of your hands, creating a shield.
powers.full: You can draw the protective nature of the Morphin Grid around one of your hands, creating a shield. By spending 1 Power to summon the shield, granting the wielder a +2 armor bonus to Toughness. The shield is a physical object that can be transferred to others, and lasts until you return to your normal form.

powers.d: While wielding your summoned Power weapon, you can push raw energy into one of its attacks.
powers.full: While wielding your summoned Power weapon, you can push raw energy into one of its attacks. You may spend between 1 to 3 Power when making an attack action. If it hits, the target suffers an additional 1 Energy damage per Power spent. If it misses, the attack fizzles and the Power is wasted.

powers.d: You can lean upon the linked nature of beings within the Morphin Grid, pushing energy from yourself into other things that might need it.
powers.full: You can lean upon the linked nature of beings within the Morphin Grid, pushing energy from yourself into other things that might need it. While Morphed and in contact with a creature or object that has a measurable need for energy (Power, charges in an arcane item, battery life, etc.), you may freely donate Power to replenish the creature or object an equitable amount (GM’s discretion).

powers.d: Your mastery of fighting unarmed allows you to attack with speed and precision.
powers.full: Your mastery of fighting unarmed allows you to attack with speed and precision. If you make an unarmed attack on your turn, you may spend 1 Power to make two additional unarmed strikes as a Free action.

powers.d: You spend your own internal Morphin Grid energy to repair damage done to your Zord, or the combined Megaform your Zord is a part of!
powers.full: You spend your own internal Morphin Grid energy to repair damage done to your Zord, or the combined Megaform your Zord is a part of! While piloting your Zord, you may spend any number of Power to repair damage it may have suffered. For each 2 Power spent, you repair 1d2 damage. If healing a combined Megaform, the cost of this Grid Power increases by 1, but the amount healed is divided evenly amongst all combined parts (minimum of 1).

powers.d: Calling upon one of Zordon’s rarer gifts to his Rangers, you gain the ability to summon a Sharkcycle by spending 1 Power, teleporting it to anywhere within 30 feet of you.
powers.full: Calling upon one of Zordon’s rarer gifts to his Rangers, you gain the ability to summon a Sharkcycle by spending 1 Power, teleporting it to anywhere within 30 feet of you. This vehicle matches your Spectrum color, and you gain Edge on Driving Skill Tests while using it!

powers.d: You use the Morphin Grid’s energy flow to push your Morphed form to the limit, increasing your Ground Movement and potentially giving you the jump on your enemies, too.
powers.full: You use the Morphin Grid’s energy flow to push your Morphed form to the limit, increasing your Ground Movement and potentially giving you the jump on your enemies, too. While Morphed, your Ground Movement rate is increased by 10 feet. Additionally, you can spend 1 Power to gain Edge on an Initiative Skill Test.

powers.d: The force of gravity is even less of a concern on you now that the Morphin Grid pushes and pulls you through the air.
powers.full: The force of gravity is even less of a concern on you now that the Morphin Grid pushes and pulls you through the air. Instead of the normal triple maximums on your jumping distances, your Morphed form may now jump to anywhere within 90 feet as a Move action.

powers.d: Your Morphed form now taps into the data streams that flow in and out of the Morphin Grid, allowing you to translate any spoken you hear and any written language you see as well…
powers.full: Your Morphed form now taps into the data streams that flow in and out of the Morphin Grid, allowing you to translate any spoken you hear and any written language you see as well as broadcast your own voice in a universally understood language.

powers.d: With a little focus, you can use the same invisible forces within the Morphin Grid to move objects as if with an invisible hand.
powers.full: With a little focus, you can use the same invisible forces within the Morphin Grid to move objects as if with an invisible hand. You may summon an invisible, floating hand that appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you, or if you choose to drop concentration over it. You can use a Free action to control the hand. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or knock over small objects. You can move the hand up to 30 feet each time you use it. The hand can’t attack or carry more than 10 pounds. By spending 1 Power, this weight maximum is increased to 50 pounds for one minute.

powers.d: You can read traces in the Morphin Grid that others don’t pick up on, always knowing where and when you are.
powers.full: You can read traces in the Morphin Grid that others don’t pick up on, always knowing where and when you are. You are always aware of your astronavigation location and gain Edge on all Survival (Space) and Technology (Astro-Nav) Skill Tests.

powers.d: You can focus Grid energy to surge as a flaming nova around your fists and feet.
powers.full: You can focus Grid energy to surge as a flaming nova around your fists and feet. You may spend 1 Personal Power as a Free action to have your unarmed strikes inflict Fire damage and gain “Critical Effect: Next ally gains ↑2 against this foe” until the end of the scene.

powers.d: A strange mutant ability awoke within you, granting you a minor supernatural power not necessarily tied to the Morphin Grid.
powers.full: A strange mutant ability awoke within you, granting you a minor supernatural power not necessarily tied to the Morphin Grid. Maybe it’s something you’ve always been able to do, or perhaps a new ability manifested right after your last adventure. Regardless, this power is more than a party trick, but you won’t be taking over the universe with it. When you gain this Grid Power, you work with your GM to select an interesting minor superpower. When choosing a superpower for this Perk, consider the power level of something achievable with a successful Skill Test or a part of a General or Role Perk. Some good examples are: • Teleporting a single object (less than 5 foot × 5 foot in size) from one place to another within line of sight • Igniting a flammable object by touch or close proximity • Reading digital information and electronic transmissions by touch • Healing damage at an advanced rate • Telepathy, willing or potentially forced • Breathing underwater or surviving in a vacuum Activating your Civilian Superpower requires a Standard action and can be used as many times per scene equal to your lowest Essence score.

powers.d: You can weave Grid energy around your Morphin shell to fortify it when exposed to damage.
powers.full: You can weave Grid energy around your Morphin shell to fortify it when exposed to damage. Once per scene, after suffering any form of Elemental damage (Cold, Electricity, Fire, and so on), you may spend 1 Personal Power immediately to gain Resistance to that type of Element damage to your Morphed form until the end of the scene.

powers.d: Your connection to the energy of the Morphin Grid has opened to flow faster than ever before.
powers.full: Your connection to the energy of the Morphin Grid has opened to flow faster than ever before. Your Personal Power Regeneration rate increases by 2 per day. You may choose this Grid Power more than once.

powers.d: Calling upon the specialized equipment sometimes used by the Power Rangers in particular environments, you gain the ability to summon a Galaxy Glider (see page 125 of the Power…
powers.full: Calling upon the specialized equipment sometimes used by the Power Rangers in particular environments, you gain the ability to summon a Galaxy Glider (see page 125 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook). By spending 1 Personal Power, your Galaxy Glider soars to your position and slides under your feet when you jump into the air. This vehicle matches your Spectrum color, and you gain Edge on Acrobatics Skill Tests to pilot it. WELCOME TO THE UNIVERSE WELCOME TO THE UNIVERSE

powers.d: You can call upon the Grid to provide you with a small, armored flying vehicle.
powers.full: You can call upon the Grid to provide you with a small, armored flying vehicle. You gain the ability to summon a Jet Jammer (see page 91) by spending 1 Personal Power, causing it to teleport to within 30 feet of your current position. This vehicle matches your Spectrum color, and you gain Edge on Driving Skill Tests when piloting it.

powers.d: Using experience and floods of data from the storage banks of the Morphin Masters, you’ve infused your Morphin shell with Grid energy to better resist the forces of evil Choose a…
powers.full: Using experience and floods of data from the storage banks of the Morphin Masters, you’ve infused your Morphin shell with Grid energy to better resist the forces of evil Choose a Defense, and your Morphed form adds 2 to that Defense.

powers.d: You have been altered by your access to the Morphin Grid, allowing you to store additional Grid energy inside of you.
powers.full: You have been altered by your access to the Morphin Grid, allowing you to store additional Grid energy inside of you. Your Personal Power Maximum increases by 2. You may choose this Grid Power multiple times.

powers.d: Your aptitudes and instincts vary enough from the traditional Ranger Spectrum teachings that you manifest another Ranger Spectrum hue’s abilities.
powers.full: Your aptitudes and instincts vary enough from the traditional Ranger Spectrum teachings that you manifest another Ranger Spectrum hue’s abilities. You may choose to gain one Role Perk from any standard Spectrum Role (not Advanced Spectrum Roles). You must choose a Perk from a Level at least 3 levels lower than your current level when you gain this Grid Power, adhering to the following stipulations as well: • The Role Perk must not refer to quantities represented on the Spectrum Role’s Level progression table (such as Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots, Green Ranger’s Solo Strike, and the like). • The Role Perk cannot grant additional Essence. • You cannot choose Extra Attack, General Perk, Grid Power, Zord, or Zord Feature. For example, Peter’s Green Ranger has just reached 6th Level and chooses this Grid Power. Peter wants his Green Ranger to be more of a leader instead of a loner these days, so he looks at the Red Ranger’s 2nd Level “Follow Me!” Role Perk. It is at least 3 levels lower than his current level, making it a good choice to help him be the leader he wants to be!

powers.d: Your Morphed form adapts to empower you to aid others.
powers.full: Your Morphed form adapts to empower you to aid others. While Morphed, you may attempt a Science or Technology Skill Test to help, repair, or heal another as a Free action once per turn with a ↑1 bonus.

powers.d: You see things in different shades of now, then, and what has yet to be and are keenly aware of the passing of time.
powers.full: You see things in different shades of now, then, and what has yet to be and are keenly aware of the passing of time. You always know the local time, no matter the measurement units used, and how much time has passed since a specific moment transpired. Once per scene, by looking at all the possibilities of a decision, you can spend 1 Personal Power to re-roll all dice on a Skill Test but must accept the second result.

powers.d: Chosen by the Morphin Masters, you wield the power of the Grid’s enemies against them.
powers.full: Chosen by the Morphin Masters, you wield the power of the Grid’s enemies against them. You may spend 1 Personal Power to open yourself up to the Void as a Free action, changing the damage inflicted by your unarmed and weapon-based Attacks to Void damage (see page 77) for the remainder of the scene. While this Grid Power is active, you cannot regain Personal Power.

powers.d: You possess one of the powerful chips of a legendary Zeo crystal.
powers.full: You possess one of the powerful chips of a legendary Zeo crystal. Once per scene, as a Standard action, spend 2 Personal Power and use your Zeo crystal to gain a benefit based on the item in which you insert your Zeo crystal. • Into your Morpher: Gain ↑1 on unarmed Attacks and +1 to all Defenses until the end of the scene. • Into your Power Weapon: Your Power Weapon inflicts 1 additional Energy damage with each strike until the end of the scene. • Into your Zord: Gain ↑1 to Driving (Zord) Skill Tests until the end of the scene, or increase damage on a single successful Zord Attack by 2. If every member of your team has this Grid Power while piloting your team’s Megaform, you may all insert your Zeo crystal pieces to add 1 damage to all Megaform Zord Attacks until the end of the scene.

f.line: Zeo Crystal Boost (Across the Stars p.73)

powers.d: You have enough experience with dimensional shifts (portals to a nearby spacecraft or a mystical wood in a parallel dimension) to sense their presence even when they aren’t open…
powers.full: You have enough experience with dimensional shifts (portals to a nearby spacecraft or a mystical wood in a parallel dimension) to sense their presence even when they aren’t open and may be able to use dimensional openings that would be denied to you. You can also use 1 Personal Power as a Free action to create a temporary portal to another dimension that lasts long enough to allow yourself and anyone within your immediate vicinity access.

powers.d: Needs Energem and Dino Charged Items. You have had enough exposure to your Energems that you can power your Dino Charged items even without your Energem or Dino Chargers.
powers.full: Prerequisite: Energem and Dino Charged Items You have had enough exposure to your Energems that you can power your Dino Charged items even without your Energem or Dino Chargers. As long as you are Morphed, you can use all of your gear normally. Unfortunately, this takes its toll, and you take 1 Essence damage (you may choose from which) each time you spend a Personal Power. Lost Essence may be recovered normally.

powers.d: Prerequisite: Dinosaur-themed Team When you need to get somewhere fast, you may call upon a Dino Raptor to activate and run to your position.
powers.full: Prerequisite: Dinosaur-themed Team When you need to get somewhere fast, you may call upon a Dino Raptor to activate and run to your position. This costs 1 Personal Power and a Dino Raptor answers the call like a Zord, arriving within 3d2 game rounds. Once it comes into contact with you, you automatically mount and gain control of it for as long as it is needed. Once you dismount, it returns to the Zord carrier or lair.

powers.d: Prerequisite: Dino Thunder Form When you take this grid power, you are granted 3 extra Personal Power that may only be used to activate your Dino Thunder Form Power.
powers.full: Prerequisite: Dino Thunder Form When you take this grid power, you are granted 3 extra Personal Power that may only be used to activate your Dino Thunder Form Power. This special form of Personal Power is recovered the same way that regular Personal Power is recovered.

f.line: Dino Thunder Boost (Beneath the Helmet p.56)

powers.d: Needs Dino Thunder Form Ordinarily, you may only take one power for your Dino Thunder Form. With your Game Master’s permission, you may take an additional Dino Thunder Form Power as long as it is rationally related to your Dino Thunder Form.
powers.full: Prerequisite: Dino Thunder Form Ordinarily, you may only take one power for your Dino Thunder Form. With your Game Master’s permission, you may take an additional Dino Thunder Form Power as long as it is rationally related to your Dino Thunder Form. For example, if you took Super Strength, then you may argue that your powerful legs might also grant you Super Speed. In this case, using a Personal Power activates both of your powers, and both powers disappear when you morph.

f.line: Extra Dino Thunder Form Power (Beneath the Helmet p.57)

powers.d: Needs Grid Science or Grid Tech Role Perk. You have a closer affinity to the Morphin Grid.
powers.full: Prerequisite: Grid Science or Grid Tech Role Perk You have a closer affinity to the Morphin Grid. Whenever you gain a Grid Science or Grid Tech Role Perk, you may choose an extra Grid Science or Grid Tech bonus.

powers.d: Your continual exposure to the Morphin Grid has slowed or even halted your aging.
powers.full: Your continual exposure to the Morphin Grid has slowed or even halted your aging. By spending 1 Personal Power, you can recall facts or rely on a relationship from the past from 5 years or more that would be useful to remember today.

powers.d: You can only take this power if your backstory includes having been a Power Ranger previously and on a different team.
powers.full: You can only take this power if your backstory includes having been a Power Ranger previously and on a different team. Now that you’ve become a Power Ranger once more with a new team, you can reach through the Morphin Grid and share that experience with your new teammates. By spending 1 Power, you can turn one failure in a Group Skill Test into a success.

powers.d: Prerequisites: White Ranger only, Dino Thunder Form As a White Ranger, you have the ability to mimic the Dino Thunder Powers of your teammates.
powers.full: Prerequisites: White Ranger only, Dino Thunder Form As a White Ranger, you have the ability to mimic the Dino Thunder Powers of your teammates. When you spend 1 Personal Power, you may activate any Dino Thunder Power that you or your teammates have. If you choose a power that is not yours, then the Game Master may impose a Snag or a ↓1 on Skill Tests that involve those powers. New Contacts See the Introduction for rules on gaining and using Contacts.

f.line: White Ranger Extra Dino Thunder (Beneath the Helmet p.57)

powers.d: Needs Level 6+, Personal Power Capacity 4+. You can channel an experimental and volatile way to weave Grid Energy around your Morphin Shell.
powers.full: Prerequisites: Level 6+, Personal Power Capacity 4+ You can channel an experimental and volatile way to weave Grid Energy around your Morphin Shell. Activate your Metallic Armor as a Free action when Morphed by spending 2 Personal Power and yelling, “Metallic Armor, Power UP!” In addition, this Power-hungry upgrade costs 1 Personal Power at the start of each subsequent turn to maintain. When you activate Metallic Armor, you gain the following: • The Metallic Armor forms an additional layer of protection around your Morphin Shell, granting you three temporary Health. • Your Attacks gain the Multiple Targets (2) trait, and Attacks that already have the Multiple Targets trait increase the number of targets by 1. All targets must still be within your reach or range and qualify for any other requirements, such as line of sight. • You reduce the damage dealt to you by minion and foot soldier enemies by 1 to a minimum of 0. • While Metallic Armor is active, you cannot teleport. Metallic armor is volatile and consumes power quickly. It lasts until you choose to end it, you cannot pay the Personal Power to continue using it, you suffer a Critical Success on an Attack by a nonminion Threat, or you are Defeated.

f.line: Metallic Armor Power Up! (Shattered Grid p.26)

powers.d: When you choose this Grid Power, select a Movement type, such as aerial, aquatic, underground, or other.
powers.full: When you choose this Grid Power, select a Movement type, such as aerial, aquatic, underground, or other. While Morphed, you can spend 1 Personal Power to gain that type of Movement at 30 feet until the end of the scene. Using this Grid Power sometimes causes your Morphin Shell to change, growing wings, fins, mole-like claws, or other appendages for the type of movement.

powers.d: Needs Level 8 or higher. You have long roamed in a region where the Morphin Grid doesn’t exist or is difficult to access, forcing you to learn how to be most efficient in using your Power.
powers.full: Prerequisite: Level 8 or higher You have long roamed in a region where the Morphin Grid doesn’t exist or is difficult to access, forcing you to learn how to be most efficient in using your Power. Whenever you spend Personal Power, roll 1d4. On a 4, you regain 1 Personal Power. You cannot use this Perk when an enemy Attack or ability causes you to lose Personal Power. Team Perks

powers.d: The Shattering of the Morphin Grid has imbued you with astounding power that you can channel without the effort of Morphing.
powers.full: The Shattering of the Morphin Grid has imbued you with astounding power that you can channel without the effort of Morphing. You may spend 1 Power to deal 1 Electric damage to one target. New Contacts

powers.d: You can recall previous memories from the old universes and warped timelines after Lord Drakkon’s entry into the Morphin Grid.
powers.full: You can recall previous memories from the old universes and warped timelines after Lord Drakkon’s entry into the Morphin Grid. The split memories sometimes feel jarring, but they confer a series of benefits: • You can spend 1 Personal Power as a Free action to recall details and motives of a character from one of the timelines to your advantage. You gain an Edge when making a Social Skill Test on the chosen character. • You can gain new Contacts with a special ability: “Fractured Time Memory: The Contact has a brief recollection of your Ranger team from one of the timelines before and during the Shattering, and they owe you one. The team can summon the Contact for one scene.” • You can spend 1 Personal Power to gain ↑1 on Smarts Skill Tests to recall details from the two timelines.

powers.d: You can focus Grid energy to empower your movement and provide a small defense with elemental air energy.
powers.full: You can focus Grid energy to empower your movement and provide a small defense with elemental air energy. While Morphed, you gain 2 Free actions per turn to buy extra Movement. These Free actions cannot be used for any other activity. If you don’t use any Free actions on your turn, you gain +5 Evasion until the start of your next turn.

zordfeats.d: This Zord has evolved and developed an additional method of attacking, whether it is an additional limb that can strike in close combat, a missile rack that hurls volleys of…
zordfeats.full: This Zord has evolved and developed an additional method of attacking, whether it is an additional limb that can strike in close combat, a missile rack that hurls volleys of missiles, a frozen spray from its trunk, etc. You may choose to add either a basic melee or ranged attack to your Zord, using the baseline Zord attack statistics and choosing the details (damage type, description, etc.).

zordfeats.d: This Zord is designed as an additional component to one or more team’s Zord Megaform, meaning it more commonly has to fight on its own, without team, until called upon to combine.
zordfeats.full: This Zord is designed as an additional component to one or more team’s Zord Megaform, meaning it more commonly has to fight on its own, without team, until called upon to combine. The following bonuses are added to the Zord: • +2 to Strength (with associated skill ranks) • 2 bonus Health • +1 damage to Melee Attacks

zordfeats.d: Your Zord’s ranged attack is designed to deal with groups of targets instead of a single foe.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord’s ranged attack is designed to deal with groups of targets instead of a single foe. Your ranged attack is now deals damage in 10ft radius blast area of attack.

zordfeats.d: This Zord is designed to keep other Zords within itself, protecting them from harm until it is time to release them for battle.
zordfeats.full: This Zord is designed to keep other Zords within itself, protecting them from harm until it is time to release them for battle. The following bonuses are added to the Zord: • +2 to Strength (with associated skill ranks) • 2 bonus Health • Contains a metaphysical space that holds up to five Vehicular Scale Zords and their Crew inside itself; carried Zords may not be harmed until released as an action • Automatically releases all carried Zords upon reaching 0 Health

zordfeats.d: This Zord is capable of altering its own form and modulating into being part of a larger, combined form with one or more other mechanical beings.
zordfeats.full: This Zord is capable of altering its own form and modulating into being part of a larger, combined form with one or more other mechanical beings. A Megaform that is more than the sum of its parts. Full rules for using the Combiner Zord Feature can be found later in this chapter, starting on page 139.

zordfeats.d: The Zord has additional access points and passenger areas that allow up to three additional crew to join the driver.
zordfeats.full: The Zord has additional access points and passenger areas that allow up to three additional crew to join the driver. These additional crew should be treated like any other vehicle crew, allowing the Zord to access multiple weapon systems when it takes an attack action. However, the Zord doesn’t have external points where these crew can attack with their own weaponry. For more information on Vehicle Crews, see page 175.

zordfeats.d: The Zord has an enhanced form of one of its attack types or weapon systems, making it more potent.
zordfeats.full: The Zord has an enhanced form of one of its attack types or weapon systems, making it more potent. Choose one of the Zord’s methods of attack. Choose either to add Accurate (↑1) to the attack, add 1 damage, or apply one special effect from the list below to the attack. • Doubles Melee Reach • Adds 30ft/60ft to Range • Reduces target’s Speed by 1d2 (1d4 if taken twice) • Ignores Armor Bonus to Toughness • Gain Multi-Weapon (2) (or add +1 if taken multiple times) • Change damage type (Energy, Fire, etc.)

zordfeats.d: The Zord has faster than normal reflexes with its melee-style attacks, allowing it to make an additional melee attack when it takes the Attack action.
zordfeats.full: The Zord has faster than normal reflexes with its melee-style attacks, allowing it to make an additional melee attack when it takes the Attack action. This Zord Feature may be chosen multiple times, each time adding another melee attack to the Zord’s Attack action. It should be noted that this Zord Feature doesn’t carry over as a trait of the attack when combined into a Megaform.

zordfeats.d: Needs Combiner This Zord is always ready to take the next step and transform into their part of a larger, combined form. The Zord Feature speeds up how long the Zord must be in combat before it can join with others using its Combiner feature.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Combiner This Zord is always ready to take the next step and transform into their part of a larger, combined form. The Zord Feature speeds up how long the Zord must be in combat before it can join with others using its Combiner feature. Each time this Zord Feature is chosen, the type of die is reduced by one type (d6 to d4, d4 to d2, etc.) to a minimum of 1.

zordfeats.d: The Zord has an armored shell that is tougher and more durable than that of its brethren.
zordfeats.full: The Zord has an armored shell that is tougher and more durable than that of its brethren. Not only does it increase its Strength score by 1, it adds +2 to its Armor bonus to Toughness as well. While in a Combined Megaform, it adds +1 to the Megaform’s Armor bonus to Toughness.

zordfeats.d: This Zord is built for durability and raw power, as a real brute force kind of Zord.
zordfeats.full: This Zord is built for durability and raw power, as a real brute force kind of Zord. This Zord Feature increases the Zord’s Strength by 1 and gives the Zord one additional Health.

zordfeats.d: The Zord has an exemplary degree of enhancement in one of its primary Essence Scores—Strength or Speed.
zordfeats.full: The Zord has an exemplary degree of enhancement in one of its primary Essence Scores—Strength or Speed. This Zord feature increases one of these two Essence Scores by 2, to a maximum of 15.

zordfeats.d: This Zord is built for mobility and flexibility instead of durability.
zordfeats.full: This Zord is built for mobility and flexibility instead of durability. This Zord Feature increases the Zord’s Speed by 1 and adds 10 feet one of the Zord’s movement types. While in a Combined Megaform, it grants ↑1 to the Megaform’s Initiative Skill Test.

zordfeats.d: The Zord is of a humanoid shape and links with the Ranger driving it to use their own bodily movements and martial training to pilot its battle movements.
zordfeats.full: The Zord is of a humanoid shape and links with the Ranger driving it to use their own bodily movements and martial training to pilot its battle movements. The Zord’s melee attacks are more in tune with the driver, granting ↑1.

zordfeats.d: Prerequisite: Combiner This Zord is designed to function better as a part of the whole.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Combiner This Zord is designed to function better as a part of the whole. This feature allows you to choose a second Megaform Trait for your Zord to contribute to any Megaform they are a part of.

zordfeats.d: The Zord is capable of extraordinarily fast movements or a different manner of locomotion than simply walking.
zordfeats.full: The Zord is capable of extraordinarily fast movements or a different manner of locomotion than simply walking. This feature adds 30 feet to one of the Zord’s movement types or creates a new kind of movement type (aerial, aquatic, burrowing, etc.) at 45 feet.

zordfeats.d: Needs Ranger must have the Ninja Power General Perk. The Zord has been joined with the mighty power of Ninjor and infused with light and strength, transforming it into a new animal form and granting it one of the following special…
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Ranger must have the Ninja Power General Perk The Zord has been joined with the mighty power of Ninjor and infused with light and strength, transforming it into a new animal form and granting it one of the following special powers: Balance of Justice: Grants Edge to allies who attack a target already attacked by this Zord in the same round. Deep Wisdom: Edge on attacks versus targets with Resistance or Immunity to a type of damage Mighty Strength: Increase Strength score by 2; increase the skill rank for one Melee Attack by two ranks. Raw Ferocity: May choose to take a Snag on melee attacks to inflict 2 damage (of the appropriate type). Shining Light: Snag to ranged attacks targeting it specifically. Stealthy Misdirection: Can take the Defend action as part of any Move action that is more than 20 feet.

zordfeats.d: Needs Auxiliary Zord. The Zord has a connection to an ancient item known only to the Champions of the Grid and some of its most dire enemies.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Auxiliary Zord The Zord has a connection to an ancient item known only to the Champions of the Grid and some of its most dire enemies. This connection makes possession of this Relic Key necessary to pilot the Zord, but it also grants it two very distinct bonuses: • The Zord may choose to have Edge on any one roll in the scene • The Zord has a default Smarts and Social of 3 when the Relic Key is present but no crew is currently driving

zordfeats.d: The Zord is built on a much larger frame than others, standing nearly as large as some team’s Zords’ Megaform.
zordfeats.full: The Zord is built on a much larger frame than others, standing nearly as large as some team’s Zords’ Megaform. The following rules apply to the Zord with this feature: • The Zord is of Towering Size class • The Zord’s gains 2 Health • The Zord’s base melee attacks deal 3 damage • The Zord’s Strength increases by 1, but its Speed score is reduced by 2 (this doesn’t affect current skill ranks) • The Zord can’t benefit from the following Zord features: Hardened Chassis, Light Chassis, Ninja Powered, Upgraded Zord; if it already had one of these features, replace it with another

zordfeats.d: The Zord has been chosen to receive an upgrade to its entire form and function by the Morphin Grid.
zordfeats.full: The Zord has been chosen to receive an upgrade to its entire form and function by the Morphin Grid. It completely changes the shape, spirit, and efficiency of the Zord in question. Depending on the type of Upgrade being granted by the Morphin Grid, there are specific bonuses granted to the Zord in question (the Essence adjustments below don’t add new skill ranks to the Zord): • Thunder Upgrade: +1 Speed, +1 skill rank to Driving, increase all attack damage by 1 • Shogun Upgrade: +1 Strength, ↑1 to melee attacks, ability to Defend as a Free action • Super-Zeo Upgrade: +2 Toughness, +2 Health, ↑1 to ranged attacks • Rescue Upgrade: +1 Strength, +1 Speed, +20 feet to all movement types, +1 Armor bonus to Toughness

zordfeats.d: The Zord can shift into a different fighting form by spending 3 of its Ranger’s Personal Power, changing from its animal, mythological, or other shape into that of a gigantic…
zordfeats.full: The Zord can shift into a different fighting form by spending 3 of its Ranger’s Personal Power, changing from its animal, mythological, or other shape into that of a gigantic humanoid fighting form. When it does so, it makes the following adjustments: • Now is considered a Towering Size combatant • Grants ↑2 to Initiative Skill Tests • Melee attacks deal 1 additional damage while in Warrior Mode • Warrior Mode lasts until the Zord is involved in a Combiner Megaform or is subject to Recall for Repairs

zordfeats.d: The Zord is ready and equipped to leave its planet and venture into the vacuum of space.
zordfeats.full: The Zord is ready and equipped to leave its planet and venture into the vacuum of space. Upon acquiring this Zord Feature, the Zord gains an Aerial Movement type of 60ft (30ft) and is fully capable of moving unhindered in the vacuum of outer space (see Zero-G Combat on page 176 for more informatio). Additionally, as ranged combat is a necessity in outer space combat, this Zord’s ranged attacks all gain ↑1.

zordfeats.d: One of your Zord’s attacks rips through the armored layers of its enemies to inflict devastating damage.
zordfeats.full: One of your Zord’s attacks rips through the armored layers of its enemies to inflict devastating damage. One of the Zord’s attacks gains the Anti-Tank and Wrecker weapon traits and the special trait “Critical Effect: Reduces Target’s Armor by 2 for the remainder of the scene.”

zordfeats.d: Prerequisite: Ranger must have the Lightspeed Response Perk Augmented with a portion of the power found within the Light of Orion, the Zord shines with a halo of goodness itself.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Ranger must have the Lightspeed Response Perk Augmented with a portion of the power found within the Light of Orion, the Zord shines with a halo of goodness itself. Increase its Health by 2 and choose one of the following special powers to add to its arsenal. • Aeronautic: Gain Aerial Movement of 40ft and a +2 bonus to Evasion while in flight. • Aquatic: Gain Aquatic Movement of 40ft and a +2 bonus to Evasion while submerged. • HAZMAT: Gain Resistance to two types OR Immunity to one type of damage from the following list: Acid, Cold, Electricity, Poison, or Sonic. • Medical: Add 10 feet to all existing Movement types and grant ↑2 to any Science or Technology Skill Tests to perform first aid, wound treatment, or mechanoid repairs performed by the Zord or its pilot and crew. • Pyrotechnic: Gain Immunity to Fire damage and can use a Standard action to extinguish a 20 foot × 20 foot area of burning targets or materials automatically.

zordfeats.d: This Zord has an alternate monstrousor animal-like form which can be activated by its attuned Power Ranger if they have a conversion key item, ability, or energy to change forms.
zordfeats.full: This Zord has an alternate monstrousor animal-like form which can be activated by its attuned Power Ranger if they have a conversion key item, ability, or energy to change forms. When the Zord answers its Call to Action, it arrives in its Megafauna Form, and the following rules are in effect: • The Zord has Smarts and Social Essence Scores of 3. • All melee attacks gain ↑1 due to bestial ferocity. • The Zord’s pilot uses Animal Handling in place of Driving to operate the Megafauna Form. • Evasion Defense gains a +3 bonus. • The Zord’s pilot can take a Standard action using the conversion key to convert to Zord Form. • The Zord cannot access its Combiner Zord Feature in Megafauna Form.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord has an innate connection to the ebbs and flows of Grid energy that fuels it, funneling a portion of that energy into its pilot and passengers.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord has an innate connection to the ebbs and flows of Grid energy that fuels it, funneling a portion of that energy into its pilot and passengers. After any scene involving your Zord, the piloting Power Ranger and any Power Rangers or characters possessing Personal Power in the Crew Compartment regain up to 6 Personal Power each.

zordfeats.d: Needs Zord must already possess the Crew Compartment Zord Feature. Your Zord is fully equipped and prepared to serve as an emergency medical and repair hub, even in the heat of battle.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Zord must already possess the Crew Compartment Zord Feature Your Zord is fully equipped and prepared to serve as an emergency medical and repair hub, even in the heat of battle. Using raw Grid energy infused in the machines within the crew and passenger area, the Zord itself can knit nearly any wound or mend any damage. Any damaged being currently inside the cockpit or Crew Compartment of your Zord has a 50% chance to regain 1 Health at the end of every round (roll 1d2; Health is regained on a 2).

f.line: R.R.R. (Rapid Rescue Response) (Across the Stars p.104)

zordfeats.d: This Zord is a sentient machine.
zordfeats.full: This Zord is a sentient machine. It has 5 points to divide between its Smarts and Social Essence Scores (minimum of 1 each), granting it its own Willpower and Cleverness Defenses. The Zord can be targeted with mind-affecting effects, although it is immune to fear. Its driver’s Willpower and Cleverness can still be targeted. On the Zord’s turn, it gains a number of Free actions equal to its Smarts minus 2. It can use these Free actions to Lend Assistance to its driver/ crew. This Zord Feature can be chosen multiple times, with each instance after the first adding 2 to each of the Zord’s Smarts and Social Essence Scores.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord manifests a powerful, invisible energy field that turns aside incoming attacks in same way that many spacecraft deflect debris or enemy payloads.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord manifests a powerful, invisible energy field that turns aside incoming attacks in same way that many spacecraft deflect debris or enemy payloads. Your Zord gains the Vehicle Trait: Shielded (2). You can choose this Zord Feature multiple times, increasing your Shielded numerical value by 2 each time, up to a maximum of Shielded (6).

zordfeats.d: Needs Ranger must have the S.P.D. Asset Perk Space Patrol Delta has given your Power Ranger additional equipment, munitions, or other augmentations, granting the following benefits: • Armor Up!: Gain a +2 plating bonus to Toughness. • Drop It!:. The pilot may use Intimidation and Persuasion Skills through the Zord’s loudspeakers, gaining Edge.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Ranger must have the S.P.D. Asset Perk Space Patrol Delta has given your Power Ranger additional equipment, munitions, or other augmentations, granting the following benefits: • Armor Up!: Gain a +2 plating bonus to Toughness. • Drop It!: The pilot may use Intimidation and Persuasion Skills through the Zord’s loudspeakers, gaining Edge. • Incapacitation Ammo: Gain an alternate firing mode for any ranged attacks, changing the effect to Stun with a numerical effect 1 higher than the damage dealt. (For instance, a weapon that deals 1 Blunt damage changes to deal Stun 2.) • Incarceration Protocols: Your Zord answers its Call to Action with 6 containment cards as standard, and any enemy Defeated by your Zord’s attacks is automatically digitally detained if there are vacant containment cards.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord can reconfigure its chassis, either bulking and increasing its overall structure or slimming down and streamlining the machine.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord can reconfigure its chassis, either bulking and increasing its overall structure or slimming down and streamlining the machine. When you choose this Zord Feature, you select one of the following options: • Increase Size Class by 1 category (maximum of Towering) and gain 2 Health, 1 Strength Essence (and the associated Skill Rank of your choice) • Decrease Size Class by 1 category (minimum of Long) and gain +10 feet of Movement, 1 Speed Essence (and the associated Skill Rank of your choice) You may only choose this Zord Feature if you can make the appropriate Size change, and once you choose a direction (larger OR smaller), future choices of this Zord Feature can only be in the same direction.

f.line: Tactical Size Shift (↑/↓) (Across the Stars p.104)

zordfeats.d: Your Zord boasts advanced range-finding and targetassessment enhancements that aid it in ranged combat.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord boasts advanced range-finding and targetassessment enhancements that aid it in ranged combat. Whenever you make a ranged attack, you may apply one of the following effects before making the Skill Test: • Ignore up to ↓2 due to Size difference. • Count the target as if they are in the attack’s normal Range. • Increase the damage of the attack by 1 of the appropriate type by taking ↓1.

zordfeats.d: Learning from the tactics and technologies of the enemies of the Grid, your Zord has added special protection measures in the form of relics created by the Morphin Masters…
zordfeats.full: Learning from the tactics and technologies of the enemies of the Grid, your Zord has added special protection measures in the form of relics created by the Morphin Masters themselves to defend against the weapons of Dark Specter and his ilk. Attacks with the Void trait no longer ignore bonuses to your Zord’s armor (if any), and your Zord gains Resistance to Void damage.

zordfeats.d: Needs Extra Attack, Titan Body. With this upgrade, your Zord has become the stuff of legends, a true icon of conflicts that terrifies its enemies and inspires its allies.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Extra Attack, Titan Body With this upgrade, your Zord has become the stuff of legends, a true icon of conflicts that terrifies its enemies and inspires its allies. Morphin Grid lore recounts few Zords that ascend to this status, but scholars have recorded your Zord among them. Your Zord gains the following benefits: TOOLS OF THE TRADE TOOLS OF THE TRADE • The Zord is now of Titanic Size. • The Zord gains 3 Health. • The Zord gains 3 Strength Essence (and the associated Skill Ranks). • The Zord always has Edge on its Initiative Skill Tests. • All the Zord’s Might or Finesse-based attacks increase their base damage by 1 of the appropriate type. • If the Zord possesses the Combiner Zord Feature, it must now spend 1 Story Point per Zord combining with it to assume a truly immense and history-making Megaform. Upgraded Zord (Expanded) Add the following options to the list shown on page 138 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook: • Elemental Air Upgrade: +1 Speed, +1 Skill Rank to Targeting; add 50 feet to all Range maximums • Elemental Fire Upgrade: +1 Strength, +1 Skill Rank to Might, ↑1 to ranged attacks • Elemental Stone Upgrade: +2 Toughness from Armor Plating, +2 Health; add 1 damage to melee attacks inflicting Blunt damage • Elemental Time Upgrade: +1 Speed, +1 Skill Rank to Initiative; add 15 feet to all Movement types • Elemental Water Upgrade: +1 Strength, +1 Skill Rank to Athletics; gain Resistance to Cold damage • Grave Upgrade: +1 Health, +1 Skill Rank to Con ditioning; add 1 Void damage to any single attack • UltraMax Upgrade: +1 Strength and +1 Speed (and the associated Skill Rank); add 1 to the base damage of all attacks Note that a Zord may only benefit from ONE upgrade option from this Zord Feature at a time; further applications of Upgraded Zord replace the earlier benefits with those of the new choice. New Megaform Traits The following Megaform Traits are accessible to all Power Rangers Roleplaying Game characters whose Zords have the Combiner Zord feature. Accurate Combiner: Whenever the Megaform calls upon one of this Combiner participant’s attack types, the associated Skill Test gains ↑1. You can choose this option twice, once for the Combiner participant’s melee attacks and once for ranged attacks in any order. Defender: The Combiner participant takes the brunt of enemy attacks to spare the rest of the Megaform. No

zordfeats.full: Hatched from DinoZord eggs and then tamed by a Dino Thunder Rangers’ Morpher using Dino Gems, these Zords are infused with elemental attacks related to their respective gem type. This integration grants ↓1 Targeting on one of the Zord’s ranged energy attacks. You may change the energy type dependent on your Ranger’s spectrum color: • Black: Cold • Blue: Energy type, increase range by 50 ft. • Green: Energy type, 1 additional damage • Pink: Electric • Red: Fire • Yellow: Sonic • Advanced Spectrum: Any of the above

zordfeats.d: Needs Zord must have the Dino Gem Integration Feature. Your Ranger’s attunement with their Dino Gem has become more aligned with the powers of the Morphin Grid, granting one of the following special powers to your Zord: • Dino Shield:…
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Zord must have the Dino Gem Integration Feature Your Ranger’s attunement with their Dino Gem has become more aligned with the powers of the Morphin Grid, granting one of the following special powers to your Zord: • Dino Shield: Snag to ranged attacks targeting the Zord specifically. HELMETS, MORPHERS, AND MORE HELMETS, MORPHERS, AND MORE • Dino Sense: Gain ↑2 on all Alertness Skill Tests. • Primordial Power: May choose to take a Snag on melee attacks to inflict +2 damage (of the appropriate type). • Enhanced Stealth: Increase all Movement types by 10 feet. Gain ↑2 on Infiltration Skill Tests to move quietly and avoid detection. • Genetic Resonance: Reduce the time it takes for the Zord to arrive when summoned to the conflict by 2 rounds to a minimum of 1 round.

f.line: Advanced Dino Gem Integration (Beneath the Helmet p.71)

zordfeats.d: Prerequisite: Zord must have the Dino Gem Integration Feature As a Standard action, you may harness bio-energy from the surrounding environment.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Zord must have the Dino Gem Integration Feature As a Standard action, you may harness bio-energy from the surrounding environment. On your next turn, gain ↑2 on Attack Skill Tests and inflict 2 extra damage on all attacks (both melee and ranged).

zordfeats.d: Needs Zord must have the Dino Gem Integration Feature All DinoZords can channel their energy, releasing a surge of power that temporarily boosts their strength, speed, and defenses. Once per scene, a Ranger can choose to spend 3 Personal Power to have their Zord gain the following abilities for 2d2 rounds. This Zord Feature can only be used once per scene. • Increase Speed and Strength Essence by 2 •. You may take the Attack or Defend Combat Action as a Free action once per turn
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Zord must have the Dino Gem Integration Feature All DinoZords can channel their energy, releasing a surge of power that temporarily boosts their strength, speed, and defenses. Once per scene, a Ranger can choose to spend 3 Personal Power to have their Zord gain the following abilities for 2d2 rounds. This Zord Feature can only be used once per scene. • Increase Speed and Strength Essence by 2 • You may take the Attack or Defend Combat Action as a Free action once per turn

zordfeats.d: By introducing the incredible power of Energems to Zords, the Power Rangers’ potent war machines gain the primordial strength of dinosaurs.
zordfeats.full: By introducing the incredible power of Energems to Zords, the Power Rangers’ potent war machines gain the primordial strength of dinosaurs. Energems enhance the ability of Zords by increasing the damage of one of their ranged energy attacks by +1 and optionally may change the energy type of that ranged energy attack dependent on your Ranger’s spectrum color. • Black: Cold • Blue: Energy type, increase range by 50 ft. • Green: Energy type, 1 additional damage • Pink: Electric • Red: Fire • Yellow: Sonic • Advanced Spectrum: Any of the above

These Zords gain the benefit of the following bonuses: •. The Zord has a default Smarts and Social of 2 when no crew is currently driving • The Zord’s Driving (Autopilot) Skill gains ↑1

These Zords gain the benefit of the following bonuses: • The Zord has a default Smarts and Social of 2 when no crew is currently driving • The Zord’s Driving (Autopilot) Skill gains ↑1

zordfeats.d: Needs Zord must have the Energem Infusion Feature Rangers who have tapped into the robust power of the Energems can activate Dino Drive Mode, granting their Zord a boost to armor and enhancing their energy attacks. Engaging Dino Drive Mode requires a Standard action, imposing a −3 penalty (minimum 1) to the Speed Essence of their Zord until the start of its next turn. The Zord then receives the following benefits for the remainder of the scene: • Dino Steel Plating: Increase the armor plating by 1.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Zord must have the Energem Infusion Feature Rangers who have tapped into the robust power of the Energems can activate Dino Drive Mode, granting their Zord a boost to armor and enhancing their energy attacks. Engaging Dino Drive Mode requires a Standard action, imposing a −3 penalty (minimum 1) to the Speed Essence of their Zord until the start of its next turn. The Zord then receives the following benefits for the remainder of the scene: • Dino Steel Plating: Increase the armor plating by 1. • Reflective Armor: Once per round, decrease the damage of a ranged energy Attack by d2. • Amplified Dino Strength: Gains Edge on energy Attacks when within 30 feet of another Zord with the Energem Infusion feature. • Speed Surge: Increase one of the Zord’s movement types by 10 feet.
