zordfeats.d: Needs Auxiliary Zord Feature, Combiner Zord Feature When confronting the evils of the universe, Zords combine to create Megaforms whose power and toughness are far greater than any individual Zord. However, sometimes these Megaforms are not enough to defeat the overwhelming power of evil. In these dire situations, Megaforms can unleash devastatingly powerful attacks to save the day! However, these displays of overwhelming force can only be utilized sparingly due to the immense energy and coordination required. Once per scene, a Megaform that includes at least one Zord with this Feature can initiate a Signature Finishing Move as a Standard action. This is either a Melee Weapon Attack (Might) or Ranged Weapon Attack (Targeting) that deals 4× the damage of the participant attack of the same type. The type of attack and the type of damage that it deals is chosen at the selection of this Feature.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Auxiliary Zord Feature, Combiner Zord Feature When confronting the evils of the universe, Zords combine to create Megaforms whose power and toughness are far greater than any individual Zord. However, sometimes these Megaforms are not enough to defeat the overwhelming power of evil. In these dire situations, Megaforms can unleash devastatingly powerful attacks to save the day! However, these displays of overwhelming force can only be utilized sparingly due to the immense energy and coordination required. Once per scene, a Megaform that includes at least one Zord with this Feature can initiate a Signature Finishing Move as a Standard action. This is either a Melee Weapon Attack (Might) or Ranged Weapon Attack (Targeting) that deals 4× the damage of the participant attack of the same type. The type of attack and the type of damage that it deals is chosen at the selection of this Feature. In addition, the Reach for Melee Weapon Attacks is Reach ×3 and the range for Ranged Weapon Attacks is tripled.

f.line: Megaform Signature Finishing Move (Beneath the Helmet p.72)

zordfeats.d: Prerequisite: Megaform Signature Finishing Move There are instances where even Megaforms and their Signature Attacks fall short against the overwhelming might of evil.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Megaform Signature Finishing Move There are instances where even Megaforms and their Signature Attacks fall short against the overwhelming might of evil. In such dire circumstances, Megaforms can unleash devastatingly potent assaults to annihilate the forces of evil. Due to the colossal energy demands on the Morphin Grid and the intricate coordination involved, these awe-inspiring demonstrations of force are limited to extremely infrequent use. Once per day, a Megaform that includes at least one Zord with this Feature can initiate an Advanced Signature Finishing Move as a Standard action. To initiate, each Zord or pilot must succeed on a DIF 15 Skill Test using any Strength or Speed Essence Skill. If every Zord in the Megaform is successful, the Megaform executes their Signature Finishing Move! This is either a Melee Weapon Attack or Ranged Weapon Attack (chosen at the selection of this Feature) that deals ×5 damage of the participant attack of the same type while bypassing all of the target’s damage Resistances! In addition, the Reach for Melee Weapon Attacks is Reach ×3 and the range for Ranged Weapon Attacks is tripled. This Advanced Signature Finishing Move can only be used in while Megaform!

f.line: Megaform Advanced Signature Finishing Move (Beneath the Helmet p.73)

zordfeats.d: Needs Combiner Zord Feature. While all Zords serve to battle the forces of evil, some Zords provide support to their fellow Zords by protecting them until it is the right time to strike.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Combiner Zord Feature While all Zords serve to battle the forces of evil, some Zords provide support to their fellow Zords by protecting them until it is the right time to strike. These massive and robust Zords are capable of transporting other Zords into battle, as well as functioning as a mobile command center for Power Rangers. Zords that are dedicated to this function give up their ability to join with Megaforms to better serve this role! The Zord gains the following bonuses: • The Zord loses the Combiner Zord Feature and instead gains the Carrier Zord Feature • The Zord gains +3 to their Armor Plating Bonus • The Zord gains 2 additional health Alternate Megaform Combinations This section provides comprehensive rules for creating alternate Megaforms for your Ranger team’s Zords. Sometimes, not every Ranger is available when the intergalactic forces of evil are so powerful that the energy of the Morphin Grid is needed to create a Megaform. Perhaps the enemy has Defeated a Ranger’s Zord, or the Zord is needed to complete a competing critical task at the same time! Or, as can happen with even the most dedicated team of Rangers, not every player can make it to a session! The following list is intended to help Rangers and GMs alike to easily create Megaforms no matter which Zords are present. This flowchart and the numbered list below will guide players and GMs alike through a step-by-step process of determining HELMETS, MORPHERS, AND MORE HELMETS, MORPHERS, AND MORE

zordfeats.d: Once per scene, this Zord can unleash a powerful elemental ranged Attack against its enemies.
zordfeats.full: Once per scene, this Zord can unleash a powerful elemental ranged Attack against its enemies. When you select this Zord Feature, choose among air, earth, fire, lightning, and water. The Attack deals two times the normal level of damage as this Zord’s strongest ranged Attack, uses its Range, and has the following additional characteristics according to the selected element: • Air: The Attack deals Sonic damage. On a Critical Success, the target becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn. • Earth: The Attack deals Blunt damage. On a Critical Success, it knocks the target Prone. • Fire: The Attack deals Fire damage. On a Critical Success, it deals +2 damage (added after applying all other additional effects). • Lightning: The Attack deals Electric damage. On a Critical Success, the target becomes Stunned until the end of their next turn. • Water: The Attack deals Cold damage. On a Critical Success, the target becomes Immobilized until the end of their next turn. If a Zord with this feature participates in a Megaform, this is not a valid participant ranged Attack.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord can manifest from scratch wherever you are using the Morphin Grid Energy within you.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord can manifest from scratch wherever you are using the Morphin Grid Energy within you. As part of the Standard action to summon your Zord, you may spend 4 Personal Power. If you do so, you do not have to roll to determine how many turns it takes your Zord to arrive at the conflict. Instead, the Zord forms from that energy and is ready to pilot at the beginning of the following turn. When it becomes ready, you are placed in the driver’s position as usual. As long as its Ranger has enough Personal Power to manifest it, a Zord with this feature can attend a call even if something interferes with its Ranger’s connection to the Morphin Grid.

zordfeats.d: Needs GM Approval, Not Titan Body Made from the remnants of several other Zords, this Zord is always in a Megaform-like state, giving it greater potency and improving its battle capability. This Zord Feature causes the following changes to your Zord: •. Your Zord’s size becomes Towering.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: GM Approval, Not Titan Body Made from the remnants of several other Zords, this Zord is always in a Megaform-like state, giving it greater potency and improving its battle capability. This Zord Feature causes the following changes to your Zord: • Your Zord’s size becomes Towering. • Choose three Megaform Traits. Your Zord benefits from them at all times, considering itself a Megaform whose component Zords selected such features. For example, you may choose Core Body, Core Ability, and Core Defenses, causing your Zord to double its Health, gain +1 to Strength or Speed, and +1 to its Defenses. • Your Zord can still participate in a Megaform, but it does not benefit twice from any Megaform Trait. For example, if the Zord has the Combiner Zord Feature with the Core Body Megaform Trait and its Health is already doubled due to selecting the same Megaform Trait with Mesh Zord, it does not double again when combined. In addition, the Megaform does not benefit from the Megaform Traits your Zord has due to Mesh Zord. • The Zord cannot benefit from the following Zord Features: Megafauna, Multi-Megaform, Ninja Powered, Titan Body, Upgraded Zord, POWER RANGERS ROLEPLAYING GAME: THROUGH THE SHATTERED GRID and Warrior Mode. If it already has any of these, you may replace them with other features when you select Mesh Zord. This feature counts as Titan Body for the purpose of fulfilling prerequisites to acquire other Zord Features.

zordfeats.d: You can overload the system of this Zord to obtain additional potency from it by sacrificing its integrity.
zordfeats.full: You can overload the system of this Zord to obtain additional potency from it by sacrificing its integrity. As a Free action at the beginning of the Zord pilot’s turn, they can have the Zord lose 1d2 Health (this is a cost to activate this Zord Feature rather than damage) to give an Edge to all the Attacks it performs on that turn. This ability does not carry over to a Megaform in which the Zord participates.

zordfeats.d: This Zord has a reservoir that can store Morphin Grid energy, which it can use to fuel its abilities.
zordfeats.full: This Zord has a reservoir that can store Morphin Grid energy, which it can use to fuel its abilities. The Zord gains a reserve of 3 Personal Power that it or a pilot driving it can spend to use Zord Features. You may choose this Zord Feature up to three times, adding 3 Personal Power to the Zord’s reserve each time.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord is made of raw Morphin Grid energy, which gives it a translucent appearance of the color associated with your Ranger’s spectrum.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord is made of raw Morphin Grid energy, which gives it a translucent appearance of the color associated with your Ranger’s spectrum. After choosing this feature, your Zord gains the following benefits: • When the Zord suffers damage from a melee Attack targeting its Toughness Defense, the attacker receives 1 Energy damage. • The Zord’s melee Attacks gain “Alternate Effect: 2 Energy damage.” • When the Zord reaches 0 Health, it disappears into the Morphin Grid as if it had been recalled with the Recall for Repairs Zord Feature.

zordfeats.d: Needs Remote Control Zord Feature. A combination of remote control and preprogrammed A.I. lets this Zord fight as if its pilot were driving it.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Remote Control Zord Feature A combination of remote control and preprogrammed A.I. lets this Zord fight as if its pilot were driving it. As part of the Standard action to summon your Zord or as a Free action at any point while you control it, you may attempt a DIF 15 Technology Skill Test. If you succeed, your Zord can act independently for 2d2 turns, using your Driving or Technology Ranks for its Skill Tests as if you were driving it.

zordfeats.d: Needs Ranger must have Technology Skill at d4 or higher Allowing Mesh Zords into. Your Game The Mesh Zord feature intends to let Game Masters and players bring impressive creations like the Gravezord and Typhonis to the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Ranger must have Technology Skill at d4 or higher Allowing Mesh Zords into Your Game The Mesh Zord feature intends to let Game Masters and players bring impressive creations like the Gravezord and Typhonis to the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game. However, you must consider some things before doing so. With a variety of options, Mesh Zord has the potential to be an extremely powerful modification or just give a slight boost to a Zord. For example, if someone takes Mesh Zord and selects the Accurate Combiner, Core Defenses, and Layered Systems Megaform Traits, the Zord would gain ↑1 to either a melee or ranged Attack, +1 to its Defenses, and +3 Health, a set of bonuses no different from those granted by other Zord Traits. On the other hand, if one selects the Assault Weapon, Core Body, and Enhanced Melee Attack Megaform Traits, the Zord would not only receive a +1 damage bonus to its melee Attacks and have double its normal Health, but it will also access a devastating attack that could wipe out many Threats in a single blow. Just like a Megazord, indeed! All this is not necessarily bad and may even be compelling if your players spend most of the time during battles in their individual Zords. What is more, a small group of Rangers can greatly benefit from this, becoming each one able to field what is basically a Megazord. Even so, when someone declares their intention to select the Mesh Zord feature, the Game Master and players should discuss what Megaform Traits would make sense for that particular Mesh Zord to have, seeking to reach a compromise that leaves everyone satisfied. CHAPTER TWO: SHATTERED AND REFORGED You can control your Zord even when you are not in its cabin. When you choose this feature, the Zord gains the following benefits: • You may use your Technology Skill instead of Driving to pilot your Zord. • Your Zord gains a special connection to your helmet. As a Free action, you can see what your Zord sees and broadcast your words through it. • As long as you are aware of what your Zord is seeing, you can use a Standard action to remotely control your Zord just as if you were in the driver’s position and may use Personal Power to fuel its Zord Features. • When you summon your Zord, you can have it arrive at a different location than your own. For example, if a giant monster is fighting your team while you are defending your base from a

zordfeats.d: A piece of your Zord’s body is detachable and linked to a chain so it can shoot it to immobilize its enemies.
zordfeats.full: A piece of your Zord’s body is detachable and linked to a chain so it can shoot it to immobilize its enemies. The detachable part may be a fist, a claw, a horn, or a hook if your Zord is more like a vehicle. You Zord gains a ranged Attack with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 65 feet that Grapples the target if successful. A Grappled target must succeed on an Athletics, Brawn, or Finesse Skill Test versus your Zord’s Toughness to break the grapple.

zordfeats.d: This Zord can enhance itself by absorbing technology from its surroundings, be it vehicles, computational equipment, or other machines.
zordfeats.full: This Zord can enhance itself by absorbing technology from its surroundings, be it vehicles, computational equipment, or other machines. Once per scene, the Zord’s pilot can expend 3 Personal Power to have the Zord mesh with the technology of its surroundings, causing the following effects: • The Zord regains 3 Health. • Choose between +1 bonus to Toughness or Evasion Defense. • Choose one of the Zord’s Attacks to add ↑1 to Attack Skill Tests or +1 damage to it. • Bonuses gained from this Zord Feature last until the Zord is involved in a Combiner Megaform or is subject to Recall for Repairs.

zordfeats.d: Needs Combiner Zord Feature This Zord can merge with any other Zord to create a Megaform and make the most of it, no matter the circumstances. A Zord with this feature may combine into a Megaform with any Zord that lacks the Combiner Zord Feature without spending a Story Point.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Combiner Zord Feature This Zord can merge with any other Zord to create a Megaform and make the most of it, no matter the circumstances. A Zord with this feature may combine into a Megaform with any Zord that lacks the Combiner Zord Feature without spending a Story Point. In addition, that Zord provides one of the following Megaform Trait benefits depending on its Ranger’s spectrum: • Black: Core Defenses • Blue: Layered Systems • Green: Enhanced Melee Attack • Pink: Move • Red: Assault Weapon • Yellow: Enhanced Ranged Attack • Other spectrums: Any of the above. This feature only allows for this Zord to combine with one other Zord. However, more than one Zord with this feature may work together to create a stronger Megaform. For example, two Zords with this Zord Feature can combine with two Zords without Combiner, benefiting from the corresponding Megaform Traits according to their Ranger’s spectrum.

zordfeats.d: Needs Extended II or Extended III size This Zord can serve as a mount for Zords of humanoid shape. The following rules apply to a Zord with this feature: • Humanoid-shaped Zords may ride this Zord following the rules for mounted combat presented on pg. 174 of the Power Rangers…
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Extended II or Extended III size This Zord can serve as a mount for Zords of humanoid shape. The following rules apply to a Zord with this feature: • Humanoid-shaped Zords may ride this Zord following the rules for mounted combat presented on pg. 174 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. • The Zord is one Size Class larger for the purpose of determining if another Zord can ride it. • As long as it has a pilot, the mount is an independent mount, and the pilot remains in control of its actions. If nobody is directing the mount, the Zord’s pilot can direct it using Free actions just like with a regular mount. • When the Zord mount makes a melee Attack for the first time in its turn, the rider Zord can immediately also make a melee Attack against that same target.

zordfeats.d: Needs Auxiliary Zord and Combiner. Your Zord provides extra power to your team’s Megaform when you combine.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Auxiliary Zord and Combiner Your Zord provides extra power to your team’s Megaform when you combine. When you select this feature, you gain two other Megaform traits. When your Zord a is part of a Megaform it provides the combiner with the following benefits: • +1 armor plating bonus to Toughness. • +1 Evasion • +1 damage to one Attack

zordfeats.d: Prerequisite: Megaform Signature Finishing Move There are times when monsters don’t play nice and decide to group up to attack the Megaform.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Megaform Signature Finishing Move There are times when monsters don’t play nice and decide to group up to attack the Megaform. For this situation, you can adapt your finisher to cover a large area instead of focusing on a single target. This wider attack hits more enemies but at the cost of less damage than a finishing move directed at a single monster. Once per scene, a Megaform that includes at least one Zord with this Feature can initiate an Energy Maximum Pulse finishing move as a Standard action. This is a Range Weapon Attack that deals 2× the damage of a participant attack of the same type. This area of effect Attack covers 60ft × 60ft.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord has been upgraded with technology foreign to the Morphin Grid.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord has been upgraded with technology foreign to the Morphin Grid. These upgrades add functions and capabilities to your Zord without changing its core abilities. However, these enhancements have a drawback: the Morphin Grid can’t repair them. Your Zord only recovers half its Health when you activate Recall for Repairs, and you must spend downtime or call upon a Contact to finish the repairs. Your Zord gains the following. • +1 armor plating bonus to Toughness. • An alternative movement equals half its Ground Movement. • Add a basic ranged Attack to your Zord, using the baseline Zord Attack statistics and choosing the details (damage, description, etc.)

zordfeats.d: Needs Hardened Chassis, Shield Matrix, or Titan Body. You can use your Zord’s reinforced body to cover your team and prevent them from taking damage.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Hardened Chassis, Shield Matrix, or Titan Body You can use your Zord’s reinforced body to cover your team and prevent them from taking damage. Once per round, if an Attack targets an adjacent Zord, you can swap places in response to take the Attack against your own Defenses. If your Zord is part of a Megaform, once each round, you can redirect 1 damage from another Zord to your Zord.

f.line: Get in the Way (Shattered Grid p.78)

zordfeats.d: Needs Auxiliary Zord, Megaform Signature Finishing Move. Desperate times call for desperate measures!. Your Zord might be the last one standing, or time is running out, and you need to finish the situation quickly.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Auxiliary Zord, Megaform Signature Finishing Move. Desperate times call for desperate measures! Your Zord might be the last one standing, or time is running out, and you need to finish the situation quickly. So, you will put everything you have in the following attack! Your Zord can perform a finishing move on its own. This puts extreme pressure on the Zord and its user, so once you do it, you won’t have anything left. Once per scene, you can initiate a finishing move as a Standard action. This is a Targeting Ranged Weapon Attack Skill Test that deals ×4 damage of your Zord’s strongest Ranged Attack. The range of the Attack is 3× the Ranged Attack. After this, your Zord lays dormant and Prone, and you unmorph.

zordfeats.d: Your Zord can rearrange its energy flow to compensate for its system’s damage.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord can rearrange its energy flow to compensate for its system’s damage. While piloting your Zord, you can use a Standard action and make a DIF 15 Technology Skill Test. If you succeed, heal your Zord equal to half your Smarts but suffer ↓1 on any of the Zord’s Skills. CHAPTER THREE: WORLDS BEYOND

zordfeats.d: Needs Must be of an animal, beast, or similar organic shape, and Ranger must have Animal Handling Skill at d8 or higher. You share a special connection with your Zord.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Must be of an animal, beast, or similar organic shape, and Ranger must have Animal Handling Skill at d8 or higher. You share a special connection with your Zord. You see it as more than a construct; in your eyes, it is a sentient living creature, and you treat it as such. This bond allows you to summon your Zord’s energy without summoning the Zord itself. Once per scene, you can perform a Standard action and spend three Personal Power to receive help from your Zord, using one of its Attacks without summoning it. Using this Power does not count as a Call to Action and doesn’t have any delay.

zordfeats.d: Needs Crew Compartment or have a Techsavvy Contact. When a Zord falls in battle, it needs to retreat into the Morphin Grid to recover, but your Zord has access to a capable team of mechanics that can fix some of its damage to allow it to fight a little more before retreating to the grid for a full recovery. Once per scene, when your Zord’s Health drops to 0, you can take a Standard action to call for repairs. The repairs will take 1d6+1 rounds, after which your Zord will stand up with a quarter of its Health rounded down.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Crew Compartment or have a Techsavvy Contact. When a Zord falls in battle, it needs to retreat into the Morphin Grid to recover, but your Zord has access to a capable team of mechanics that can fix some of its damage to allow it to fight a little more before retreating to the grid for a full recovery. Once per scene, when your Zord’s Health drops to 0, you can take a Standard action to call for repairs. The repairs will take 1d6+1 rounds, after which your Zord will stand up with a quarter of its Health rounded down. Additionally, if your Zord suffers damage that can’t be recovered by a Recall for Repairs, your repair crew ensures your Zord is ready without spending downtime.

zordfeats.d: Needs Ranger must have d6 Rank in Finesse or Driving Skill. A stealth drive conceals your Zord’s presence from electronic surveillance.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Ranger must have d6 Rank in Finesse or Driving Skill. A stealth drive conceals your Zord’s presence from electronic surveillance. Your Zord is invisible to radar and other digital location devices. Additionally, you can give your Zord an Edge on Infiltration Skill Tests as a Free action. zordfeats.d: Needs Temporal Buffer. Your Zord contains the most advanced technology of the 31st century, allowing it to adapt and upgrade any past technology that it encounters.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Temporal Buffer Your Zord contains the most advanced technology of the 31st century, allowing it to adapt and upgrade any past technology that it encounters. Your Zord gains the Combiner Feature and may combine with other Zords that do not have the Combiner Zord Feature. When forming a Megaform that includes at least 3 Zords with this feature, it may include an ineligible vehicle or Zord as if they had the Combiner Core vehicle Perk or the Combiner (core body) Zord Feature.

zordfeats.d: Needs Must have more than one ranged attack. The Zord has multiple forms to deal damage while keeping its distance.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Must have more than one ranged attack. The Zord has multiple forms to deal damage while keeping its distance. It can chain all its attacks to deal devastating damage. When it makes a ranged attack, you can spend one Personal Power, and it can make a ranged attack with every other ranged weapon it has. This Zord Feature may be chosen multiple times, allowing additional energy POWER RANGERS ROLEPLAYING GAME: THROUGH THE SHATTERED GRID to fire another chain of attacks. This Zord Feature does not carry over as a trait of the attack when combined into a Megaform.

zordfeats.d: Needs Must be of an animal, beast, humanoid, or similar organic shape. Your Zord comes with extra limbs (multiple arms, legs, heads, etc.), which can be used in combat to overwhelm the enemy with a barrage of attacks.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: Must be of an animal, beast, humanoid, or similar organic shape Your Zord comes with extra limbs (multiple arms, legs, heads, etc.), which can be used in combat to overwhelm the enemy with a barrage of attacks. Choose one of your Zord’s melee attacks. The attack gains Multi-Weapon (3).

zordfeats.d: Your Zord comes equipped with a way to impair enemy movement to help the rest of the team land their attacks.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord comes equipped with a way to impair enemy movement to help the rest of the team land their attacks. When dealing damage with a melee attack you can spend one Personal Power and make an opposed Brawn or Might Skill Test against the target. If successful, the enemy is also restrained by the attack. This feature can be used as part of a Megaform.

zordfeats.d: Needs The Zord must not have Social and Smarts Essence Scores of its own. Your Zord has become the vessel of a mystical creature.
zordfeats.full: Prerequisite: The Zord must not have Social and Smarts Essence Scores of its own. Your Zord has become the vessel of a mystical creature. This creature’s intentions may line up with yours or be totally opposite, but that doesn’t mean the creature is inherently evil. The creature modified your Zord to make it more to its liking, boosting its capabilities and adding new ones. Your Zord gains the following new properties: • Your Zord gains an additional Zord Feature based on the spirit’s nature and capabilities. • Increase one of your Zord’s Essence scores by 2 and reduce another by 2. • Your Zord gains a Essence Smarts Score of 3 and Social Essence of 1. • At the start of your turn, you must succeed on a DIF 10 Persuasion Skill Test, or the creature takes control of the Zord for this round. Roll a d4 to determine what the spirit does, targeting a creature of the Spirit/GM’s choice:

zordfeats.d: Your Zord features durable construction to withstand the rigors of traveling through transwarp energies, time portals, and similar continuum transit methodologies.
zordfeats.full: Your Zord features durable construction to withstand the rigors of traveling through transwarp energies, time portals, and similar continuum transit methodologies. Your Zord gains a +1 bonus to its Toughness Defense, and it gains an Aerial Movement of 45ft. When your Zord time travels, it reduces the die type for any Continuum Anomaly Tests (see The Power Rangers Roleplaying Game: A Jump Through Time, pg. 113) by one size. This benefit is not cumulative with other Zord Feature instances but applies when combined into a Megaform. roles.intro: Rangers that are imbued with the Black energy of the Morphin Grid tend to be social charmers, entertainers, and the real life of the party.

dance, song, jokes.t: One collective way that Black Rangers tend to reach their teammates with their special brand of reinforcing positivity is through light-hearted behaviors not commonly found in a staunch warrior. Whether that is through telling one liner jokes, harmless limericks or rhymes, singing pleasant tunes, and maybe even just showing with a little personal dance, Black Rangers find their own way to connect their team members to themselves and each other.

good leaders.t: When a Ranger more dedicated to leadership, like a Red or White Ranger, isn’t available for the team, Black Rangers often step up and take the role. Their dedication to team strength and cooperation put them in a great place to make collective plans, and their teammates rarely have reason to question what motivates a Black Ranger. While they tend to be the glue between the members of their team, standing at its forefront is just as natural to them.

stalwart anchors.t: A Black Ranger’s Zord, whether it hails from the depths as a Dinozord or even a humanoid Shogunzord or Battle Borg, represent being a defensible root or anchor for the team’s other Zords. Animal shapes are often tough, armored, quadruped beasts known for their ability to withstand tremendous adversity. Humanoid Zords are thicklimbed and wield heavier weaponry. Vehicular Zords revolve around being a hard punch, an anvil upon which the other rangers in the team can rely.

it’s morphin time!.t: Starting at 1st level, by summoning the energy within you through your Power Morpher and saying the words “It’s Morphin Time!” as a Standard action, you are enveloped with a stylized shell of Morphin Grid energy that serves as your armor, grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • Your Toughness Bonus is determined by your Armor Training: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra-Heavy (+6). • All of your Jump distance maximums are tripled. • As a Free action, you can summon any single Power-based weapon to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious, and at 1 Health.

heart of the team.t: Beginning at 1st level, your natural mirth and positivity can be used to boost your teammates and other allies with just a few words. Whether in the heat of battle or at the peak of a difficult obstacle, your clever words can make the difference between failure and success. As a Free action, you can apply a ↑1 shift to the roll of any ally within 60 feet of you that can understand what you are saying. This costs one of your Quips & Speeches per long rest, as noted on the table above. The value of this die rolled increases to the listed amount at 5th, 10th, and 15th levels.

whatever we need.t: At 2nd level, your charm extends to others when you need to acquire something mundane from a shop, a store, or another normal person in the backdrop of the so-called normal world. You can, by expending one of your Quips & Speeches per long rest and asking the non-player character in question for a favor, you can gain Edge on all Alertness, Deception, and Persuasion Skill Tests targeting them for 5 minutes.

you got this!.t: Starting at 2nd level, a few quick words at the perfect time can keep a teammate in fighting spirit. As a Free action, you can spend one of your Quips & Speeches per day to give any ally within 30 feet a number of temporary Health that last until the end of the current combat scene. The amount of Health increases at 7th level, then again at 12th and 17th levels.

zord.t: By the time a Ranger reaches 3rd level, their role in protecting the Morphin Grid requires them to battle larger and more devastating foes. When piloting your personal Zord, you cannot suffer Snags when using the Driving skill. You now have access to a powerful construct of a particular kind based upon the Power Ranger team you are a part of. These are the various Zords, Borgs, and Power vehicles that the Rangers summon to aid them when the monsters and other minions of evil are empowered by warlords like Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa. Rules and statistics surrounding Zords can be found in the section starting on page 131. Black Ranger Zords What sort of shape a Black Ranger’s Zord takes depends on the kind of Power Ranger Team they are a part of. Examples of previously chosen Zords are: • Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Mastodon, Lion • Ninja Power Rangers: Frog • Alien Rangers: Black Battle Borg • Space Rangers: Mega V2 Shuttle Zord Feature Upon reaching 6th level, then again at 10th, 14th, and 17th levels, a Ranger’s connection and proficiency with their Zord has strengthened and evolved to a place where their abilities while using it are stronger and more powerful than ever. Each time this Role Perk is acquired by a Black Ranger, they may choose from the list of Zord Features (see page 136 for details) to apply to their personal Zord.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you have the ability to personalize your Ranger a little further and must choose to gain a General Perk of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

grid power.t: First upon reaching 6th level, then again at 11th and 16th levels, your understanding and connection to the power that flows from the Morphin Grid in ways other Rangers may not. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you may choose a Grid Power (see page 99) to add to your Ranger, so long as they meet the requirements, if any.

one for all.t: Upon acquiring 11th level, your connection to and willingness to sacrifice for your team is strong enough to bridge your power into them at a moment’s notice. Once per day, as a Standard action while Morphed, you can spend 3 of your current Personal Power to allow all of your teammates to regain 1d2 Personal Power immediately. Unlike other Black Ranger features, this doesn’t cost one of your Quips & Speeches.

all for one.t: At 18th level, your Ranger career of always being there for your teammates can be turned into a two-way street when you are in dire need. If you are ever brought to 0 Personal Power or 0 Health, you can immediately call upon your fellow Ranger teammates to help you. When this Role Perk is called upon, each member of your team may choose to give 1d2 Power and/or 1 Health to you immediately, spending the same amount from themselves to do so. This ability may only be used once daily.

black ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s Black Ranger. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 to all Defenses • Additional point of damage with Martial Arts attacks • Edge on Social-based Skill Tests

roles.intro: Those chosen to embody the energy of the Blue Ranger will be the closest member of the team to the inner workings of the Morphin Grid itself.

team technician.t: Blue Rangers embody the Morphin Grid’s ability to design and create constructs and devices using millennia of knowledge from around the universe. They are the most likely member of the team to discover an alien item, piece of technology, or special construct that will help solve the problem or overcome an obstacle. While other teammates might spend their time working on new fighting techniques or Zord maneuvers, a Blue Ranger is probably seeking knowledge about the past to better deal with the future.

brains over brawn.t: Unlike candidates chosen for other colors of Ranger in the Spectrum, people chosen to be Blue Rangers are rarely looked at save for their most basic fighting abilities or combat instincts. Instead, they are chosen for their brilliant minds and the ingenuity they bring to the team. Blue Rangers embody the logical calculation it takes to see a victory and how to achieve it before the first punch is ever laid on a Putty. As a Power Ranger they will have to battle the forces of evil, but they personify the idea of fighting smarter, not harder.

a stoic role.t: For as long as there have been Power Ranger teams, the Blue Ranger has not only been the technician and the inventor for their teammates, but also the stalwart memory of the Morphin Grid itself. The history of all that has gone before flows through their color of the Spectrum, and this is personified in not only their abilities and skills, but in the beasts and creatures from which their Zords take shape. They are animals that embody wisdom and mysticism; the triceratops, unicorn, and sphinx are all infused with the Blue Ranger’s energy.

At any point where you are about to make a Skill Test with a Smarts-based skill, you may spend an Idea Point to gain Edge on that roll.

helping hand.t: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your connection to the technology of the Morphin Grid to patch up the power shell of another team member. As a Free action, you may spend 1 Personal Power to heal any Morphed member of a Power Rangers team within 60 feet one Health.

grid tech.t: You have begun to unlock the technological secrets of the Morphin Grid. You acquire this Role Perk in four parts, I, II, III, and IV at 2nd, 7th, 12th, and 17th levels. Upon gaining each version of this Role Perk, you may choose two of the Grid Tech bonuses currently available to them to apply. Grid Tech I Aptitude Augmenter: Pick one skill in which you have at least one rank. You may re-roll 1s and 2s while attempting Skill Tests with that skill. This Grid Tech may be chosen multiple times. Gridspeak Receivers: You and your Power Ranger team, when Morphed, can understand and read any language used by creatures on the Morphin Grid. Gridspeak Transmitters: You and your Power Ranger team, when Morphed, can speak a form of universal language understandable by any creatures on the Morphin Grid. Blaster Focusers: You may add a ↑1 shift to all of the Blade Blaster attacks of your Power Rangers’ team. Grid Tech II Defensive Shields: You may increase the Morphed Toughness of one member of your Power Ranger team by +1. This Grid Tech can be chosen once per team member. Enhanced Summoner: You and your Power Ranger team reduce the number of rounds it takes to summon your Zords by -1 (minimum of 1). Power Focusers: You may a ↑1 shift to all of the Power Weapon attacks of your Power Rangers’ team. Vision Focuser: While Morphed, you and your team can see in darkness up to 30 feet as if it were dim light and treat dim light within the same range as bright light. Grid Tech III Aim Apparatus:

power infusion.t: Upon reaching 9th level, you can pour your Morphin Grid energy into one series of empowered attacks from your team. As a Blue Ranger, your connection to the Grid’s power is almost symbiotic. Once per scene, by spending 1 Personal Power and a Free action while Morphed, you and each of your Morphed Power Ranger teammates within 60 feet re-roll natural 1s on your next successful attack. At 18th level, they may also re-roll 2s.

power burst.t: At 10th level, the Blue Ranger knows how to tap the Morphin Grid directly once per scene to send a ripple of raw power into his team. You can spend a Standard action to have every Morphed member of the Power Ranger team, no matter where they are on the Grid in space and time, to gain 1d2 Power. Upon reaching 15th level, this amount increases to 1d4.

roles.intro: Possessing a rare wavelength of energy within the Morphin Grid, Green Rangers are the loners and the outsiders.

still part of the spectrum.t: The Green Ranger was once unleashed by General Repulsa as a weapon of her own, but it took her ancient arcane powers to do so. This goes to show that the Green Ranger is not a pawn to be pushed around, but instead a powerful part of the Morphin Grid, same as any other. They just might seem to play on their own better than other members of their team. They are the rogues, the wildcards, and they are good at playing by their own rules.

fight hard for victory.t: Green Rangers, whether they have a Power Ranger team to fall back upon or not, have an uphill battle to prove themselves worthy of the gift that has been placed upon them. They are skilled fighters that take on threats that entire teams might try and face, normally long enough to get the rest of the team involved to achieve victory. Their fighting styles might be less conventional than other Rangers, but no one would argue that it doesn’t get the job done.

unique connection.t: Being apart from the common Spectrum for as long as it had been, the Green energy wavelength has a different and truly unique way that it interacts with the Morphin Grid. It can seamlessly bond with other Rangers to be part of a team, linking its Grid Zord to one or more other members’ to form specialized Megazords in some cases, and staying separately devastating when they do battle on their own. It is as if the Morphin Grid itself understands the wildcard nature of the Green Ranger and has adapted to it accordingly.

it’s morphin time!.t: Starting at 1st level, by summoning the energy within you through your Power Morpher and saying the words “It’s Morphin Time!” as a Standard action, you are enveloped with a stylized shell of Morphin Grid energy that serves as your armor, grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • Your Toughness Bonus is determined by your Armor Training: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra-Heavy (+6). • All of your Jump distance maximums are tripled. • As a Free action, you can summon any single Power-based weapon to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious, and at 1 Health.

solo strike.t: Starting at 1st level, the Green Ranger is skilled at picking a single target and going at it one on one. This Role Perk allows you to make a special kind of melee attack. By making only a single attack against an adjacent target which is also not adjacent to any of your allies, you may apply the dice shift listed on the table above. Hit or miss, you may not make any other attacks in the round in which you attempt a Solo Strike.

unique weapon.t: To aid you in wielding the Green energy, you are given a special, unique Power Weapon at 1st level. This weapon has a special ability attached to it, but also a risk of some kind. At 1st level, you may choose from or roll randomly on Table 4–4 to create the different aspects of your Green Ranger Unique Weapon. 1D4 ROLL TYPE OF WEAPON (SKILL USED) SPECIAL ABILITY ITEM RISK 1 Ranged Weapon 60/100 (Targeting) Stores up to 3 Personal Power for wielder to use. User loses 1d4 Personal Power upon a roll of natural 1 to hit. 2 Small Melee (Finesse) Calls Zord in half normal time. DIF 12 Performance Skill Test while wielding weapon to temporarily steal control of Zord. 3 Versatile Melee (Might or Finesse, chosen at attack) Gains ↑2 shift when attacking targets at least 3 sizes larger. Does not Morph with user; it always exists in a physical state. 4 Two-Handed Melee (Might) Inflicts energy damage instead of its normal type. Slows all of wielder’s movement types down by 10 ft. survival boon.t: Green Rangers need to have an extra sense of selfprotection that other Rangers aren’t offered because of the time they spend fighting on their own. At 2nd level you may choose one of the following selfpreservation skills to apply to your Ranger. You may make a second choice at 9th level, and a third at 14th level. 360° Awareness: You cannot be surprised if awake, you gain ↑1 to your Alertness and Initiative Skill Tests. Enhanced Shell: Your Morphed form’s body shell is slightly more protected, having manifested a shielded mantle. Your Toughness is +1. Like a Shadow: You can become statue-still at a moment’s notice, gaining Edge on all Infiltration Skill Tests. Move Like a Song: The first attack that targets you each round has a Snag. If that attack already has a Snag, it automatically misses instead. Savant: You have a knack for trying anything and getting it right. If you don’t have any ranks in a skill, you can always try a Skill Test using a d2 as your skill rank. You must still purchase the d2 rank in a skill to increase it further.

zords.t: By the time a Ranger reaches 3rd level, their role in protecting the Morphin Grid requires them to battle larger and more devastating foes. When piloting your personal Zord, you cannot suffer Snags when using the Driving skill. You now have access to a powerful construct of a particular kind based upon the Power Ranger team you are a part of. These are the various Zords, Borgs, and Power vehicles that the Rangers summon to aid them when the monsters and other minions of evil are empowered by warlords like Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa. Rules and statistics surrounding Zords can be found in the section starting on page 131. Green Ranger Zords What sort of shape a Green Ranger’s Zord takes depends on the kind of Power Ranger Team they are a part of. Examples of previously chosen Zords are: • Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Dragonzord • Power Rangers Zeo: Taurus • Power Rangers Turbo: Desert Thunder Truck Zord Feature Upon reaching 6th level, then again at 10th, 14th, and 17th levels, a Ranger’s connection and proficiency with their Zord has strengthened and evolved to a place where their abilities while using it are stronger and more powerful than ever. Each time this Role Perk is acquired by a Green Ranger, they may choose from the list of Zord Features (see page 136 for details) to apply to their personal Zord.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you have the ability to personalize your Ranger a little further and must choose to gain a General Perk of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

grid power.t: First upon reaching 6th level, then again at 11th and 16th levels, your understanding and connection to the power that flows from the Morphin Grid in ways other Rangers may not. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you may choose a Grid Power (see page 99) to add to your Ranger, so long as they meet the requirements, if any.

sidestep.t: At 7th level, you can sidestep danger and dodge certain area effect attacks, such as the slime barrage from the Goo Fish or a strafe from Lord Zedd’s eyebeams. When you are subjected to an attack that has an Area of Effect that targets your Evasion, you may spend a point of Personal Power to reduce the attack result by the number rolled on your Acrobatics skill die.

team player.t: Upon reaching 10th level, you are less of a lone wolf. You can transfer your unique Survival Boons to your Power Ranger teammates. By making contact between your Morphed form and a teammate’s Morphed form, and both of you spend 1 Personal Power to make the transfer, you may choose one of your current Survival Boons to pass to that teammate. This transfer lasts until both of you return to your normal form; the next time you use It’s Morphin Time!, all transferred Survival Boons will have been returned to you.

at all costs.t: At 18th level, you have formed a connection with your team strong enough to surprise you with what you are capable of on their behalf. You can, once per day, fight beyond reaching 0 Health while Morphed. Instead of being Defeated or returning to your normal form, you may continue to fight normally. During this time, when an enemy successfully hits you, you lose 1 Personal Power instead of taking damage. If, at any time during this Role Perk’s use, you reach 0 Personal Power, you immediately return to your normal form with 0 Health, Unconscious and Defeated. This is a dangerous Role Perk, and is normally only called upon when the team is truly in trouble.

green ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s Green Ranger. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 to all Defenses • Deal an additional point of damage with Unique Weapon attacks • Edge on Social-based Skill Tests

roles.intro: Infused with one of the supporting energies in the Spectrum, Pink Rangers are warriors that specialize in backing up their team from the rear ranks.

can’t catch me!.t: Pink Rangers are solid martial artists, but first and foremost they are ranged combat experts with numerous abilities and talents that benefit the team most when they are outside of the reach of an enemy. They are nimble, agile, and often chosen for their gymnastic talents. These skills are perfect for dodging out of trouble’s way to get a better vantage point to pick off Putties and Tengas that might threaten their friends!

true heart.t: It takes a lot of heart and trust in their teammates to stand in the rear or on the flanks, picking off enemies a few at a time instead of wading in and fighting back to back with their friends. They fill their team with hope and good will; sometimes with words, sometimes with actions. When a Power Ranger looks over their shoulder, whether it is at the local juice bar hanging out or in the middle of a field of Eye Guy’s floating minions, and sees their Pink Ranger is watching, they can trust they are in good hands.

best defense.t: Pink Rangers are light on their feet and lightly armored within their shell, but their energy and their training makes up for it by simply keeping the enemy from getting their hands on them. They duck and dodge most incoming threats, relying on their teammates to lend a hand when things get thick, but always taking down important targets as they dance, flip, and dart around the battlefield.

hard target.t: At 2nd level, you are particularly adept at making yourself difficult to hit in combat. As part of a Move action, you are allowed to roll your Acrobatics skill die to augment your Evasion score by the result until the beginning of your next turn.

penetrating shot.t: At 5th level, your aim with your ranged Power Weapon is so steady that you can direct a number of shots into the same exact point, delivering a punishing amount of damage to one target. By spending an additional 1 Personal Power when using the Volley feature, you can choose to make a single attack against a single target that will apply to all of the shots from the Volley. This attack gains ↑1 per additional shot after the first made in the Volley.

group strike.t: Upon reaching 5th level, you can split the energy blasts from your ranged Power Weapon into a shower of smaller blasts that saturate an entire area. After spending 1 Personal Power, you choose a 10 foot by 10 foot area within range and line of sight, and make a ranged attack against all targets in that area. The area affected increases to 15 feet by 15 feet at 10th level, and again at 15th level to 20 feet by 20 feet.

precision aim.t: At 9th level, your ranged attacks are instinctually well-aimed and seem to seek out the weak points in enemies. If you do not move on your turn, your ranged combat attacks now inflict an additional point of damage if they hit. At 18th level, the bonus damage is increased to 2 damage.

roles.intro: Born leaders and warriors through and through, candidates chosen to embody the noble spirit and fighting prowess that each Red Ranger uses to stand proud and strong in the front lines of their Ranger teams.

stand tall and fierce!.t: Red Rangers personify the kind of proud nobility and martial skill prowess it takes to lead a Power Ranger team. Subtlety and subterfuge are not the kinds of skills that tend to be important to a Red Ranger, as their candidates are chosen for their ability to think on their feet and solve problems directly rather than trying to find ways around them. Red Rangers are, by no means, unintelligent or ignorant. They just tend to excel at taking on trouble head on.

always ready to help.t: The strength and sanctity of the Power Ranger team is, at their core, where a Red Ranger draws its strength. Their fighting styles revolve around teaming up on enemies, dealing decisive blows after a teammate has softened them up, and either serving as the core of a team’s Grid Zord Megaform, or alternatively, standing back to back in their own fighting Zord with a Megaform made up of the rest of the team!

a long and noble line.t: Stretching as far back as to when the Morphin Grid has needed them, Red Rangers have had a place on their most successful champion teams. Across dimensions and across time, these noble warrior leaders have all had the same ideal embossed on their very core: the team comes first, and its enemies cannot be allowed to harm its members. Even if a Red Ranger has had to put themselves directly on the line in the name of their teammates, they would do so gladly for the sake of their friends.

power strike.t: At 1st level, a Red Ranger’s attacks can be direct conduits to their raw Morphin Grid energy. You can, when making any form of melee attack while Morphed, spend 1 Personal Power to add a number of bonus damage to the attack if successful. The amount is listed on Table 4–6.

follow me!.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, a Red Ranger’s leadership skills are just beginning to shine. At the beginning of any combat, instead of rolling their own Initiative, your teammates may always choose to instead set their Initiative as 1d4 lower than yours (minimum final result of 1). They must choose to follow this Role Perk before you roll your Initiative result, but each team member who chooses to do this emboldens you and adds +1 to your result. For example, Jason uses Follow Me! at the beginning of a fight with Goldar and a pack of Putties. Trini, Zack, and Billy decide to follow his lead; while Tommy and Kimberly do not. Tommy and Kimberly roll their own Initiative. Jason rolls a 13 for his Initiative, adding +2 from his Initiative modifier, but also adding +3 from his teammates joining in for a final result of 18. Each rolling 1d4 to subtract from Jason’s 18, Trini ends up with a 17, while Zack and Billy both end up at 15.

weapon mastery.t: At 2nd level, you are focused on making the most out of your Power Weapon attacks. Whenever you roll a 1 or 2 on a skill die for an attack you make with your Power Weapon, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll, even if the new roll is a 1 or a 2.

When piloting your personal Zord, you cannot suffer Snags when using the Driving skill. You now have access to a powerful construct of a particular kind based upon the Power Ranger team you are a part of. These are the various Zords, Borgs, and Power vehicles that the Rangers summon to aid them when the monsters and other minions of evil are empowered by warlords like Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa. Rules and statistics surrounding Zords can be found in the section starting on page 131. Red Ranger Zords What sort of shape a Red Ranger’s Zord takes depends on the kind of Power Ranger Team they are a part of. Examples of previously chosen Zords are: • Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Tyrannosaurus Rex, Red Dragon • Ninja Power Rangers: Red Ape • Alien Rangers: Red Battle Borg • Power Rangers Zeo: Phoenix • Power Rangers Turbo: Red Lightning Racer • Space Rangers: Mega V1 Robot Zord Feature Upon reaching 6th level, then again at 10th, 14th, and 17th levels, a Ranger’s connection and proficiency with their Zord has strengthened and evolved to a place where their abilities while using it are stronger and more powerful than ever. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 10th level and four when you reach 15th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

let’s bring ‘em together!.t: Starting at 5th level, your connection to the team and all of your Power Weapons is strong enough to allow you to collect all of them together to create a special combined form of weapon that unleashes a devastating team-based attack. You may, as a Standard action, spend 1 Personal Power to begin the Let’s Bring ‘Em Together process, taking a Contingency action with the trigger of “When all of my teammate’s Power Weapons are joined, we will combine our attack on…” naming the target of the attack. For this feature to function, each other teammate must move to be adjacent to you and name the same Contingency action trigger. When all of your teammates have moved to be adjacent, spent the 1 Personal Power, and named the appropriate Contingency action trigger, your team collectively triggers the Contingency actions and the combined Power Weapon attack takes place. The ranged attack has a Reach of 100/250, gains an additional ↑2 to hit using your attack traits and abilities, but inflicts 1 damage upon a successful hit per participating member. After the attack takes place, the team’s Power Weapons are returned to them as normal.

grid power.t: First upon reaching 6th level, then again at 11th and 16th levels, your understanding and connection to the power that flows from the Morphin Grid in ways other Rangers may not. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you may choose a Grid Power (see page 99) to add to your Ranger, so long as they meet the requirements, if any.

resilience.t: Upon achieving 7th level, your ability to stand firm against the enemies of your team makes you far more resistant to damage when you willfully defend against it. While Morphed, when targeted by any attack you were aware of, you may choose to spend 1 Personal Power and roll your Athletics skill die. You reduce all incoming attacks by the amount rolled until the start of your next turn.

team focus.t: Starting at 9th level, Red Rangers are efficient at finishing off enemies that have been damaged but not vanquished by their teammates. You add a ↑1 to any melee attack that targets a target that has already been attacked by your teammate since your last turn. Beginning at 18th level, this bonus is increased to ↑2.

red ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s Red Ranger. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • Resistance to Blunt and Sharp damage • Additional point of damage with Power Weapon attacks • Gain Edge on Strengthbased Skill Tests

roles.intro: Chosen for their understanding of the arts, both creative and martial, candidates to accept the power of the Yellow Ranger should be clever, witty, and full of originality.

soul of the team.t: Where other Rangers of the Spectrum fill certain roles like inventor, leader, or supporting healer, Yellow Rangers are like the water in which their boats sail upon. A Yellow Ranger is a friend, a confidante, and always ready to stand shoulder-to-shoulder or back-to-back with one or more of their teammates. Their team can count on them to be there, chipping away at and coming up with solutions for the same problems and obstacles the team might face.

right place, right time.t: Speed. Speed is part of what makes a Yellow Ranger able to be in many places at once, and capable of lending their help when it is needed most. Yet this is not the kind of speed that is measured in races and sprints. It is not merely how far they can run, it is the ability to act on the go, and put their skills to good use here, there, and anywhere they are needed as they maneuver through a conflict.

hands on fighter.t: Yellow Rangers have the fastest hands and feet on a Power Ranger team. While other Rangers might hit harder or at a distance, Yellow Rangers are empowered to strike fast and furiously up close. What another warrior might inflict with a single blow that could be turned aside or dodged, these Rangers strike from every different angle. Their foes are worn down in seconds, and they might never have realized where the tidal wave of blows ever even came from.

it’s morphin time!.t: Starting at 1st level, by summoning the energy within you through your Power Morpher and saying the words “It’s Morphin Time!” as a Standard action, you are enveloped with a stylized shell of Morphin Grid energy that serves as your armor, grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • Your Toughness Bonus is determined by your Armor Training: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra-Heavy (+6). • All of your Jump distance maximums are tripled. • As a Free action, you can summon any single Power-based weapon to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious, and at 1 Health.

triple strike attacks.t: Yellow Rangers at 1st level have already begun to show their talent at unleashing flurries of blows. You can, whenever you make an Finesse attack action, spend a Personal Power to make an attack with each of your hands at no penalty, and then make a third, Follow-Up martial arts attack at a target of one of the previous strikes. This follow-up attack (often a kick, elbow, or headbutt) has a variable skill die based on your Yellow Ranger level, shown on the table above.

nimble fighter.t: Starting at 2nd level, you use the agility of the Yellow Ranger to weave through a combat delivering blows wherever they are needed. After each successful melee attack, you may immediately move 5 feet in any viable direction. This movement is free and additional to any other movement you might make during your turn.

strike bonus.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, you are able to infuse your Morphin Grid power into your melee attacks while Morphed. At the beginning of any round you may spend 1 Personal Power to apply a ↑1 shift to the first melee attack you make during your action. This shift increases by 1 at 5th, 8th, and 11th levels.

zords.t: By the time a Ranger reaches 3rd level, their role in protecting the Morphin Grid requires them to battle larger and more devastating foes. When piloting your personal Zord, you cannot suffer Snags when using the Driving skill. You now have access to a powerful construct of a particular kind based upon the Power Ranger team you are a part of. These are the various Zords, Borgs, and Power vehicles that the Rangers summon to aid them when the monsters and other minions of evil are empowered by warlords like Lord Zedd and Rita Repulsa. Rules and statistics surrounding Zords can be found in the section starting on page 131. Yellow Ranger Zords What sort of shape a Yellow Ranger’s Zord takes depends on the kind of Power Ranger Team they are a part of. Examples of previously chosen Zords are: • Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Sabretooth Tiger, Griffin • Ninja Power Rangers: Bear • Alien Rangers: Yellow Battle Borg • Power Rangers Zeo: Artillery Tower • Power Rangers Turbo: Dune Star Racer • Space Rangers: Mega V4 Rover Zord Feature Upon reaching 6th level, then again at 10th, 14th, and 17th levels, a Ranger’s connection and proficiency with their Zord has strengthened and evolved to a place where their abilities while using it are stronger and more powerful than ever. Each time this Role Perk is acquired by a Yellow Ranger, they may choose from the list of Zord Features (see page 136 for details) to apply to their personal Zord.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you have the ability to personalize your Ranger a little further and must choose to gain a generic Perk of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 15th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual. Additionally, the extra attacks aren’t split into multiple attacks by the Triple Strike Attacks Role Perk. They are singular attacks added to the Standard attack action.

grid power.t: First upon reaching 6th level, then again at 11th and 16th levels, your understanding and connection to the power that flows from the Morphin Grid in ways other Rangers may not. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you may choose a Grid Power (see page 99) to add to your Ranger, so long as they meet the requirements, if any.

exploit weakness.t: Upon reaching 7th level, the Yellow Ranger can see ways around a creature’s strengths, turning them into weaknesses. You can, after making a melee attack against a target with augmented defenses of some kind, make a DIF 14 Alertness Skill Test. If successful, you and your teammates may ignore one of the target’s defense bonuses (Resistance, Armor bonus, etc.) with your attacks until the end of the scene. At 15th level, your ability to see weaknesses allows you and your team to ignore all Defense augmentative bonuses the target might possess.

whirlwind strike.t: Starting at 9th level, Yellow Rangers can unleash a deadly spinning attack at groups of enemies surrounding them. You can, by expending 1 Personal Power while Morphed, allow your attack action’s melee attacks to target every enemy adjacent to you until the end of the round. You still only make a single attack Skill Test, but the result is applied to all enemies adjacent to you similar to an Area of Effect ranged attack.

lighting fast.t: A 13th level Yellow Ranger is capable of flashing like a burst lightning to a specific location in the blink of an eye. By spending 1 Personal Power while Morphed, instead of moving normally, you can instantly appear anywhere within 60 feet and line of sight of your current location. While this is treated like a miniature teleportation, you do actually sprint and/or jump to reach this new location; it is just so fast, no one can see you doing so.

devastating strike.t: Upon achieving 18th level, the Yellow Ranger’s melee attacks can find the precise point on a target to inflict maximum damage. You now inflict triple damage when you make a critical hit on a target instead of the normal double damage.

yellow ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s Yellow Ranger. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • Resistance to Blunt and Sharp damage • Additional point of damage on Finesse attacks • Gain Edge on Speedbased Skill Tests

roles.intro: Like the wavelength of light itself that it represents, the White energy of the Morphin Grid is like the raw energy pouring into the prism to be split into the necessary parts for the team to be at its best.

elevated champion.t: Not just any candidate can become one with the White energy. They need to hold the concept of the Morphin Grid’s power close to their hearts and stand as its very champion. White Rangers are not always the leaders of their teams, but they cannot ignore their will and desire to stand at the forefront and protect their teammates. A White Ranger will fight to the bitter end for their friends.

valiant leader.t: White Rangers frequently fall into the role of leading their Ranger teams, and their skills and abilities only augment this. They fight bravely, they defend fearlessly, and they orchestrate their fellow Rangers to work together as a better team. The White energy in the Spectrum comes with a strong need to stand against the enemies of good, and those who wield it are often the legends remembered throughout history.

ranger and zord as one.t: Unlike the other wavelengths found in the Spectrum, White energy focuses itself through the Grid using unique and powerful relics, like Tommy’s beloved tiger-blade, Saba. This somehow connects the inner essence of the White Rangers to their Morphin Grid constructs tighter than that between a normal Ranger’s Morpher and their Zord, Borg, etc. This is why it seems that White Rangers bring new and special kinds of Zords to fight alongside those of their teams. Their Zords are just as worthy of leading the charge as they are.

grid relic weapon.t: Once chosen to wield the White energy of the Morphin Grid, the newly created White Ranger is gifted a powerful and unique Grid relic weapon through which they can control it. At 1st level, you are given this truly wondrous item that inflicts energy damage with its attacks, plus one level in a special Might or Finesse (Grid Relic) specialization. Unlike other skills, this weapon’s skill die is based upon your level in White Ranger, as shown on the table above. Additionally, your Grid relic starts with two of the following Relic Weapon Traits: Zord Control: The Grid Relic is key to controlling your Zord, halving the time it takes to summon it and giving you ↑1 to hit with your Zord’s attacks. Energy Blasts: The Grid Relic is capable of firing three power blasts per day, each one with a Reach of 100 feet and a ↑1 shift to hit. follow me!.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, the White Ranger’s leadership skills are just beginning to shine. At the beginning of any combat, instead of rolling their own Initiative, your teammates may always choose to instead set their Initiative as 1d4 lower than yours (minimum final result of 1). They must choose to follow this Role Perk before you roll your Initiative result, but each team member who chooses to do this emboldens you and adds +1 to your result. For example, Tommy uses Follow Me! at the beginning of a fight with Rito and a flock of Tengas. Adam, Kimberly, and Rocky decide to follow his lead; while Billy and Aisha do not. Billy and Aisha roll their own Initiative. Tommy rolls an 11 for his Initiative, adding +3 from his Initiative modifier, but also adding +3 from his teammates joining in for a final result of 17. Each rolling 1d4 to subtract from Tommy’s 17, Adam and Rocky end up with a 16, while Kimberly ends up at 14.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you have the ability to personalize your Ranger a little further and must choose to gain a General Perk of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 13th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

inspiration.t: When a White Ranger reaches 5th level, they know how to verbally inspire their allies, whether they are in their normal form, Morphed, piloting their Zord, or part of a combined Megaform! By taking a Free action to say something positive and uplifting to a member of their team, that member may add 1d4 to the result of any d20 roll on their next turn. The die increases to 1d6 at 10th level, and to 1d8 at 15th level.

grid power.t: First upon reaching 6th level, then again at 11th and 16th levels, your understanding and connection to the power that flows from the Morphin Grid in ways other Rangers may not. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you may choose a Grid Power (see page 99) to add to your Ranger, so long as they meet the requirements, if any.

shining leader.t: When you get to 8th level, you stand as the tip of the shining spear against your enemies, and your teammates know victory is assured if they stand behind you. Once per scene, you can spend 1 Personal Power and a Standard action while Morphed to take a flashy posture and make a spectacle out of yourself to embolden your allies. For the rest of that round and the following round, all of your allies gain Edge on their attack Skill Tests.

sidestep.t: At 9th level, you can sidestep danger and dodge certain area effect attacks, such as the slime barrage from the Goo Fish or a strafe from Lord Zedd’s eyebeams. When you are subjected to an attack that has an Area of Effect that targets your Evasion, you may spend a point of Personal Power to reduce the attack result by the number rolled on your Acrobatics skill die.

at all costs.t: At 18th level, you have formed a connection with your team strong enough to surprise you with what you are capable of on their behalf. You can, once per day, fight beyond reaching 0 Health while Morphed. Instead of being Defeated or returning to your normal form, you may continue to fight normally. During this time, when an enemy successfully hits you, you lose 1 Personal Power instead of losing Health. If, at any time during this feature’s use, you reach 0 Personal Power, you immediately return to your normal form at 0 Health, with the conditions Unconscious and Defeated. This is a dangerous Role Perk, and is normally only called upon when the team is truly in trouble.

white ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s White Ranger. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 to all Defenses • Additional point of damage with Zord (non-Megaform) Attacks • Edge on Strength-based Skill Tests

roles.intro: The Gold Ranger’s radiant energy exists between the Black Ranger’s stalwart nature and the Red Ranger’s noble leadership.

protect the team.t: Many of a Gold Ranger’s abilities allow them to take surprising amounts of punishment in a fight. They commonly use this boundless tenacity to absorb attacks and take the hits for their team. A Gold Ranger wades into battle, careless of danger, knowing that every strike that sparks off their shell or armor is one less hit their friends might take.

bravery personified.t: The Morphin Grid’s empowerment to make Gold Rangers tougher than your average Power Ranger gives the Gold Ranger confidence to face any danger. Like one of King Arthur’s knights of Camelot, a Gold Ranger does not waver against any threat and will never back down when it counts. Such selfless bravery does not go unnoticed; a Gold Ranger’s teammates often feel emboldened and encouraged no matter how high the stakes.

a shining example.t: When candidates accept the Morphin Grid’s Gold energy into their Ranger form, they take on the responsibility of becoming the protective hub of their team. The Gold Rangers often crave the spotlight, attract attention to themselves, and weather any storm their provocative attitude might LEVEL ROLE PERK PERSONAL POWER CAPACITY HARDENED ARMOR STRENGTH INCREASE SPEED INCREASE SMARTS INCREASE SOCIAL INCREASE 1st Hardened Armor, It’s Morphin Time!, Zord 2 +1 +2 — — +1 2nd Golden Guardian 2 +1 — — — +1 3rd Zord Feature 2 +1 — +1 — — 4th General Perk 2 +2 — — +1 — 5th Extra Attack 4 +2 +1 — — — 6th Grid Power, Zord Feature 4 +2 — — — +1 7th Stand Behind Me! 4 +2 — +1 — — 8th General Perk 4 +3 — — +1 — 9th Counterstrike 6 +3 +1 — — — 10th Zord Feature 6 +3 — — — +1 11th Grid Power, Resilience 6 +3 — +1 — — 12th General Perk 6 +4 — — +1 — 13th Multi-Counter 8 +4 +1 — — — 14th Zord Feature 8 +4 — — — +1 15th Extra Attack (2) 8 +4 — +1 — — 16th General Perk, Grid Power 8 +5 +1 — — — 17th Zord Feature 10 +5 — — — +1 18th Splinter Defense 10 +5 +1 — — — 19th General Perk 10 +5 — — — +1 20th Gold Ranger Prime +5 +1 — — — attract. Morphin Grid energy envelopes you, giving you a stylized shell of Grid energy that serves as your armor, and grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • You gain a Toughness bonus depending on your Armor Proficiency: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra-Heavy (+6). • You triple all your Jump distance maximums. • As a Free action, you can summon a Powerbased or Laser-based weapon to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious, at 1 Health.

hardened armor.t: A Gold Ranger’s armored shell, even at 1st level, is more durable than that of any other Power Ranger. Starting at 1st level, your Toughness Defense increases while Morphed. The bonus found in Table 2-11: Gold Ranger rises as you gain more experience in this Role. Additionally, after suffering a damage type other than Blunt or Sharp, you gain Resistance to that damage type (attacks that deal that damage type have a Snag, and you reduce damage by half when the effect is unavoidable) for the remainder of the scene. Resistance from Hardened Armor applies to each damage type. For example, Elizabeth’s Gold Ranger Vatra suffers Fire damage in one turn, so she gains resistance to Fire damage for the rest of the scene. In the next turn, she takes Energy damage, so she has resistance to Fire and Energy damage until the end of the scene.

zord.t: At 1st level, you have access to a powerful construct based on your Power Ranger team. These are the various Zords, Borgs, and Power vehicles that the Rangers summon to aid them in battle. When piloting this personal Zord, you cannot suffer Snags while CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS making Skill Tests using the Driving Skill.
