golden guardian.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, protecting your fellow teammates is instinctive. If an attack hits an adjacent ally, you can spend 1 Personal Power to intercept the attack and take the hit yourself. Golden Guardian cannot change whether the attack hits, misses, inflicts damage, is a Critical Success, or the like; you take all the effects caused by the attack.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can personalize your Ranger by adding a General Perk for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 15th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

grid power.t: Upon reaching 6th level, and again at 11th and 16th levels, you expand your understanding and connection to the Morphin Grid. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, choose a Grid Power for which you meet the requirements for to add to your Ranger.

stand behind me!.t: At 7th level, you stand as a shining beacon of your team’s battle against evil. At the beginning of any round when Morphed, you can spend 1 Personal Power to force all enemies within 60 feet of you to target you in their attacks unless they succeed at a DIF 14 Alertness Skill Test.

counterstrike.t: Beginning at 9th level, the Gold Ranger has mastered the art of making their enemies pay for attacking the Ranger’s teammates. While Morphed, if you call upon the Golden Guardian Role Perk, you may immediately make a single attack against the foe who attacked your teammate.

resilience.t: Upon reaching 11th level, your ability to stand firm against the enemies of your team makes you far more resistant to damage when you willfully defend against it. While Morphed, when targeted by an attack you are aware of, you may spend 1 Personal Power and roll your Athletics Skill die. Add the Skill die result to all your Defenses until the start of your next turn.

multi-counter.t: As of 13th level, you become a golden sentinel for adjacent allies. When you activate your Golden Guardian Role Perk, you can intercept any number of attacks targeting adjacent allies, such as from a villain who can make multiple attacks or attack multiple targets in a round. You may Counterstrike for each strike you intercept.

splinter defense.t: At 18th level, your Golden Ranger shell is so dense and durable that any creature that successfully hits you with a melee Attack automatically suffers an Initiative penalty equal to your hardened armor Role Perk bonus. This Role Perk can only affect each target once per combat scene.

gold ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s Gold Ranger. Your Morphed form gains the following benefits: • You gain +2 to all Defenses • An additional point of damage on Megaform Zord Attacks your Zord is part of • Edge on Strength Skill Tests

roles.intro: Silver energy flows through the Morphin Grid, seeking to infuse candidates with an extraordinary symbiosis between a Ranger and their Grid constructs.

perfect tool for the job.t: Silver Rangers are jacks of all trades, embracing the Morphin Grid’s flexibility to solve a problem or overcome an obstacle. The same goes for having the right weapon for the enemy standing against them—a Silver Ranger urges the Morphin Grid to create the best way to defeat evil and defend the innocent.

team player or not?.t: Like their Green and White colleagues, Silver Rangers are excellent additions to Power Ranger teams but often tend to work alone. Akin to how the Silver Ranger calls on the right tool for the job, Champions of the Morphin Grid call out for their Silver Ranger allies when the time is right. Nothing keeps a Silver Ranger from staying with a team following the call to duty, but it often seems they fade away shortly after the threat is dealt with unless they feel the team needs them around.

always a silver ranger.t: While there may not be a Silver Ranger on every Power Ranger team across time and space, at least one candidate exists in each corner of the universe and every dimension. When the time is right, the Grid connects the Silver energy to a candidate and sends them to other Rangers’ aid. power heal.t: One of the first things a Silver Ranger learns is to call on the Morphin Grid to repair their Morphed form in the heat of battle. At 1st level, you can spend Personal Power as a Free action to heal yourself for 1 Health per point of Personal Power spent. The amount of Health recovered per point of Personal Power spent using this Role Perk increases to 2 Health at 7th level and finally to 4 Health at 13th level.

danger sense.t: Silver Rangers develop sharp eyes and quick reflexes when working alone. At 2nd level, you CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS hone your senses for self-preservation beyond that of a typical Ranger. You gain ↑2 to your Alertness Skill Tests, have Edge on Skill tests to avoid traps and ambushes, and re-roll 1s and 2s on Initiative Skill dice.

grid surge.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, you learn how to channel Grid energies to create something helpful directly into your hands. As a Standard action while Morphed, you can activate a Grid Surge as many times per day as shown in Table 2–12: Silver Ranger. You may choose one of these four effects each time you activate this perk. • You can create a temporary construct that is a tool or item needed at the moment that lasts for one hour. When you create the object, choose one Skill. The construct tool grants you Edge on Skill Tests with the selected skill. • You can change the shape and type of your Power Weapon until you leave your Morphed form, such as changing a light dagger to a versatile staff or a two-handed trident. • You can increase your Morphed form’s armor bonus to Toughness Defense by 1 for 1d6 × 10 minutes. You can choose this multiple times, up to a +3 cumulative bonus. • You can speed up the arrival of any Zords currently en route to the scene by 1 round. You can choose this multiple times in the same scene.

power boost.t: Starting at 3rd level, you can call upon the Grid to boost your Power Weapon attacks. As a Free action, you may spend two Personal Power to activate this perk. While active, you inflict an additional point of Energy damage with each Power Weapon attack. This bonus Energy damage increases to two points at 10th level and three at 17th level.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can personalize your Ranger by adding a General Perk for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 15th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an Individual.

grid power.t: Upon reaching 6th level, and again at 11th and 16th levels, you expand your understanding and connection to the Morphin Grid. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, choose a Grid Power for which you meet the requirements for to add to your Ranger.

duty of the silver.t: At 7th level, the Morphin Grid calls upon the Silver Ranger as much as the Silver Ranger calls upon it. You can spend one of your Grid Surges and 2 Personal Power to instantly teleport to the closest concentration of Power Rangers on that dimension or timeline. Additionally, you gain the Heavy Armor proficiency automatically. If you already have the Heavy Armor proficiency, you gain the Ultra-Heavy Armor proficiency instead.

power adaptation.t: At 9th level, and then again at 18th level, your Morphed form evolves in new ways. Choose one of the following improvements on Table 2–13: Power Adaptations to your Morphed form; each requires Personal Power to activate. NAME COST EFFECT Boost of Speed 1 Personal Power Increase Movement by 20 feet for 1d6 minutes. Crushing Strength 1 Personal Power Gain ↑2 to all Athletics and Brawn Skill Tests for 1d6 minutes. Striking Hands 1 Personal Power Gain ↑1 to your unarmed Attacks for 1d6 minutes. Fast Trigger 2 Personal Power Make one additional ranged Attack per Attack action for the next 1d6 combat rounds. Regenerating Shell 2 Personal Power Restore 1 Health at the end of each of your turns for 1d6 turns.

silver ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of your team’s Silver Ranger. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • You gain +2 to all Defenses • You deal an additional point of damage on all Attacks in the first turn of a combat scene. • Enemies suffer Snag when attacking your Willpower Defense.

roles.intro: Born of a project to explore the Morphin Grid in the time of the Morphin Masters, the Phantom Rangers are a force to be reckoned with if they appear in your time and space.

servants of the masterforge.t: The Phantom Rangers are not a structured collective or policing agency. They are agents of the Masterforge, performing the prescribed duties of the Morphin Masters. No one has determined where the Phantom Rangers get their instructions from, but they always appear precisely when and where they are needed most. The Grid deploys Phantom Rangers to the places and times where they can make an impact, even if the Phantom Rangers themselves aren’t always sure how or why they the Grid sent them. Many Power Rangers and Morphin Grid scholars believe that the Phantom Rangers’ various calls to action might be carved into reality by the Masterforge itself.

ghosts in the grid.t: From the initial empowering of the first Phantom Suite of armor and powers, the Morphin Masters discovered the existence of entities within the Morphin Grid that represent the antitheses of the light of the Morphin Grid, spirits of personified darkness. One amongst them, the Dark Specter (who would later become the Grand Monarch of Evil), drew his entire world of Infernus into the war for control over the Morphin Grid energy spectrum. Beings of darkness trying to claim the light, Dark Specter and his ilk do so primarily by inserting themselves and their villainous agents throughout time and space. When they do, they can strike at the hearts of the Morphin Grid champions during moments of weakness. The universe remains safe from Dark Specter’s machinations only through the actions of valiant Power Rangers and the Phantom Rangers among them.

wherever, whenever, however.t: To wage the Morphin Masters’ eternal war against the opportunistic United Alliance of Evil, the Phantom Rangers adapted their tactics to the enemy. These enigmatic Power Rangers appear through the CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS LEVEL ROLE PERK PERSONAL POWER CAPACITY BURST SPEED STRENGTH INCREASE SPEED INCREASE SMARTS INCREASE SOCIAL INCREASE 1st It’s Morphin Time!, Phantom Ship, Phantom Suite (+2) 2 — +1 +1 +1 — 2nd Follow Through 2 5 feet — — +1 — 3rd Ship Feature 3 5 feet — — — +1 4th General Perk 3 10 feet — +1 — — 5th Extra Attack, Mending the Grid 4 10 feet +1 — — — 6th Ageless Knowledge, Grid Power, Ship Feature 4 15 feet — — +1 — 7th Phantom Suite (+3) 5 15 feet — — — +1 8th Body of Energy, General Perk 5 20 feet — +1 — — 9th Unseen Strike 6 20 feet +1 — — — 10th Phantom Focus I, Ship Feature 6 25 feet — — +1 — 11th Grid Power 7 25 feet — — — +1 12th General Perk, Phantom Suite (+4) 7 30 feet — +1 — — 13th Extra Attack (2) 8 30 feet +1 — — — 14th Ship Feature 8 35 feet — — +1 — 15th Phantom Focus II 9 35 feet — — — +1 16th General Perk, Grid Power 9 40 feet +1 — — — 17th Phantom Suite (+5), Ship Feature 10 40 feet — — +1 — 18th Through the Arches 10 45 feet +1 — — — 19th General Perk 11 45 feet — — +1 — 20th Phantom Ranger Prime 11 50 feet +1 — — — Morphin Grid across time and space to balance the scales of light versus darkness. Sometimes they phase into the activities of a Power Ranger team to lend their aid for one decisive combat, for an extended time to batt

spectrum role features.t: As a Phantom Ranger, you gain the following: Power Personal Power Regeneration: 3 per day Personal Power Capacity: +1 per 3 levels Training Armor: Light and Medium Armor Skill Ranks: +1 Athletics, +1 Finesse, +1 Culture Grid Equipment You start with your possessions from your preMorphin life and gain the following items from the Morphin Grid. Those marked with an asterisk are only available when Morphed. • Gridwide Communicator • Phantom Key/Focus • Phantom Laser*

it’s morphin time!.t: Starting at 1st level, you can summon the energy within you by using your Power Morpher and saying the words “It’s Morphin Time!” as a Standard action. Morphin Grid energy envelopes you, giving you a stylized shell of Grid energy that serves as your armor, and grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • You gain a Toughness bonus depending on your Armor Proficiency: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra-Heavy (+6). • You triple all your Jump distance maximums. • As a Free action, you can summon a Powerbased or Laser-based weapon to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious and at 1 Health.

phantom ship.t: Advanced Spectrum Rangers’ duties to protect the Morphin Grid carry expectations above those of the typical Spectrum. For many, this means a specialized Zord, but a Phantom Ranger gains access to their Phantom Ship at 1st level. The Phantom Ship is a mobile base of operations that travels across space and takes on mighty threats. Despite being more of a traditional vehicle than a typical Zord, the Phantom Ship still follows all the same rules and statistics surrounding Zords found in the section starting on page 131 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. All rules and references to Zords also apply to the Phantom Ship. When piloting the Phantom Ship, you cannot suffer Snags when using the Driving Skill. Ship Feature Upon reaching 3rd level, and again at 6th, 10th, 14th, and 17th levels, a Phantom Ranger’s connection and proficiency with their Phantom Ship strengthens and evolves. Each time your Phantom Ranger gains this Role Perk, they may choose from the list of available Zord Features and apply it to their Phantom Ship.

phantom suite.t: Phantom Rangers get their name from the suite of powers, tools, armor that allow them to appear as an apparition that can vanish from view, becoming an outline of shimming translucency. At 1st level, this Role Perk allows you, while Morphed, to spend 1 Personal Power to become semi-invisible. You remain in this semi-invisible state until you take damage from an Attack against your Evasion Defense. While the Phantom Suite is active, you gain ↑1 and Edge to all Infiltration (Stealth) Skill Tests and a +2 bonus to your Evasion Defense. Additionally, your semi-invisibility Evasion Defense bonus increases as you gain Role levels, increasing to +3 at 7th, +4 at 12th, and +5 at 17th level.

follow through.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, the Phantom Ranger gains specialized techniques for hit-and-run attacks. While Morphed and fighting as an individual, the first time each round you Defeat an enemy target with a Might or Finesse Attack Skill Test, you may move a distance equal to your Burst Speed (see Table 2–14: Phantom Ranger) and immediately make the same Attack against another target. Your Burst Speed Movement ignores all obstacles, enemies, and rough terrain and increases as you increase in Role Level. To the naked eye, this movement almost seems like the Phantom Ranger is blinking in and out of existence or time, and, at higher Role Levels, you are!

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, CHARACTER OPTIONS CHARACTER OPTIONS 16th, and 19th level, you can personalize your Ranger by adding a General Perk for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 13th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

mending the grid.t: Upon reaching 5th level, Phantom Rangers see the changes their actions have made to strengthen, mend, and ward the fabric of the Morphin Grid. Despite cryptic missions and strange orders, your confidence that your every effort matters grows, even if only you and the Masters see the fruits of this labor. You may now spend a Story Point to re-roll any failed Skill Test (instead of just results of 1), and when you do so, the re-rolled Skill Test gains a ↑2 bonus!

grid power.t: Upon reaching 6th level, and again at 11th and 16th levels, you expand your understanding and connection to the Morphin Grid. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, choose a Grid Power for which you meet the requirements for to add to your Ranger.

ageless knowledge.t: At 6th level, a Phantom Ranger gains access to the seemingly limitless data compiled from the various eras, alternate dimensions, and anywhere the Phantom Rangers are called to serve. This Role Perk represents your access to these pieces of information as needed. By spending 1 Personal Power and a Free action to tap into the Phantom energy data, even when not Morphed, you may remove the unskilled penalty from any single kill for 1 minute.

body of energy.t: When you reach 8th level as a Phantom Ranger, your body transforms almost entirely into Grid Energy when you Morph into your Phantom Suite. Narratively, when you are injured, and an injury pierces your Phantom Suite armor, you leak pure Grid Energy into the air as a steady, prismatic seepage. While Morphed, your Health and Personal Power points are interchangeable, becoming one pool of Personal Power. When you spend or lose Health or Power for any reason, you reduce your combined pool accordingly. When you exit your Morphed form for any reason other than being Defeated, your Health and Personal Power return to a value equal to half of your remaining combined pool points.

unseen strike.t: At 9th level, you have learned how to improve your fighting abilities by incorporating your Phantom Suite’s stealth advantages. On your first Attack Skill Test each turn while your Phantom Suite is active, the target halves (rounding up) their Evasion Defense against the Attack, making it much easier to get a Critical Success or additional degrees of success against your target!

phantom focus.t: By 10th level, you’ve learned to customize your Morpher, the Phantom Key or Phantom Focus, for the challenges of mending the Grid anywhere and at any time. First at 10th level, and then again at 15th level, you may choose one of the following Phantom Focus abilities to augment your Morphed form permanently. You can only select any single ability once. • Boosted Vigor: The sheer power within your Phantom Key or Focus saturates every cell in your body when you tap into it. While Morphed, you gain 3 Temporary Health. When you exit your Morphed form, these additional Health disappear. • Healing Light: By focusing Power through your Phantom Key or Focus to mend, you may spend 1 Personal Power and 1 Health to heal 2d2 Health to any target. Alternatively (or in addition), you may spend 1 Personal Power and 1 Health to remove all current poisons and adverse Conditions from the target. • Multiversal Pocket: While Morphed, you have access to a small, 10 foot × 10 foot extradimensional storage pocket. As a Standard action, you can reach in and deposit or remove any non-living object you wish from this personal pocket void. The pocket exists outside of time and space, and items deposited within are held in stasis. This stasis freezes objects in time and prevents decay or spoilage. The pocket void immediately forces out any living thing you attempt to store in it. • Phase Defense: Your Phantom Suite bends time and space as much as it bends light around you. When your Phantom Suite Role Pe

through the arches.t: At 18th level, you have become one of the Morphin Grid’s Phantom Ranger champions and easily travel across time and space. In the times of the Masterforges, travel into and out of the Morphin Grid required special gates called Arches. You have updated your suit to work like the Arches of ancient lore. By spending 2 Personal Power, you and your ship can pass “through the Arches,” vanishing in a flash of dazzling light and reappearing within 30 feet of any object, person, or place integrated with Morphin Grid energy. When you pass through the Arches in this way, you usually have control over where and when you appear, but the Grid works in mysterious ways. You can take other beings with you, provided they are physically touching you and capable of spending the same amount of Personal Power that you do. While you are accustomed to traversing across the Morphin Grid between realities, others are not. Characters who travel with you and do not have this Role Perk arrive befuddled by the transfer and suffer Snag on all Skill Tests for 1 minute after arrival.

phantom ranger prime.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of the hidden Morphin Grid’s faction of Phantom Rangers. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 to all Defenses • Deal 1 extra point of damage (choose type when you hit) on unarmed Attacks • Edge on Skill Tests when using a Grid Power Expanding Skills for Space Just as Earth-bound Power Rangers Roleplaying Game campaigns use Skill Tests to determine what happens when there’s a chance for an exciting

roles.intro: Continuing to explore new character options, this section presents a new Core Role, the Dark Ranger as shown by Heckyl, and two new Ranger Spectrum shift options: the Aqua Ranger, a modified Blue Ranger, and the Graphite Ranger, a modified…

fear is power.t: The Dark energy of the Grid attaches itself to the Dark Rangers impulses, thrumming and surging the more its hosts resist its call. When Dark Rangers cause panic and fear within their immediate surroundings, the Dark energy stabilizes and becomes easier to control. These Rangers carry immense potential at the cost of a war with themselves; if they cannot generate enough terror, their Dark energy lashes out to create it for them.

an important decision.t: Though born in darkness, a Dark Ranger can still take control of their own destiny. Some Dark Rangers only use their Dark energy to protect the people they care about. In time, a Dark Ranger may see the light and take on a different role in the Ranger Spectrum. The choice is always in the Ranger’s hands, no matter their beginnings or the company they keep.

vibrance in darkness.t: The Morphin shell of a Dark Ranger takes its colors from other parts of the Ranger Spectrum. They may appear similar to a Red or Black Ranger, though Purple, White, and Green-semblant Dark Rangers are the most common. While a Dark Ranger can manifest an identical physical image to their teammates, their Dark Energy often twists their shell’s visage with sharper, more dramatic shapes and stripes.

terror.t: Your Dark energy accumulates power from the fear of others. Starting at 1st Level, you gain 1 Terror whenever you deal damage or inflict a Condition on another character as a result of a Skill Test you have Edge on (provided they aren’t immune to being Frightened). You can carry a maximum amount of Terror equal to the Terror Capacity value listed on the Dark Ranger table above, losing all accrued Terror at the start of a new day. You can spend any amount of accrued Terror to deal the same number of additional points of damage on your Attacks.

menacing glare.t: At 2nd level, you can impose your ill will onto those around you. As a Standard action, you can spend 1 Personal Power to make an Intimidation Skill Test against a target’s Willpower. Upon success, you can impose one of the following effects on the target until the end of your next turn: • The target suffers Snag on the next Skill Test they perform. • You have Edge on the next Skill Test you make against the target. • The target is Frightened of you.

spite.t: It’s not always about being the victor. Sometimes it’s about seeing them lose. At 2nd Level, whenever you miss your Attack Skill Test against a creature, you can spend 1 Personal Power to manifest your ire, providing Edge to the next Attack against your target. This effect ends at the start of your next turn or the first time the target is successfully attacked.

zord.t: At 3rd level, you have access to a powerful construct based on your Power Ranger team. These are the various Zords, Borgs, and Power vehicles that the Rangers summon to aid them in battle. When piloting this personal Zord, you cannot suffer Snags while making Skill Tests using the Driving Skill. Rules and statistics for Zords start on page 131 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. Terrorzords Unlike other Rangers, a Dark Ranger’s energy shapes their Zord into a Terrorzord, a wicked, beastlike machine that is notoriously difficult to control. The only example of previous Terrorzords are the ones Lord Zedd bestowed upon the Dark Rangers.

terrorzord nature.t: Your Terrorzord has several special properties that set it apart from other Zords: • Your Terrorzord has a Smarts Score of 5 and a Social Score of 4. It uses its movement as it wants to at the start of your turn unless you succeed on a DIF 10 Driving Skill Test. • You can spend your accrued Terror to boost your Terrorzord, granting it ↑1 on a Skill Test for each Terror you spend. • You lose 1 Personal Power whenever you roll a natural 1 while driving your Terrorzord. choose from the list of available Zord Features to apply to their Zord.

grid power.t: Upon reaching 6th level, and again at 11th and 16th levels, you expand your understanding and connection to the Morphin Grid. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, choose a Grid Power for which you meet the requirements to add to your Ranger.

menacing laugh.t: Starting at 7th Level, the Dark Ranger can savor the terror of their victims to reinvigorate their powers. As a Free action, once per turn, you can spend 1 Terror to regenerate 1 Personal Power.

fe-burn!.t: You’ve grown clever to the instability of Dark energy by the time you’ve reached 7th level. While Morphed and have at least 1 Terror accrued, when you take damage from any attack that you were aware of, you can spend all your Terror to cause your shell to burst into vibrant flames to reduce the incoming damage by half. For each Terror you spend, you can target an enemy adjacent to you to take Energy damage equal to the other half of the damage you would have taken. You immediately un-Morph after using this Role Perk.

unlucky (for you).t: When you reach 13th level, you can seed misfortune into your attacks to generate more Terror. Whenever you successfully target a character with an attack, that character suffers Snag on the next Skill Test they make before the start of your next turn. If they fail this Skill Test and you are aware of it, you gain 1 Terror. This Role Perk can only affect each target once per combat scene.

absolute menace.t: At 18th level, when you start your turn, you may expend 2 Personal Power to make a single Intimidation Skill Test against the Willpower of every enemy within 10 feet of you. Each enemy your Skill Test is successful against is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

roles.intro: Silver energy flows through the Morphin Grid, seeking to infuse candidates with an extraordinary symbiosis between a Ranger and their Grid constructs.

perfect tool for the job.t: Silver Rangers are jacks of all trades, embracing the Morphin Grid’s flexibility to solve a problem or overcome an obstacle. The same goes for having the right weapon for the enemy standing against them—a Silver Ranger urges the Morphin Grid to create the best way to defeat evil and defend the innocent.

team player or not?.t: Like their Green and White colleagues, Silver Rangers are excellent additions to Power Ranger teams but often tend to work alone. Akin to how the Silver Ranger calls on the right tool for the job, Champions of the Morphin Grid call out for their Silver Ranger allies when the time is right. Nothing keeps a Silver Ranger from staying with a team following the call to duty, but it often seems they fade away shortly after the threat is dealt with unless they feel the team needs them around.

always a silver ranger.t: While there may not be a Silver Ranger on every Power Ranger team across time and space, at least one candidate exists in each corner of the universe and every dimension. When the time is right, the Grid connects the Silver energy to a candidate and sends them to other Rangers’ aid.

You may choose one of these four effects each time you activate this perk. • You can create a temporary construct that is a tool or item needed at the moment that lasts for one hour. When you create the object, choose one Skill. The construct tool grants you Edge on Skill Tests with the selected skill. • You can change the shape and type of your Power Weapon until you leave your Morphed form, such as changing a light dagger to a versatile staff or a two-handed trident. • You can increase your Morphed form’s armor bonus to Toughness Defense by 1 for 1d6 × 10 minutes. You can choose this multiple times, up to a +3 cumulative bonus. • You can speed up the arrival of any Zords currently en route to the scene by 1 round. You can choose this multiple times in the same scene.

power boost.t: Starting at 3rd level, you can call upon the Grid to boost your Power Weapon attacks. As a Free action, you may spend two Personal Power to activate this Perk until the end of your turn. While active, you inflict an additional point of Energy damage with each Power Weapon attack. This bonus Energy damage increases to two points at 10th level and three at 17th level.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can personalize your Ranger by adding a General Perk for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action

roles.intro: The Coinless Resistance Origin can also work for resistance from a different place, such as Edenoi resisting Count Drakkon, or worlds under siege by Dark Specter.

grid equipment.t: You start with your possessions from your preMorphin’ life, but also gain the following items from the Morphin Grid. Those marked with an asterisk are only available when Morphed. • Gridwide Communicator • Magna Morpher • Magna Sword*

magna power!.t: Starting at 1st level, by summoning the energy within you through your Magna Morpher and saying the words “Magna Power!” as a Standard action, you are enveloped with a stylized shell of Morphin Grid energy that serves as your armor, grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • You gain a Toughness (Armor) bonus depending on your Armor Proficiency: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra-Heavy (+6). • You triple all of your Jump distance maximums. • As a Free action, you can summon your Magna Sword or other Power-based weapons to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious, and at 1 Health. This Role Perk counts as the “It’s Morphin Time!” Role Perk for the purpose of acquiring and using General Perks and Grid Powers. Anything that affects “It’s Morphin Time!” also affects this Role Perk.

honorable legacy.t: The Magna Defender title is unique in that its bearer chooses their successor. Even if a Magna Defender falls in battle, their spirit remains inside the Magna Sword until they find someone with the right mettle to inherit the power.

adaptable combatants.t: Magna Defenders are warriors capable of adapting to any battlefield. Sometimes, the Magna Defender searches for the enemy commander to engage them, disregarding all other combatants. On other occasions, they focus on defending their allies, rushing to them when attacked, or neutralizing any threat before it becomes a problem.

zord form.t: One of the most awe-inspiring aspects of the Magna Defenders is their ability to shift into a Zordlike form, thus fighting alongside their team’s Zords in a unique manner. The mystery behind this ability only adds to the Magna Defender legend.

spectrum role features.t: As a Magna Defender, you gain the following:

power.t: Personal Power Regeneration: 3 per day Personal Power Capacity: +1 per every 3 levels

training.t: Armor: Light, Medium, and Heavy Armor Starting Skill Ranks: +1 Intimidation, +1 Might, +1 Targeting CHAPTER TWO: SHATTERED AND REFORGED

magna sword.t: You wield a unique Power Weapon: the Magna Sword. This hand-and-a-half sword can convert into a secondary form known as the Magna Blaster. It has the following characteristics: When you summon your Magna Sword, it can appear in Magna Blaster mode. You may enhance any mode of your Magna Sword as you would with any other Power Weapon.

combat stance.t: In any battle, there is always one foe that stands out from the rest, and you are used to confronting these greater threats on your own. Beginning at 1st level when you use your “Magna Power!” Role Perk or as a Standard action while Morphed, you may designate an enemy you can see and whose Threat Level is not below your level by more than three levels. You prepare to fight your chosen foe by entering into Combat Stance. While in Combat Stance, you gain ↑1 on Attack Skill Tests against your chosen foe. In addition, you may spend 1

table 2-5: weapons of the magna defender.t: Magna Sword Might medium melee Reach 1 or 2 Sharp 1 Two hands: (Sharp 2, ↓1) Sharp, Power Weapon Magna Blaster Targeting medium ranged 60ft/100ft 2 Energy 1 — Energy, Power Weapon POWER RANGERS ROLEPLAYING GAME: THROUGH THE SHATTERED GRID Personal Power before making your Attack Skill Test to deal additional damage equal to the Combat Stance number (listed in the table above) if successful, once per Attack. Your Combat Stance lasts until your foe leaves the scene, is Defeated, you return to your natural form, or you end it as a Free action. You can only use this Role Perk once per scene.

defender step.t: Upon reaching 2nd level, you can move around the battlefield, protecting your allies. Whenever an Attack targets an ally you can see, you can spend 1 Personal Power to Move half your Ground Movement towards that ally. If you finish your movement adjacent to that ally, you increase their defenses against the Attack that triggered this Role Perk by an amount equal to your Combat Stance number.

torozord.t: As the Magna Defender, you are bound to a specific Zord: the Torozord. At 3rd level, you become able to summon it to aid you in battle. The Torozord follows the same rules as other Zords presented in the section starting on pg. 131 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. When piloting the Torozord, you cannot suffer a Snag on Driving Skill Tests. The Torozord begins with Hardened Chassis and Sentience as Automatic Zord Features. Still, you may replace them with others if you want to represent your affiliation to a specific Ranger team. You can find the initial statistics for the Torozord on pg. 38.

mega defender.t: Once the Torozord has answered your call and arrived at the conflict, by expending 3 Personal Power as a Standard action, you can have it channel and infuse you with Morphin Grid energy, changing you into a Zord-like form known as the Mega Defender. The following apply while you are in Mega Defender form: • You use the Strength and Speed Essence Scores, Health, Defense bonuses, and type of movement of the Mega Defender form. • You use your Might and Targeting Skill Ranks to make melee and ranged Attacks. • Once assumed, you remain in Mega Defender form until the scene’s end or the form’s Health falls to 0. • When reduced to 0 Health, you automatically return to your Morphed form with the same Health and Conditions you had before assuming the Mega Defender form. • While in this form, you and the Torozord share actions. This means only one of you can Move and only one can take a Standard action each turn. You may divide your Free actions as you see fit, using the highest number of Free actions between you to determine how many you have. You can find the statistics for the Mega Defender form on pg. 38. Your Mega Defender form cannot have Zord Features other than those listed.

defender torozord.t: While in Mega Defender form, you and the Torozord are considered to have the Combiner Zord Feature with the Core Body and Defender Megaform Traits, respectively, but only to combine to create a unique Megaform known as the Defender Torozord. At a later time, you can select the Combiner Zord Feature for the Torozord, choosing any Megaform Trait you desire so it can combine with other Zords.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you can personalize your Magna Defender by gaining a General Perk of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th level, you can Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of Attacks increases to three when you reach 10th level and to four when you reach 15th level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

grid power.t: Upon reaching 6th level, and again at 11th and 16th levels, you expand your understanding and connection to the Morphin Grid. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, choose a Grid Power for which you meet the requirements to add to your Magna Defender. CHAPTER TWO: SHATTERED AND REFORGED

torozord feature.t: Upon reaching 6th level, then again at 10th, 14th, and 17th levels, your connection with the Torozord has strengthened, allowing it to evolve and become more powerful. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you may choose from the available Zord Features to apply to the Torozord.

retribution.t: At 7th level, you can ensure those who Attack you or your allies pay for their transgressions. Whenever you activate your Defender Step and end adjacent to the enemy that triggered Defender Step, you can spend 1 Personal Power to make a single melee Attack against that foe. You gain +1 damage if the enemy still struck your ally or an Edge on the Retribution Attack if your Defender Step caused the Attack to miss.

continuous stance.t: At 9th level, you have better learned how to deal with your foes and not to relax until the fight is truly over. When you use Combat Stance, the dice shift you receive on Attacks you make against your chosen foe increases to ↑2. In addition, if your Combat Stance would end due to your enemy being Defeated or leaving the scene, you may designate a new one. If you cannot immediately designate any enemy, Combat Stance ends as usual.

swift defender.t: Beginning at 13th level, you have learned to move faster on a battlefield, even in the middle of a fight. When you use the Defender Step or the Retribution Role Perks, you can Move a distance equal to your Ground Movement instead of half. In addition, you gain 1 temporary Health when you activate Defender Step.

at all cost.t: At 18th level, you have developed a sense of duty towards your allies strong enough to surprise you with what you are capable of doing on their behalf. Once per day, you can fight beyond reaching 0 Health while Morphed. Instead of being Defeated or returning to your normal form, you may continue to fight normally. During this time, when an enemy successfully hits you, you lose Personal Power instead of Health. If, at any time during this Role Perk’s use, you reach 0 Personal Power, you immediately return to your normal form with 0 Health, with the Conditions Unconscious and Defeated. This is a dangerous Role Perk and is usually only called upon when the team is truly in trouble.

ultimate magna defender.t: At 20th level, you have become the most advanced version possible of the Magna Defender. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 to all defenses • An additional point of damage on all your melee Attacks, including the ones you make in Mega Defender form and while forming the Defender Torozord. • An Edge on Strength Skill Tests General Perks This section provides new General Perks for the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game. These Perks are available to any Ranger. Characters in other Essence20 Roleplaying System games may, at the Game Master’s discretion, also select these General Perks.

dr. k’s modified morpher.t: Your Power Morpher has been modified by Dr. K, making its connection to the Morphin Grid much more stable. Attacks that would make you lose Personal Power or make you unable to spend it suffer ↓2 when targeting you.

harrowing past.t: There is something in your past you don’t talk about and try to hide from others. Perhaps you were a bully, an evil Ranger, or worse. While you now fight for a better cause, you haven’t forgotten how to hit your enemies where it hurts the most. • You gain ↑1 on Intimidation Skill Tests. • You may spend a Story Point to know a weakness or a Hang-Up of a single enemy you can see.

once a ranger.t: This is not your first time wearing the suit. Maybe you received a call to a greater mission and had to change teams, leave for a time before resuming your heroic activity, or had the opportunity to briefly become a Power Ranger at some point in your past. However, once a Ranger, always a Ranger. You gain the following benefits:

roles.intro: Thousands of years before the Power Rangers, the Eltarians manifested the powers of the Morphin Grid and created an elite peacekeeping force.

protector of the universe.t: Eltarians’ technologically advanced civilization grants them the responsibility to steward young and vulnerable cultures and worlds. Some of these planets join under Eltar’s protectorate to gain access to their technology and teachings, especially on matters related to the Morphin Grid. To fulfill Eltar’s obligation to the many worlds under its protection, Guardians are recruited and trained as part of a company of other Guardians. These Guardians work, train, and fight together as a cohesive unit under a company leader or lieutenant. More experienced Guardians may accompany the Chief or Supreme Guardian on expeditions and assaults, a point of pride for some and worry for those hoping to return home alive. A Guardian’s life is full of challenges and dangers, but it’s an opportunity for them to serve Eltar and the wider interstellar community.

soldier of peace.t: As servants of the greater good, a Guardian of Eltar represents the wisdom of the Elders of Eltar. While some may find their wisdom bureaucratic and slow, Guardians must be ready to act whenever threats emerge, and people become endangered. Each Guardian has a reason why they joined, whether because of obligations, a sense of duty, or gloryseeking; their training inevitably turns them into proper warriors who can fend off the most mundane threats.

beacons of power.t: The armor and Morphed shell of a Guardian of Eltar symbolizes peace and justice. From their ranks, the Guardians appoint lieutenants and leaders to oversee small battalions and companies of Guardians through the stars. The Supreme Guardian sits at the top of the hierarchy as a direct envoy with the Elders of Eltar. Following the Supreme Guardian is the Chief Guardian, the second-in-command of all Guardians and typically a formal title dedicated to the next Supreme Guardian apparent. Each Guardian is charged with the Eltarian’s technology that utilizes Grid energy, coupled with tens of thousands of years of advancement over many other civilizations. A Guardian of Eltar embodies the teachings of the Elders, the strength and tenacity of their training, and the Power also protects them.

spectrum role features.t: As a Guardian of Eltar, you gain the following: Power Personal Power Regeneration: 1 per day Personal Power Capacity: +2 per every 5 Levels CHAPTER THREE: WORLDS BEYOND Training Armor: Light, Medium, and Heavy Armor Starting Skill Ranks: +1 Might, +1 Performance, +1 Technology Grid Equipment You start with your possessions from your preMorphin life and gain the following items from the Morphin Grid. Those marked with an asterisk are only available when Morphed. • Gridwide Communicator • Morpher • Eltarian Battle Staff • Ranged Power Weapon*

a guardian of eltar!.t: Starting at 1st Level, you can summon the energy within you by using your Power Morpher and saying the words “You’ve Got a Guardian of Eltar!” as a Standard action. Morphin Grid energy envelops you, giving you a stylized shell of Grid energy that serves as your armor, grants you access to your Power-based weapons, and many other abilities that require Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • You gain a Toughness bonus depending on your Armor Proficiency: Light (+1), Medium (+2), Heavy (+4), Ultra Heavy (+6) • You triple all your Jump distance maximums. • As a Free action, you can summon any single Power-based weapon to your hands. • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious, and at 1 Health.

eltarian tech.t: Starting at 1st Level, you have underlying access to Eltar’s greatest technological achievements and use it to overcome any obstacles when dealing with technology from other species. You receive a number of Eltarian Tech Points per day, as listed in the table. At any point when you make a Technology Skill Test, you may spend 1 Eltarian Tech to gain an Edge on that roll.

charge into battle.t: Guardians of Eltar are known to charge toward foes and violators of interstellar laws. At 2nd Level, you hone your combat prowess to charge into dangerous situations and emerge unscathed. You gain +2 to Evasion, ↑1 to your Alertness Skill Tests, and ↑1 on Attack Skill Tests against multiple direct targets. Whenever you wield a Melee Power Weapon, it gains Multiple Targets (2) if it does not have the Multiple Targets trait.

zeal.t: A Guardian of Eltar carries a strong conviction to bring peace to the universe and stop any injustices. At 2nd Level, any mind-affecting or mental Attack has a Snag against the Guardian’s Willpower.

rally guardians.t: At 3rd Level, you have been given command of a small company of fellow Eltarian Guardians. These Guardians are summoned to aid you in battle. Unlike a Zord, you rally your company of warriors using the Persuasion Skill, and you cannot suffer a Snag while making Skill Tests using the Persuasion Skill to direct your fellow Guardians. Your company of Guardians uses the same rules and statistics for Zords as they appear on pg. 131 of the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook.

rally guardians feature.t: Your company of Guardians gains Zoid Features at the Levels indicated on Table 3-2. However, it cannot take the Combiner or Zord-Mega Weapon System Zord Features nor any feature that has Combiner as a prerequisite.

general perk.t: When you reach 4th Level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th Level, you can personalize your Guardian by adding a General Perk for which you meet the prerequisites.

extra attack.t: Beginning at 5th Level, you can Attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of Attacks increases to two when you reach 15th Level. This Role Perk only functions while Morphed and fighting as an individual.

grid power.t: Upon reaching 6th Level, and again at 11th and 16th Levels, you expand your understanding and connection to the Morphin Grid. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, choose a Grid Power for which you meet the requirements to add to your Guardian.

eltarian mettle.t: At 7th Level, you channel the Morphin Grid into your inner reserves and push through any pain and adversity. You can spend 1 Personal Power as a Free action to remove one Condition other than Defeated.

wisdom of the elders.t: At 9th Level, and again at 18th Level, you implore the council of the Eltarian Elders for guidance as you evolve your Morphed form to protect Eltar and all innocent life. Choose one of the following improvements from Table 3-3: Wisdom of the Elders to your Morphed form. Each modification requires Personal Power or Eltarian Tech Points to activate.

observer.t: At 10th Level, you can use the Morphin Grid to create disguises to blend into local populations to observe and assess when a planet is ready to receive the benefits of Eltar’s technology and teachings. You gain the following benefits: • You can activate your disguise using your Morpher as a Free action, spending 1 Personal Power. • You gain ↑2 to Deception Skill Tests. • If you suffer a Snag on any Social-based Skill Tests regarding understanding another species, you may suffer ↓2 on the Skill Test instead. • If anyone attempts to search or scan for you using any Technology-based Skill Tests, they suffer a Snag when attempting to find or identify you. CHAPTER THREE: WORLDS BEYOND

chief guardian.t: When you reach 13th Level, your experience with the wider interstellar community and its many threats has granted you special boons from the Eltarian Elders. You may choose one of the following benefits: • Energy Rebuttal: Whenever you use the Defend action against an oncoming Attack that deals Energy damage and it fails, you absorb some of the residual energy to deal an extra 2 Energy damage on your next Attack. This Role Perk can only be used once per combat scene. • Guardian Blast: You and your allies can make a combined Attack. As a team, with you leading the effort, everyone must spend their full action to move into the same area (within 5 feet of at least 2 other allies) and launch an Attack fueled by Grid energy. You and each ally make a Group Targeting Skill Test. If you hit, the blast deals 5 Energy damage. • Tactical Meditation: Your mind is full of battle strategies and tactics. You cannot be surprised, and allies within 10 feet of you gain ↑2 to Alertness and Initiative Skill Tests.

supreme guardian.t: At 20th Level, you have achieved the pinnacle as a Guardian of Eltar as a clandestine beacon of peace and order. Your Morphed form gains the following benefits: • When you Morph, you may immediately cause the area within a 20-foot radius of you to become illuminated with bright light and make a Technology Skill Test against each Threat’s Toughness. On a success, the Threat is Blinded for 1d6 combat rounds. • After you hit with an Attack with a Melee Power Weapon, you may spend any number of Eltarian Tech Points to add an 1 Energy damage per Tech Point spent to the total damage dealt. • Whenever you take Energy damage, you may roll a d20. If the roll is 10 or above, you regain 1 Eltarian Tech Point. New General Perks

emissary’s gift.t: Prerequisite: Level 5+, GM approval One of the many Emissaries of the Morphin Masters has granted you the rare opportunity to go beyond the limits of your Spectrum energy. When you choose this Perk, select a Role Perk from any of the Core Ranger Spectrum Roles at any Level equal to or lower than your current Level; you now possess this Role Perk. Replace any references to that Spectrum Role with that of your current Spectrum Role. If your new Perk would refer to any special quantities on that Spectrum Role’s Level progression table, such as Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots or Green Ranger’s Solo Strike, that special quantity is its lowest (for example, Pink Ranger’s Volley Shots cannot exceed 2). You cannot choose the following: Extra Attack, General Perk, Grid Power, Zord, Zord Feature.

eltarian training.t: Prerequisite: Speed 4 or higher You have trained with Eltarian warriors in their combat arts and tactics to powerful effect. Your Ground Movement increases by 10 feet, and you ignore the first ↓1 on Finesse Skill Tests.

table 3-3: wisdom of the elders.t: Teleportation 1 Eltarian Tech Point Teleport to a location you can see within 30 feet of you. Lightshield Armor 1 Personal Power Gain +2 to Toughness for the next 2d4 combat rounds. Enhanced Reflexes 1 Eltarian Tech Point Gain ↑2 to all Acrobatics and Initiative Skill Tests for 1d6 minutes. Lightfoil Wings 2 Eltarian Tech Points Gain an Aerial Movement equal to your Ground Movement for 1d6 hours. Resilient Armor 2 Personal Power Ignore 1 damage per turn for 1d4 combat turns. Ferocious Strikes 3 Personal Power Make one additional melee Attack per Attack action for the next 1d4 combat rounds.

roles.intro: In game terms, the following six Psycho Paths are new Roles for the Power Rangers Roleplaying Game that players can use alongside other Essence20 Origins and Influences to make Psycho Ranger player characters ranging from 1st to 20th level.

table 5-1: infiltrator bond.t: 1 I have made actual friendships among the enemy, and it saddens me to think I can’t be honest with them… or can I? 2 There is one troublesome foe that I am sure knows who I really am, and they use this truth against me at the worst time. 3 I can’t help but distrust everyone around me a little bit, as my time with the enemy taught me that anyone might not be who they say they are. 4 My time with the enemy has rubbed off on me a little, and I have picked up some of their bad habits. 5 I find it hard to be myself, my true self, around anyone anymore. 6 Sometimes I find it easier to fake a personality for strangers than it is to explain the little quirks of my real one. 7 I regret getting so close to my enemies, but I know it was necessary. 8 I have a bad poker face: there’s always a tell when I’m lying. 9 I use a lot of terms, slang, and turns of phrase that came from me acting as one of the enemy. 10 I have a souvenir from my other life that I treasure, even if it could get me in a lot of trouble. 11 I didn’t make friends with the enemy. I played the part. Nothing more. I knew what I had to do, and I did it. 12 I had to do some unsavory things while I was infiltrating the enemy, and I will never be able to forgive myself for them.

the original path.t: The plans first laid out by Dark Specter and his minions to create the Psycho Rangers began with the Path of Cruelty. For horrible beings like them, it was a simple thought: how do we push the pure light of the Morphin Grid through a twisted prism of hate and anger? Their answer took shape in the form of a wayward Xybrian named Trek, the green Supersonic Ranger. When that foul traitor allowed evil into his heart and led his team to destruction, the Path of Cruelty became a reality.

a mad furnace of sinister passions.n: A Mad Furnace of Sinister Passions
a mad furnace of sinister passions.t: So much passionate fury and spite fill up the followers of the Path of Cruelty that they must release it in waves of fiery destruction, lest it consume them. Tinges of madness follow in the wake of holding in such a kaleidoscope of feelings, which is why the Path teaches its followers to act upon their worst impulses and let out those thoughts. Better the world suffers than you.

consumed by rage.t: The Path of Cruelty is fueled by the heat and ferocity of its anger and hatred, and those who are bound by it can seem shortsighted when they lose track of their goals in favor of a momentary rush of violence. Ultimately this flaw doesn’t change how fierce and dedicated to malice those who walk this Path are, but it could be exploited by their foes. PLAYING WITH THE BAD GUYS PLAYING WITH THE BAD GUYS but also gain the following items from your Morphin Grid access portal. Those marked with an asterisk are only available when Morphed. • Psycho Morpher (a corrupted Power Morpher) • Wrist Communicator • Any Psycho Weapon*

psychic scars.t: There is a cost to forcing the Morphin Grid to empower a clone made from evil science and imperfect memories. Anytime you roll a skill test and Fumble, roll 1d6 and apply the result. • 1–3: No additional effect • 4: Immobilized until end of your next turn • 5: Impaired until end of your next turn • 6: Stunned until end of your next turn

let’s go psycho!.t: Starting at 1st level, by hijacking Morphin Grid energy using your Psycho Morpher and saying “Let’s Go Psycho!” as a Standard action, you open a personal access portal and assume your Morphed form. You are enveloped with a specialized shell of Morphin Grid energy forming your Psycho Armor, granting you access to your Power-based weapons and many other abilities that require Personal Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • Your Psycho Armor gives you a +2 deflective bonus to Toughness and Evasion Defenses. • All of your Jump distance maximums are tripled. • As a Free action, you can summon your Psycho Weapon to your hands. • You gain the Psycho Strike melee attack (see pg. 302). • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious and at 1 Health.

gang up.t: Beginning at 1st level, your Path of Cruelty teachings trained you to strike at enemies when they are busy dealing with something else, gaining the bonus listed on Table 5-2: The Path of Cruelty to an attack against a target currently within 5 feet of another being on a Psycho Path.

psycho path features.t: As a practitioner of the Path of Cruelty, you gain the following:

training.t: Armor: Psycho Armor Starting Skill Ranks: +1 Might, +1 Deception, +1 Persuasion

psycho kit.t: You start with an assortment of basic personal possessions that help define you as an individual,

psycho blast.t: Beginning at 2nd level, you can channel a concentrated outburst of aggressive energy as a forceful attack that explodes upon contact. You gain access to the Psycho Blast attack (see pg. 302).

push through the pain.t: At 2nd level, the Path of Cruelty allows you to use external negative stimuli as motivation instead of a hindrance. Anytime you suffer 2 or more damage in a single attack, you regain 1 Personal Power.

monster morph.t: At 3rd level, your Psycho Path can change your body into a monstrous form of a metallic exoskeleton overflowing with the spectral balefire of hate. You can spend 3 Personal Power as a Standard action to change into your specific Monster Form. The Monster Form of the Path of Cruelty grants the following benefits: • You grow to Large Size • +2 natural bonus to Toughness Defense • Maximum (and current) Health increases by 2 • ↑1 to Alertness, Intimidation, and Might Skill Tests • Replace weapons and Unarmed attacks with Focused Rage Flare and Monstrous Talons (see pg. 302) • Monstrous Talons inflict 2 Sharp damage • Can re-assume Ranger form as a Free action • Once per round when you suffer 2 or more damage from a single attack, you can attempt an Intimidation Skill Test targeting the Willpower Defense of all creatures within 10 feet of you. Upon success, each target suffers 1 Void damage.

Anytime a character Fumbles a Skill Test within 15 feet of you, you can spend 1 Personal Power to inflict 2 Psychic damage upon them or 2 Personal Power to inflict the damage and impart the Impaired condition.

cruel warlord.t: At 20th level, you become the most advanced evolution of the Path of Cruelty. roles.intro: Like the focused lick of a blowtorch’s fire, the Path of Flame takes the entirety of a Psycho Ranger’s anger and violent tendencies and transforms them into a precision tool of destruction.

control vs. unleash.t: The Path of Flame teaches its followers a simple truth: control your anger, let it build, and unleash its fury like a storm upon your foes. When a Psycho Ranger devoted to this concept has the right of it, very little can hope to keep up with the amount of unchecked violence they are capable of.

where there’s smoke.t: Once someone becomes devoted to the Path of Flame, they transform at some level into a living battery of destructive energy. They are the embodiment of dangerous potential, always watching and coiling their proverbial — and sometimes literal — muscles for the next perfect time to strike. Psycho Rangers on this path cannot help but always seem like they are expecting something to happen… because they often are.

boiling over.t: A pot of water placed over a flame eventually produces something useful. But if left unused and unchecked, it boils over. The Path of Flame is much the same. If its followers are not careful to find productive ways to wield the fury of its teachings, they surely lose control and risk burning everyone around them, too. It is for this reason that many devotees of the Path of Flame take on tedious and menial hobbies to give them an outlet for their smoldering rage.

nothing really matters.t: Everything is going to come crashing to an ultimate end, and followers of the Path of Frost know and understand this fact completely. They live for the moment, enjoying the chaos their actions set in motion, even if it causes distress to their allies or themselves!

more energy, more fun.t: The Path of Frost thrives on breaking down the bonds that hold everything together, and its disciples are drawn to where they find more energy. The followers of this Path come circling like moths to a flame to where the Morphin Grid is strongest or where its Power is being expended and flaunted. However, these moths are eager to snuff that flame out once and for all.

Psycho Rangers that follow this Path consume energy from the universe around them, which is reflected somewhat in their own hyperactivity.

hard heart, harder flesh.t: Wielding an aspect of Morphin Grid power that hardens the Psycho Ranger in all ways, those upon the Path of Stone begin their journey by turning off unwanted feelings. Eventually this manifestation evolves into a literal increase in density, resilience, and the ability to bodily transform into a cold, uncaring titan made from meteoric bedrock.

psycho path features.t: As a practitioner of the Path of Stone, you gain the following:

training.t: Armor: Psycho Armor Starting Skill Ranks: +1 Conditioning, +1 Might, +1 Survival

psycho kit.t: You start with an assortment of basic personal possessions that help define you as an individual, but also gain the following items from your Morphin Grid access portal. Those marked with an asterisk are only available when Morphed. • Psycho Morpher (a corrupted Power Morpher) • Wrist Communicator • Any Medium Psycho Weapon*

psychic scars.t: There is a cost to forcing the Morphin Grid to empower a clone made from evil science and imperfect memories. Anytime you roll a skill test and Fumble, roll 1d6 and apply the result. • 1–3: No additional effect • 4: Immobilized until end of your next turn • 5: Impaired until end of your next turn • 6: Stunned until end of your next turn

let’s go psycho!.t: Starting at 1st level, by hijacking Morphin Grid energy using your Psycho Morpher and saying “Let’s Go Psycho!” as a Standard action, you open a personal access portal and assume your Morphed form. You are enveloped with a specialized shell of Morphin Grid energy forming your Psycho Armor, granting you access to your Power-based weapons and many other abilities that require Personal Power to activate. While Morphed, the following traits and features apply: • Your Psycho Armor gives you a +2 deflective bonus to Toughness and Evasion Defenses. • All of your Jump distance maximums are tripled. • As a Free action, you can summon your Psycho Weapon to your hands. • You gain the Psycho Strike melee attack (see pg. 302). • When reduced to 0 Health, you may choose to avoid Defeat by automatically returning to your natural form, unconscious and at 1 Health.

numbness.t: Beginning at 1st level, the Path of Stone offers you a growing numbness that shuts out pain as easily as you shut out your emotions. You begin by having Resistance to Stun attacks. At 6th level, Psychic damage is added to your Resistances, Blunt at 12th level, and Energy at 19th level.

on my own.t: At 2nd level, the Path of Stone teaches a deep belief that, despite being part of a team, you are still better off fighting on your own. You gain ↑1 when you aren’t within 10 feet of an ally.

psycho blast.t: Beginning at 2nd level, you can channel a concentrated outburst of aggressive energy as a forceful attack that explodes upon contact. You gain access to the Psycho Blast attack (see pg. 302).

monster morph.t: At 3rd level, your Psycho Path can change your body into a monstrous form of dense rock and sharp stone. You can spend 3 Personal Power as a Standard action to change into your specific Monster Form. The Monster Form of the Path of Frost grants the following benefits: • Large Size • +4 natural bonus to Toughness Defense • Maximum (and current) Health increases by 2 • ↑1 to Intimidation, Might, and Survival Skill Tests • Resistance to all damage types except Psychic, Sonic, and Void damage • Replace weapons and Unarmed attacks with Hurl Stones and Massive Fists (see pg. 302) • Can re-assume Ranger form as a Free action

general perk.t: When you reach 4th level, and again at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level, you gain a General Perk of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites.

psycho assault.t: At 5th level, you can spend 1 Personal Power as a Free action to gain ↑1 and +1 damage of the respective type to all attacks this turn. This Role Perk can be used only when Morphed and not in Monster Form.

enhance monster.t: When you reach 6th level, then again at 14th, 17th, and 19th levels, your Monster Form evolves further to become a better weapon of your Psycho Path. You may choose one of the following enhancements to augment your Monster Form: • Add 1 damage to one Monster Form attack • Gain a +2 bonus to one Defense or a +1 bonus to two Defenses while in Monster Form • Add 50% to the Range of one attack, rounding up to the nearest 5ft increment • Increase the radius of a blast attack by 5 ft or the length of a line attack by 10 ft • Choose two Skills; each gains ↑1 while in Monster Form • Maximum (and current) Health in Monster Form increases by 2

avalanche stomp.t: At 9th level, you can leverage the strength and density of your Monster Form to stomp the ground and send shock waves toward your foes. As a Standard action, spend 1 Personal Power to make an Athletics Skill Test against the Toughness Defense of all creatures within 30 feet of you and on the ground. On a success, a target takes Stun 2; on a Critical Success, the target is also knocked Prone. This attack has the Stun Trait.

unmovable.t: At 15th level, you can spend 1 Personal Power as a Free action to become rooted to the spot. All attempts to forcibly move or Maneuver you in any way until you move for any reason (including choosing to do so) suffer a ↓3 penalty.

stone warlord.t: At 20th level, you become the most advanced evolution of the Path of Stone. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 bonus to all Defenses • Add an additional Damage type to your Numbness list • While in Monster Form, you reduce all sources of damage by 1 (minimum 0) Path of Thorns Focusing on the lingering pain that comes with an infected wound, the Path of Thorns teaches its devotees to make the most out of the attacks they inflict. They turn the slightest scratch into searing, excruciating torment.

hurt where it counts.t: The kinds of pain and suffering found at the root of this Path focus on getting past a foe’s defenses to strike where it hurts the absolute most. Unlike their peers, who hammer away at their enemies with ferocious fury, a follower of the Path of Thorns gives only a single thought to a target, but then revels in its suffering.

pain is fuel.t: The Path of Thorns teaches that the road to ultimate victory is littered with its devotees’ writhing victims. The disciples of this Path revel in every little moment of unfortunate anguish or even minor discomfort of their friends and foes. They are aware of every little thing that causes pain to others… and they live for it.

deep thoughts.t: Followers on the Path of Thorns are deceptively clever, their minds turned to long-term machinations and schemes. They are fast learners of the best ways to inflict pain on others and aid their allies in doing so, as well.

their loss, my gain.t: At 1st level, followers of the Path of Thorns are strengthened by the hardships of others. Anytime a character that you can see within 60 feet Fumbles a Skill Test, you regain a number Health as shown in the Loss and Gain column on Table 5-6: The Path of Thorns.

unshakeable aim.t: At 2nd level, when you decide to put someone in your sights, your aim is ironclad. By taking the Aim action and spending 1 Personal Power, you gain ↑2 to the attack Skill Test and add the Ballistic Trait to the attack instead of the normal Aim benefits.

monster morph.t: At 3rd level, your Psycho Path can change your body into a monstrous form of spiky foliage and jagged armor plating. You can spend 3 Personal Power as a Standard action to change into your specific Monster Form. grid power.t: When you reach 6th level, then again at 11th and 16th levels, your Psycho Path allows you to intrude upon the secrets of the Morphin Grid and make them your own. Each time you acquire this Role Perk, you gain a Grid Power, as long as you meet the requirements.

maximize flaws.t: At 7th level, you fully understand how to use a target’s weaknesses against them. By spending a Free action and spending 1 Personal Power, your attacks for the rest of your turn ignore a single target’s Resistances. If the target has no Resistances, you gain Edge on these attacks instead.

nemesis drain.t: At 7th level, you can, once per scene, spend 2 Personal Power as a Standard action to unleash your negatively charged connection to the Morphin Grid. This allows you to attack all Power Rangers within 30 feet, making an Intimidation Skill Test versus their Willpower Defense. Targets successfully hit lose 1 Personal Power and take a –1 penalty to any Defenses that gained a bonus from armor generated by the It’s Morphin Time! Role Perk. The penalty lasts until the end of the scene.

zordbane.t: Starting at 8th level, your Monster Form evolves to deal with Morphin Grid war machines with even greater efficiency. Whenever targeting a Zord of any kind, you gain ↑1 to the attack Skill Test and +1 damage of the respective type.

pollen cloud.t: At 9th level, you can blast an area with corrosive pollen while in your Monster Form. As a Standard action, spend 1 Personal Power to make a Targeting attack with a Range of 30ft/80ft. This attack can’t be defended against with Evasion and effects a 30ft × 30ft area. On a success, a target takes 2 Acid damage. This attack has the Alternate Effect: Target is Blinded until the end of its next turn. This attack has the Acid Trait.

grow!.t: At 10th level, you can spend a Standard action while in Monster Form to enlarge yourself. Your Size becomes Towering, which grants +1 damage to all attacks, and you gain +2 to your Toughness and Evasion.

suffer!.t: At 15th level, the Path of Thorns grants you the horrifying ability to infuse your attacks with primordial pain. After successfully inflicting damage on a target with an attack, you can spend any number of Personal Power as a Free action. That target is Impaired for a number of turns equal to the number of Personal Power spent.

thorn warlord.t: At 20th level, you become the most advanced evolution of the Path of Thorns. Your Morphed form immediately gains the following benefits: • +2 bonus to all Defenses • When you successfully attack a target suffering from the Frightened or Impaired condition, you regain 2 Personal Power • While in Monster Form, any attack you make that deals Acid damage can’t be defended against with Toughness Path of Venom Focused on putting enemies into a weakened state and then taking advantage of it, the Path of Venom is as vicious as any of its parallels. Mixing precise violent strikes with harsh chemical payloads, the devotees of this Path are nothing short of terrifying.

everything is a target.t: The horrifying toxicity of the Path of Venom is not purely taught in the sense of poisons of the body, but also the foul contaminants of the mind. Followers of this path see the world in different shades of weakness and how easily it would be to lay someone low, including their own allies. Nothing is safe from their predation forever.

know thy fears.t: Fear, terror, and horror are weapons in the Path of Venom’s arsenal, as they get the heart pumping and the mind racing. Poisons spread through a target faster when they are in the throes of panic. Hasty solutions and bad decisions are just as useful to these disciples in overcoming a foe as blades and bows.

uninventive but dangerous.t: Many of those treading down the Path of Venom are described as quiet or withdrawn, but such an appearance is a predator’s ploy. They make their foes believe them to be dim or unimaginative, luring them into prime striking range before exploding into action. There are great instincts hiding behind those cold, uncaring eyes.

Weapon Effects and Traits The following are new or altered descriptors of Effects and Traits to apply to weapons in the Essence20 Roleplaying System. Element (Void): This weapon utilizes a portion of the energy of consumption and the Dark Dimension, a taste of what the enemy holds as a constant basis in their hearts. This rare Element damage ignores any armor bonuses to Toughness but corrupts the thoughts and actions of its wielder over time. Non-Psycho Ranger users need special training to operate Void weapons without being overwhelmed by their inherent evil. Inaccurate: Inherently poor at targeting, users suffer the listed penalty when attacking with this weapon. Power Weapon: A weapon attuned to and empowered by Grid Energy in some way, and qualified for many other in-game effects that specify Power Weapons. Versatile: A weapon that has two methods of being wielded. Usually, this refers to wielding in one hand versus two hands, but some weapons offer different options.
